prs.title: fix(ci): route web shell smoke to ARM64 independently
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Routes self-hosted web-shell E2E smoke runs to ARM64 independently of the ordinary Linux CI fleet. The classifier still decides whether a run may use self-hosted runners, preserving untrusted-fork fallback, hosted fleet overrides, dispatch selection, the kill switch, and the missing-output fallback.

## Why it's needed

The smoke lane currently inherits the global Linux architecture. Restoring ordinary CI to the x64 ECS fleet therefore also sends smoke there. This separates the smoke architecture without changing ordinary CI routing.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With the global fleet set to x64, trusted PRs should keep ordinary CI on x64 and select ARM64 for smoke. Untrusted forks and runs forced hosted should select ubuntu-latest for smoke. A missing classifier output should also remain hosted.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The new regression failed against the original workflow because a trusted run selected x64/ecs-qwen instead of ARM64. After the fix, `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` passes all 82 tests. `node --test --test-name-pattern='ownership' .github/scripts/qwen-triage-workflow.test.mjs` passes all 13 selected tests. Prettier checks for both changed files and `git diff --check` pass.

An additional full triage-workflow test run had 42 failures in unrelated flakiness shell-wrapper tests (combined run: 165 passed, 42 failed). The representative `all-pass rounds land` failure also reproduces with the original workflow restored: it reports `error` instead of `pass`.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ Routing and targeted workflow tests |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ No live runner execution |

## Risk & Scope

- ARM64 selection uses the existing self-hosted/linux/arm64 fleet labels.
- This changes routing only; application build/typecheck and live smoke execution were not run.
- Repository variables, CI reruns, and backlog operations are handled separately. Rerunning an older workflow does not pick up this change until its workflow revision includes it.
- No product-facing changes or migration.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

让使用 self-hosted runner 的 web-shell E2E smoke 独立选择 ARM64，不再继承普通 Linux CI 的架构。是否允许 self-hosted 仍由 classifier 决定，因此保留不可信 fork、全局 hosted 覆盖、dispatch 选择、kill switch 和 classifier 输出缺失时的 hosted 回退。

## 原因

smoke 目前继承全局 Linux 架构。普通 CI 恢复到 x64 ECS 后，smoke 也会被分配到 x64。本改动独立 smoke 的架构选择，不改变普通 CI 的路由。

## 评审验证

全局 fleet 为 x64 时，可信 PR 的普通 CI 应继续使用 x64，smoke 应使用 ARM64。不可信 fork、强制 hosted 的执行和缺失 classifier 输出时，smoke 均应使用 ubuntu-latest。

新回归测试在原 workflow 上因可信执行选择 x64/ecs-qwen 而非 ARM64 失败。修复后 routing 套件 82 项通过，ownership 定向测试 13 项通过，两个修改文件的 Prettier 检查和 git diff --check 通过。

额外运行完整 triage-workflow 套件时，flakiness shell-wrapper 测试出现 42 项失败（合并运行结果为 165 项通过、42 项失败）。恢复原 workflow 后，代表性用例 all-pass rounds land 仍返回 error 而非 pass，确认该失败在基线上存在。

本机 macOS 已验证 routing 和相关 workflow 测试；未在 Windows 或真实 Linux runner 上执行。

## 风险与范围

ARM64 使用现有 self-hosted/linux/arm64 标签。本次仅修改路由，未运行应用构建、类型检查或真实 smoke。仓库变量、CI 重跑和积压任务由单独操作处理。旧 workflow 的重跑不会自动获得本改动，必须使用包含此修复的 workflow 版本。无产品行为变更或迁移。

prs.title: feat(cli): add the /autofix-pr reaction layer: guarded push, sync, replies, re-runs and the skill
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the reaction layer of `/autofix-pr` (delivery step 3 of [the design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.md)), on top of the probes that #15057 shipped. A watched PR can now be fixed, pushed to and answered, through four new helpers and a bundled skill:

- `qwen autofix-pr push <pr>` pushes the worktree's commits only as a fast-forward of the head the watch knows, with `--force-with-lease` on that head. Pre-push hooks run, and it never uses `--force`. At push time it asks GitHub whether the PR is still open and whether the target is the default branch. It stops after 10 pushes. A push someone else made meanwhile answers `resync` instead of being overwritten.
- `qwen autofix-pr sync <pr>` adopts someone else's push. A clean worktree is fast-forwarded. Unpushed commits meeting a head pushed on top of the known one get a "merge first" answer (never a rebase). A rewritten history (the author rebased or force-pushed) replaces the worktree, and any unpushed attempt made on the old history is reported as dropped.
- `qwen autofix-pr reply <pr> <plan.json>` posts a round's thread replies and its summary comment. Before anything is posted, the plan is checked against a fresh read of the PR: a reply may only go to a thread that has a new comment from a trusted author right now, and untrusted comments cannot be marked handled. Every body ends with the reply marker. Each posted id is recorded the moment it exists, so running the same plan again after a failure skips what was already posted. The plan also records failed checks and a conflict that the round left for a human. `--no-post` records them without posting anything.
- `qwen autofix-pr rerun <pr> <run-id>` re-runs an infrastructure failure at most once per check and head; the next failure of that check is treated as real.
- In prepared mode, `snapshot` now prints each failed check's attempt `key`, and it skips attempts and a conflict that an earlier round already handled.
- The bundled `/autofix-pr` skill ties these together:
  - It confirms once at the start, where it will push and that it will reply.
  - `--once` runs a single round. Otherwise the watch is a session-only scheduled task whose gate is `snapshot --gate`, so a quiet PR costs no model turn.
  - Each round runs one fix agent in the PR worktree, in the foreground. Then it re-runs CI when the agent asks for it, pushes, and replies.
  - It also has `stop` and a minimal `status`.

Docs:

- The design doc, in English and Chinese, gains the contracts of `push`, `reply`, `sync` (6.8) and `rerun` (6.9), plus delivery notes.
- A user page, `docs/users/features/autofix-pr.md`, and a row in the commands table.
- A scope note in `autofix-shared-skill.md`: its "never pushes or writes to GitHub" rule is about `/autofix` on the working tree. `/autofix-pr` is a separate command that pushes and replies only after a confirmation at each start.
- The Web Shell menu shows the skill's description in Chinese.

## Why it's needed

#15056 asks for a session that reacts to its PR — CI failures, review comments, conflicts — without a `/loop` polling the model. The trigger layer (#15069, #15211) and the probes (#15057) are merged, but nothing could act on what they report: there was no safe way to push a fix, adopt someone else's push, reply without answering its own replies, or re-run a flaky job without looping. This PR adds those writes behind deterministic checks, and the skill that drives them.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/autofix-pr`. The `push` and `sync` tests run real git against a local bare remote:
  - a lease rejected by someone else's push;
  - a non-fast-forward refused;
  - a failing pre-push hook;
  - a force-push by the author;
  - a merge requested when unpushed work meets a head pushed on top.
- `reply` and `rerun` tests mock only `gh` and the PR read:
  - a reply to an untrusted-only or unknown thread posts nothing;
  - a retry after a failed POST posts only the missing replies, and a third run posts nothing;
  - `--no-post` posts nothing;
  - a second re-run of a check on the same head is refused.
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills/bundled/autofix-pr` checks the skill's grants with a real PermissionManager. It allows `gh pr view` and the skill's own `.qwen/tmp` files. It does not allow `git push`, `gh pr comment`, `gh run rerun`, the helpers themselves, or a compound command that only starts with an allowed one. `ask_user_question` and `cron_create` stay behind their dialogs.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `qwen autofix-pr push 7` → `Unknown argument: push`, and no `/autofix-pr` skill.

After, on head d70aa9ddb9:

- `autofix-pr` tests 148/148, skill tests 3/3, core skill tests 763 passed (`src/skills`), Web Shell `localCommands` 11/11;
- cli and Web Shell typecheck clean; eslint and prettier clean.
- 16 mutants, each removing one guard, were all killed: the lease, the clean-worktree check, the fast-forward check, the default branch, the PR state, the push budget, the thread trust check, the retry skip, the once-per-head summary, untrusted ids marked handled, the second re-run, handled attempts, the handled conflict, the `sync` merge branch, the `sync` reset, and `--no-post`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests with real git; N/A otherwise.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The command pushes and comments under the user's own identity. The checks above sit in the helpers, not in the prompt.
  - The skill grants no shell rule for its helpers. The permission matcher tokenizes a command with shell-quote, which reads `"${QWEN_CODE_CLI:-qwen}"` as an empty word, so no allow rule can name the helpers alone; this is also why `/review` grants every shell command. Granting all shell for the rest of the session to a skill that reads untrusted PR text is the larger risk. In the default approval mode, every helper call, the push included, therefore asks first, and an unattended watch needs a mode that lets commands run.
  - In this step the fix agent runs in the foreground: the session waits for a round to finish, so no fire can start a second attempt and `inFlight` is not needed yet.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - No live run against a GitHub PR yet; the helpers are tested with real git and a mocked `gh`.
  - The reviewer watch (step 3's remaining item), the loop state of step 4 (background agent with `inFlight`, the remaining budgets, a later session taking a watch over) and the follow-ups of step 5.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new state fields are optional, and a state file from #15057's helpers reads as before.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.zh-CN.md). Both are updated in sync here: sections 6.4, 6.5, 6.8, 6.9 and the delivery notes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15056 (step 3 of its plan; the reviewer watch and step 4 remain). Follows #15057.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 #15057 已交付的探针之上，加上 `/autofix-pr` 的反应层（[设计文档](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.zh-CN.md)的交付第 3 步）。被盯住的 PR 现在可以通过四个新辅助命令和一个 bundled skill 完成修复、推送和回复：

- `qwen autofix-pr push <pr>`：
  - 只把 worktree 的提交作为已知 head 的快进推出去，并用 `--force-with-lease` 锁定这个 head。
  - pre-push hook 照常运行，不使用 `--force`。
  - 推送时向 GitHub 现查 PR 是否仍打开、目标是否为默认分支。
  - 推满 10 次即停。期间有人推送过时回答 `resync`，不会覆盖别人的提交。
- `qwen autofix-pr sync <pr>`：接纳别人推送的 head。
  - 干净的 worktree 直接快进。
  - worktree 里有未推送提交、而对方在已知 head 之上推送时，要求先合并（不用 rebase）。
  - 作者 rebase 或 force-push 改写了历史时，替换 worktree，在旧历史上做的未推送尝试报告为丢弃。
- `qwen autofix-pr reply <pr> <plan.json>`：发出一轮的 thread 回复和总结评论。
  - 发出任何内容之前，先对照重新读取的 PR 检查计划：回复只能发到此刻有可信作者新评论的 thread，不可信评论不能标记为已处理。
  - 每条正文末尾都带回复标记。
  - 每发出一条就立即记录 id，失败后用同一份计划重跑会跳过已发出的部分。
  - 计划还会记录这一轮留给人处理的失败检查和冲突。`--no-post` 只记录、不发帖。
- `qwen autofix-pr rerun <pr> <run-id>`：同一检查在同一 head 上最多重跑一次基础设施失败，再失败按真实失败处理。
- prepared 模式的 `snapshot` 现在会输出每个失败检查 attempt 的 `key`，并跳过之前轮次已处理的 attempt 和冲突。
- bundled skill `/autofix-pr` 把这些串起来：
  - 启动时确认一次推送目标和是否回复。
  - `--once` 只跑一轮。否则以会话内定时任务监视，闸门是 `snapshot --gate`，PR 安静时不消耗模型回合。
  - 每一轮在 PR worktree 里前台运行一个修复 agent，然后按 agent 的判断重跑 CI、推送、回复。
  - 另有 `stop` 和简单的 `status`。

文档：

- 设计文档中英文同步补上 `push`、`reply`、`sync`（6.8）、`rerun`（6.9）的契约和交付说明。
- 新增用户文档 `docs/users/features/autofix-pr.md`，commands 表格加了一行。
- `autofix-shared-skill.md` 加上范围说明：「不推送、不写 GitHub」针对的是作用于工作区的 `/autofix`；`/autofix-pr` 是另一条命令，每次启动经确认后才推送和回复。
- Web Shell 菜单显示该 skill 的中文描述。

## 为什么需要

#15056 要的是会话能对自己的 PR 作出反应——CI 失败、评审意见、冲突——而不是靠 `/loop` 轮询模型。触发层（#15069、#15211）和探针（#15057）都已合入，但还没有东西能处理它们报告的内容：没有安全的推送方式，无法接纳别人的推送，回复时可能回答自己的回复，重跑不稳定的 job 也可能陷入循环。本 PR 把这些写操作放到确定性的检查之后，并加上驱动它们的 skill。

## 验证方式

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/autofix-pr`。`push` 和 `sync` 的测试用真实 git 加本地 bare 远端，覆盖：
  - 别人推送导致 lease 被拒；
  - 拒绝非快进；
  - pre-push hook 失败；
  - 作者 force-push；
  - 未推送工作遇到在已知 head 之上的推送时要求合并。
- `reply` 和 `rerun` 只 mock 了 `gh` 和 PR 读取，覆盖：
  - 回复只有不可信评论或不存在的 thread 时什么都不发；
  - POST 失败后重试只补发缺的部分，第三次什么都不发；
  - `--no-post` 不发帖；
  - 同一 head 上第二次重跑同一检查被拒绝。
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills/bundled/autofix-pr` 用真实 PermissionManager 检查 skill 的授权：只放行 `gh pr view` 和 skill 自己的 `.qwen/tmp` 文件；`git push`、`gh pr comment`、`gh run rerun`、这些辅助命令本身，以及只是以允许命令开头的复合命令都不放行；`ask_user_question` 和 `cron_create` 仍然要过各自的对话框。

证据（head d70aa9ddb9）：

- `autofix-pr` 测试 148/148，skill 测试 3/3，core skill 测试 763 passed (`src/skills`)，Web Shell `localCommands` 11/11；
- cli 和 Web Shell 类型检查通过，eslint、prettier 通过。
- 逐个去掉 16 处防护的变异全部被测试拦下。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：
  - 命令以用户自己的身份推送和评论，上述检查都在辅助命令里，而不在提示词里。
  - skill 没有为辅助命令授予 shell 规则：权限匹配器用 shell-quote 分词，会把 `"${QWEN_CODE_CLI:-qwen}"` 读成空词，没有规则能只放行这些命令（这也是 `/review` 放行全部 shell 的原因）；而给读取不可信 PR 文本的 skill 在整个会话内放行全部 shell 风险更大。因此在默认审批模式下，每次调用辅助命令（包括推送）都会先询问，无人值守运行需要能直接执行命令的模式。
  - 这一步修复 agent 在前台运行：会话等一轮结束，不会有触发再启动第二次尝试，暂时不需要 `inFlight`。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - 还没在真实 GitHub PR 上运行过；辅助命令用真实 git 加 mock 的 `gh` 测试。
  - 评审者监视（第 3 步剩余项）、第 4 步的循环状态（后台 agent 加 `inFlight`、其余预算、之后的会话接管监视），以及第 5 步的后续工作。
- 破坏性变更：无。新增的状态字段都是可选的，#15057 辅助命令写的状态文件照常读取。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15056（其计划的第 3 步；评审者监视和第 4 步仍待完成）。接续 #15057。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): scope the sdk-java test lock to the cache write-back
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR moves the self-hosted SDK Java test lane's per-host lock off its Maven suites and onto the shared Maven cache write-back. The lane now seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache, runs the SDK and Managed Agent suites against that copy without the lock, and acquires the ticketed host lock only to publish the new artifacts back to the host cache. The write-back's children close the inherited lock descriptor, so a cancelled job's survivor cannot keep holding the lock.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent fast tier can fail before reporting a single test result when it waits out its 90-minute host-lock budget behind a long suite hold. The MariaDB integration lane already scoped its lock to the write-back, but the test lane still held the same lock across both of its Maven suites, so a roughly 90-minute full-tier Java 21 leg on the same host could starve the fast tier — the failure shape reported in #15262. With the suite unlocked, a hold measures the bounded cache copy instead of the suite, and the fast tier's wait budget is again far above one hold.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

A second fast-tier job on the same host should start Maven without waiting for the first job's suite to finish; it may wait only for the short write-back.

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): configure the assets host and branch once
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the publishing coordinates of a manual `/verify-pr <n> --publish` round configurable once. `settings.json` gains `verifyPr.assetsRepo` and `verifyPr.assetsBranch`; at startup they fill `QWEN_VERIFY_ASSETS_REPO` and `QWEN_VERIFY_ASSETS_BRANCH` when those are unset, so the skill keeps reading the variables it already documents and a one-off export still wins. The new `--assets-repo` flag sits at the top of the order, and the branch falls back to the repository's existing `assets/pr<n>-validation` convention, created when absent.

The settings are honored from the operator scopes only — User, System, SystemDefaults — and two mechanisms make that true rather than stated. `verifyPr` is a workspace-restricted root, so the merge strips a workspace value and the warnings channel reports it ignored. The two variables are also excluded from what a project `.env` or `settings.env` may supply: both are repository-controlled, and the environment loader applies them before this bridge, so without that exclusion a repository could set the variable itself and the configured value would never win. The existing `env` block could have supplied the same variables with no code at all, but it merges every scope including the workspace one, which is the hole these two pieces close. The daemon's settings route refuses these keys anyway — they are not exposed to workspace writes — so the protection does not depend on the route guard.

The skill text also states that a published filename is spent: raw.githubusercontent serves a URL from cache, so a republished image needs a new name and every reference has to move with it.

## Why it's needed

Every publish round still asked where the images go, even though the branch already resolved automatically. A coordinate that never changes between rounds should not be repeated in each invocation, and it should be configurable somewhere durable rather than in a shell profile that the daemon only reads at startup. At the same time the setting decides a write target, so it must not be something a repository can choose for its reviewer.

Design notes: [English](docs/design/verify-pr-assets-config.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/verify-pr-assets-config.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Set both keys at user scope, restart the session (the values are applied at startup), and confirm the two variables are present in the environment the shell tool sees. Then run `/verify-pr <n> --publish` on a small pull request and confirm the images land in the configured repository and branch with no `--assets-*` flag. Two negative cases matter as much: the same keys written in a workspace settings file must change nothing, and an exported variable must beat the configured value, including when the export is an empty string.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — configuration plumbing and skill text; there is no user-visible rendering to capture. Tests cover the resolver's states (unset, preset, empty export, blank value, trimming), the exclusion of both variables from project-controlled environment sources, and the sentence the skill promises.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux: static verification only. This checkout has no installed dependencies, so neither the new unit test nor the schema generator could be run locally. The generated JSON schema was updated by hand to match the generator's shape, and CI's "settings schema is up to date" step is the check that this matches.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — no runtime behavior beyond startup environment filling.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a value written in a workspace settings file has no effect — that is the intended protection, but a maintainer who puts it there sees defaults apply. The same rule closes `settings.env` at every scope, including User, because the merged map cannot tell the two apart; that entry now prints a line naming `verifyPr.*` instead of disappearing.
- Not validated / out of scope: none of the new tests and not the schema generator ran locally (no dependencies); CI covers both. The hand-edited generated schema is the one artifact whose parity with the generator is verified only by CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: an unset `verifyPr` changes nothing, and an exported variable keeps priority. One channel does close: an entry for either variable under `settings.env` is ignored at every scope, including User, and now says so on stderr. The merged map cannot distinguish a workspace entry from an operator one, so the rule is scope-blind by construction; `verifyPr.*`, the launch environment, and `~/.qwen/.env` remain the ways to set them.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 `/verify-pr <n> --publish` 的发布坐标变成"配置一次"。`settings.json` 新增 `verifyPr.assetsRepo` 与 `verifyPr.assetsBranch`；启动时若同名环境变量未设置，就把它们填入 `QWEN_VERIFY_ASSETS_REPO` / `QWEN_VERIFY_ASSETS_BRANCH`，因此 skill 继续读它已经文档化的变量，一次性的 export 仍然优先。新增的 `--assets-repo` flag 位于顺序最前，分支则回落到仓库既有的 `assets/pr<n>-validation` 约定，不存在时自动创建。

这两项只认 operator 作用域——User、System、SystemDefaults，而这是由两处机制保证的，不是只写在文档里。`verifyPr` 是 workspace 受限根：合并期剥离 workspace 值，告警通道报告其被忽略。两个变量同时被加入"项目 `.env` / `settings.env` 不得提供"的排除集：两者都由仓库控制，而环境加载器先于本桥接执行；不排除的话，仓库可以自己设置变量，让配置值永远不生效。现有的 `env` 块本可以在不改代码的情况下供出同样的变量，但它会合并所有作用域（含 workspace），这正是上述两点要补的洞。设置路由本就不把这些键暴露给 workspace 写入，所以保护并不依赖路由守卫。

skill 文本同时明确：已发布的文件名是一次性消耗品。raw.githubusercontent 按 URL 缓存，重发图片必须换新文件名，并同步更新所有引用。

## 为什么需要

每个发布轮次仍要确认图往哪推，而分支早已能自动解析。轮次之间从不变化的坐标不该每轮重述，也不该只能写进 shell profile——常驻 daemon 只在启动时读环境变量。与此同时这个设置决定的是一个写入目标，因此不能由被审仓库替维护者决定。

设计说明：[English](docs/design/verify-pr-assets-config.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/verify-pr-assets-config.zh-CN.md)。

## Reviewer Test Plan

在 user 作用域设好两项，重启会话（值在启动时应用），确认 shell 工具能看到这两个变量；然后对一个小 PR 跑 `/verify-pr <n> --publish`，确认图片进入配置的仓库与分支、且不需要任何 `--assets-*` flag。两个反向用例同样重要：同样的键写在 workspace 设置里必须毫无影响；已 export 的变量必须压过配置值，包括 export 为空字符串时。

### Evidence

N/A——配置管线与 skill 文案改动，没有用户可见的渲染可截图。测试覆盖解析器各状态（未设置、已预置、空 export、空白值、去空格）、两个变量被排除出项目可控的环境来源，以及 skill 承诺的那句话。

### Tested on

Linux：仅静态核对。该工作副本未安装依赖，新增单测与 schema 生成器都未能本地执行；生成的 JSON schema 由手工按生成器格式更新，与生成器的一致性依赖 CI 的 "settings schema is up to date" 步骤校验。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：写在 workspace 设置里的值不会生效——这是有意的保护，但写在那里会看到默认值生效；schema 描述、skill 文本与文档表格三处都写明了这一点。
- 未验证/超出范围：四个测试与 schema 生成器都未在本地运行（无依赖），由 CI 覆盖。手工更新的生成文件是唯一"一致性只由 CI 校验"的产物。
- 破坏性变更：`verifyPr` 未设置时行为不变，已 export 的变量保持优先。有一个通道确实关闭：通过 `settings.env` 设置这两个变量在任何作用域（含 User）都不再生效，现在会在 stderr 说明。合并后的 map 无法区分 workspace 条目与 operator 条目，因此这条规则按构造就是不区分作用域的；设置通道仍是 `verifyPr.*`、启动环境与 `~/.qwen/.env`。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: feat(verify-pr): configure the assets host and branch once (#15377)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(verify-pr): configure the assets host and branch once

A publish round still had to confirm where the images go, even though the
branch already resolved from a flag, a variable, then the repository's
assets/pr<n>-validation convention. The host is the last coordinate that had
to be repeated per round.

settings.json gains verifyPr.assetsRepo and verifyPr.assetsBranch. At
startup they fill QWEN_VERIFY_ASSETS_REPO and QWEN_VERIFY_ASSETS_BRANCH when
those are unset, so the skill keeps reading the variables it documents and a
one-off export still wins.

These values choose where a maintainer's evidence is published, so a cloned
repository must not be able to set them. Three paths are closed: verifyPr is a
workspace-restricted root (the merge strips it, the warnings channel reports
it ignored, and the daemon refuses a workspace write, including a nested
verifyPr.assetsRepo), and both variables are excluded from what a project
.env or settings.env may supply — the environment loader applies those before
the settings bridge, so without the exclusion a repository could set the
variable itself and the configured value would never win.

The skill also states that a published filename is spent: raw.githubusercontent
serves a URL from cache, so a republished image needs a new name and the body
and comments must move to it.

* fix(verify-pr): drop the unreachable guard and rewrap the settings table

Review found two mechanical blockers.

Prettier rejected the settings table: the two new rows were pasted with
padding that did not match the column widths, so Lint & Static failed before
"Generate settings schema" ran and the hand-edited schema was never checked.
Both rows are rewrapped against the table's own alignment; every other row is
byte-identical.

The daemon test asserted workspace_restricted_setting for verifyPr.assetsRepo,
but the route answers disallowed_key: the allowlist check runs first, and
verifyPr is not offered to workspace writes at all. That also made the new
root-segment branch unreachable for every restricted root today, so the guard
and its test are dropped. The merge strip and the env exclusion are what
protect the value.

The new shared-env-keys test also no longer separates the TLS trust-anchor
comment from the test it introduces.

* fix(verify-pr): warn on a rejected settings.env entry and name the branch call

Review R1-1: the hardcoded exclusion is key-based, so it also drops a
User-scope settings.env entry — a channel that worked before this PR, silently,
because reportRejectedSettingsEnv only reports loader-class keys. The rule
stays scope-blind: the merged env map cannot tell a workspace entry from an
operator one, and only the operator may choose a publishing target. It is no
longer silent: the rejection names verifyPr.* and the launch environment, and
an environment.test.ts case pins both the unset variable and the warning.

Review R1-2: the skill said the branch is "created when absent" while its only
upload was a contents PUT, which answers 422 Branch not found for a ref that
does not exist. The paragraph now names the GET ref / POST git/refs step (404
only) before the first upload, and the scripts assertion pins it.

The design doc and the PR description record the settings.env restriction, so
"breaking changes: none" is no longer claimed.

* test(cli): isolate the publishing-coordinate variables in environment tests

The new warning test asserts the variable stays unset, so the two names belong in TRACKED_ENV rather than depending on the runner's environment.

* docs(verify-pr): name the default-branch lookup the branch creation needs

Review R2-3: the creation step required "the default branch's head sha"
without saying where either comes from, and `default_branch` appeared nowhere
in the file. An executor would guess the PR checkout's origin/main, whose sha
need not exist in the assets repository — a fork behind upstream then answers
422 Object does not exist and every later upload fails after the round is
spent.

The paragraph now names both lookups (`.default_branch`, then `.object.sha`
of that repository) and the empty-repository 404, matching the in-repo
publisher. The scripts assertion pins `.object.sha` so the lookup cannot be
dropped again.

* fix(cli): fold case in the rejected-coordinate warning and read back from the assets repo

Review R2-1: the diagnostic looked the key up with its canonical spelling
while the gate folds case, so `qwen_verify_assets_branch` was dropped and never
reported — the silent loss this block exists to prevent. The lookup now folds
case and names the spelling that was actually written; the environment test
runs both spellings, and the lowercase case reds before this change.

Review R2-2: the post-upload read-back addressed `<owner>/<repo>`, which this
file uses for the PR repository, while the upload went to `<assets-repo>`. With
a fork as the image host the confirmation queried the wrong repository: a 404
over a correctly published file, or another blob's size and sha. It now reads
back from the repository it wrote to, and the scripts assertion pins the
placeholder.

* fix(cli): make the coordinate bridge refresh on reload and tighten its typing

Four of the deferred review items.

The bridge was add-only: a long-lived process kept the value it had written
even after the setting changed or disappeared, so the round published to the
old host. Writes are now tracked per environment object — a value this
function wrote is refreshed on change and removed when the settings drop it,
while an exported value is never touched. Three tests pin the three cases.

Both leaves used a bare `default: undefined`, so Settings['verifyPr'] inferred
as undefined; they now use the `as string | undefined` form the neighbouring
optional strings use.

The hardcoded project-exclusion list derives its two coordinate names from
VERIFY_PR_COORDINATE_ENV, so a third coordinate cannot be gated nowhere.

The workspace-restricted root membership is pinned by a test: deleting that
entry would let a cloned repository choose the publishing host, and nothing
noticed before.

prs.title: test(web-shell): stop pinning hero header wrap in token usage min-width check
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Relaxes the 1200px token-usage smoke check so the hero header is no longer required to wrap at minimum panel width. The two invariants that describe a healthy header remain pinned: the refresh metadata stays right aligned, and the header never overflows.

## Why it's needed

Whether the meta row still fits beside the value at minimum width depends on CJK glyph widths, which differ across runner images. On the hz ARM64 self-hosted pool the zh-CN header fits on one line, so `expect(alignment.wrapped).toBe(true)` fails there deterministically — 4 runs across 3 branches and 3 runner hosts (run 39997935888 on #15383, plus runs 40012238122, 40011998036 and 39978638324, the last one predating the ARM64 routing change, so the sensitivity is environmental rather than a product regression or a consequence of the reroute itself). The failure artifacts show the zh-CN header rendering correctly on a single line. The assertion was also stricter than the design it covers: #14648 describes the intent as keeping the refresh metadata right aligned *when* the header wraps, which is a conditional behavior, not a mandated layout.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This PR touches `packages/**`, so the web-shell E2E Smoke lane schedules onto the hz ARM64 pool — exactly the environment where the check failed four times. It should go green on this PR; that is the decisive verification. Locally, the 1200px light/dark en/zh-CN disclosure tests still pass with `npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts client/e2e/web-shell.token-usage.spec.ts --grep 1200px --project=chromium` from `packages/web-shell`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — assertion-only change in a browser E2E; no UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux verification is delegated to the ARM64 smoke lane on this PR, which reproduces the failing environment exactly.

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run dev` harness via Playwright.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: in an environment where the header genuinely fits on one line, a future regression that wrongly prevents wrapping would pass unnoticed; the right-alignment and no-overflow invariants still pin actual visual breakage.
- Not validated / out of scope: the intermittently failing `message actions use a hoverable menu` smoke test occasionally seen on the same pool is unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15364 · unblocks #15383

prs.title: feat: project agent identity and Agent Team delivery onto the ACP/daemon wire (refs #13785)
prs.body:
## What this PR does Projects agent identity and Agent Team coordination onto the ACP/daemon wire, in two deliberately distinct collaboration columns. Subagent column (parent→child delegation): every projected subagent frame (thought, message, tool call, tool call update) now carries `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }` with a path-style name (`/root/general-purpose`), mirroring OpenAI Responses' per-item `agent` identity; the Web Shell keeps that path on the subagent panel name as a `title` tooltip only — no visible path chip ships in this slice (`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`; pinned by `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip`). `agentName` is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent same-type subagents share it, and renaming the agent definition changes it. `parentToolCallId` distinguishes subagent executions; that boundary is documented on both the producer and the normalizer. Agent Team column (peer complete agents): an ACP-hosted session now attaches a leader sink (`team-sink.ts`). Before this, `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` returned before consuming on this host (teammate reports stayed unread in the leader inbox) and `TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` was void-emitted — the coordination never reached anyone. Now teammate reports are delivered as `peer` background notifications carrying structured sender identity (`kind: 'teammate'`, minted from the inbox entry's `from`, never parsed from message text), roster joins/exits are projected as peer notifications so an already-attached client can track membership transitions (there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect), and teammate tool approvals route to the client's `requestPermission` (fail-closed: Cancel plus a `` to the leader when the host cannot answer; YOLO auto-approve only when the request carries no renderable details). ## Why it's needed #13785 records the gap: the public vocabulary names child agents and teams, but nothing a client receives says which agent produced what. Both reference protocols (OpenAI Responses multi-agent, Anthropic Managed Agents) treat agent identity as contractual. This slice delivers the identity dimension on the daemon/ACP projection and removes the "ACP host has no leader sink" failure class — the zero-signal class among the three host classes in #13785 M4 — giving M1b a reference wire shape. Peer delivery reuses core's existing `'peer'` background-notification channel (idle wake, loss accounting, kind-agnostic drain/display), without a new peer runtime. Team-binding approval retirement now uses one private, versioned `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` notification on the existing SDK 0.14.1 connection; it adds no daemon REST route or public mediator API. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify At `3499b027c4faa`, 2,106 focused cases, targeted ESLint/Prettier, five affected workspace typechecks and integration typecheck passed on the exact committed candidate. Approval retirement, status identity, activity isolation and canonical START behavior were mutation-checked. A serialized ACP component probe verified old-binding cancellation and replacement approval at cap 1; a local macOS browser rendered the real transcript pipeline with injected protocol frames without splitting leader output or taking its usage. Main was synchronized to supply the current CI budget helper; obsolete assistant-activity handling was removed, and the rebuilt transcript's size ceiling was **raised** from 1,338,000 (main) to 1,340,000 in `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` — merged with main the entry measures 1,338,274 UTF-16 units, past both main's ceiling and the 1,338,500 this branch carried. See the [current repair report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587) for build results and verification limits. No real-provider or full daemon/browser E2E was run for this repair. The [real-model report and screenshots at `df760052100d1`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209) and the runtime observations below are historical evidence, not current-head acceptance. Real machine: boot the daemon from this branch with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`, create a session, send a team prompt (`team_create`, then spawn teammate `correctness` asking it to report one sentence ending in a marker). Expected and observed on SSE: peer notifications `teammate-roster-1` (status joined) and `teammate-message-2/3`, each carrying `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`, plus leader-reply frames with `source=background_notification_response`; the same capture contains zero subagent-column frames. Contrast run without a team: 47 `parentToolCallId`-chained frames carrying `kind:'subagent'` and zero peer markers — the two columns are mutually attributable at a glance. The Web Shell rendered the peer rows (`ⓘ … · peer`) and the verbatim teammate report in a real headless Chromium against the same daemon. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: on this host an ACP session with a team delivered 0 teammate reports (retained unread in the leader inbox) and emitted 0 approval signals; no projected object carried any agent identity. After: the SSE markers and browser rendering described above. ### Tested on (earlier runtime acceptance) | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux host; daemon via `node scripts/dev.js serve` (no bundle step); headless Chromium (playwright) for Web Shell rendering; unit suites via vitest with `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: identity is additive `_meta`; older readers ignore it. Teammate identity is minted only for single-sender batches — mixed-sender batches stay unattributed rather than misattributed. Status/idle team events are deliberately not projected (each would wake the leader into an automatic turn). Join/exit notifications are incremental, so a client that attaches late still needs a non-waking roster snapshot/query before it can claim authoritative current membership. - Not validated / out of scope: managed-agent public-contract projections (#13785 M1a/M2/M3) and client intervention verbs (M4) remain design surfaces; foreground nested subagents do not project their own frames today (verified on real machine: single `parentToolCallId` layer, depth values only 1), so depth ≥ 2 identity has no wire producer yet — nested trees remain record-projection work (M1a); cross-session teammate projection is M1b/M3. Mailbox consumption and model-visible delivery are not transactional; crash-safe redelivery after process/session destruction remains follow-up work, and reversible-close retention does not provide that guarantee. - Breaking changes / migration notes: identity fields are additive. Approval retirement requires this CLI/bridge pair; older bridges that ignore the new private notification retain the previous stale-approval behavior. No new daemon REST routes, public mediator APIs, dependencies or persisted formats. ## Linked Issues Refs #13785 (referenced without a closing keyword: the public-contract milestones remain open design work).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 把 agent 身份与 Agent Team 协调投影到 ACP/daemon 的 wire 上，分为刻意保持区分的两条协作列。 subagent 列（父子委派）：每个投影出的 subagent 帧（thought、message、tool call、tool call update）现在都带 `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }`，名字为 path 风格（`/root/general-purpose`），与 OpenAI Responses 的逐 item `agent` 身份同形；Web Shell 本片只把该 path 挂在 subagent 面板名字的 `title` tooltip 上，不渲染可见的 path chip（`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`；由 `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` 的 `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip` 钉住）。`agentName` 是可读的角色 path，并不是唯一执行 ID：同类型并发 subagent 会共享它，agent 定义改名也会改变它；`parentToolCallId` 用于区分 subagent 执行，这一边界在生产侧与 normalizer 两侧都有文档。 Agent Team 列（对等完整 agent）：ACP 托管会话现在会挂一个 leader sink（`team-sink.ts`）。在此之前，本宿主上 `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` 会在消费前早退（队员报告留在 leader inbox 里未读），`TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` 空 emit——协调过程到不了任何人手里。现在队员报告以 `peer` 背景通知投递，带结构化发送者身份（`kind: 'teammate'`，从 inbox 条目的 `from` 铸造，绝不从消息文本解析）；roster 的加入/退出投影为 peer 通知，已挂载的客户端可跟踪成员变化（晚挂载或重连时没有当前状态快照）；队员的工具审批路由到客户端 `requestPermission`（fail-closed：宿主无法应答时 Cancel 并向 leader 注入 ``；仅当请求不带可渲染细节且处于 YOLO 时才自动批准）。 ## 为什么需要 #13785 记录了缺口：公共词表里有 child agent 与 team，但客户端收到的任何东西都不说明「哪条输出是哪个 agent 产的」。两个参照协议（OpenAI Responses multi-agent、Anthropic Managed Agents）都把 agent 身份当契约内容。本片在 daemon/ACP 投影侧交付身份维度，并消掉「ACP 宿主没有 leader sink」这一失效类——即 #13785 M4 三类宿主中的零信号类——为 M1b 给出参考 wire 形状。peer 投递复用 core 既有的 `'peer'` 背景通知通道（空闲唤醒、丢失记账、kind 无关的 drain/display），不增加 peer runtime。队绑定审批回收新增一条私有、版本化的 `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` 通知，走既有 SDK 0.14.1 连接；不添加 daemon REST 路由或 public mediator API。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 `3499b027c4faa` 的精确提交候选通过 2,106 条聚焦用例、定向 ESLint/Prettier、五个相关 workspace 的类型检查和 integration 类型检查；审批回收、status 身份、活动隔离与 START canonical 行为做过变异反证。真实 ACP 串行化组件链路以 cap 1 验证旧绑定取消和新绑定审批；本地 macOS 浏览器通过真实 transcript 流水线渲染注入的协议帧，leader 答案与 usage 未被活动切断或夺走。已同步 main 补齐当前 CI 预算脚本，并删除旧 assistant 活动路径；重建 transcript 的体积阈值是**上调**的——由 main 的 1,338,000 提到 `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` 里的 1,340,000，因为与 main 合并后该 entry 实测 1,338,274 UTF-16 单位，同时超出 main 的阈值和本分支此前携带的 1,338,500。构建结果与验证限制见[本轮修复报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587)。本轮未跑真实模型或完整 daemon/browser E2E。[`df760052100d1` 的真实模型报告与截图](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209)及下方真机记录仅为历史证据，不作为当前 head 验收。 真机：从本分支起 daemon（`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`），建会话，发 team prompt（`team_create`，再派 teammate `correctness` 要求其回一句以 marker 结尾的话）。SSE 上期望并实测到：peer 通知 `teammate-roster-1`（status joined）与 `teammate-message-2/3`，均带 `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`，以及 `source=background_notification_response` 的 leader 回话帧；同一抓帧中 subagent 列帧为零。不带 team 的对照跑：47 帧 `parentToolCallId` 链帧带 `kind:'subagent'`、peer 标记零命中——两列形状互斥、可一眼归因。Web Shell 在真 headless Chromium 中对同一 daemon 渲染出了 peer 行（`ⓘ … · peer`）与队员原话。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before：本宿主上带 team 的 ACP 会话投递 0 条队员报告（留在 leader inbox 未读）、0 个审批信号；任何投影对象都不带 agent 身份。After：上述 SSE 标记与浏览器渲染。 ### Tested on（较早版本的真机验收） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 | ### 环境（可选） Linux 宿主机；daemon 走 `node scripts/dev.js serve`（无 bundle 步骤）；Web Shell 渲染用 headless Chromium（playwright）；单测走 vitest 并加 `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：身份是 additive `_meta`，旧读者会忽略它。teammate 身份只为单发送者批次铸造——混合发送者批次宁可无身份也不张冠李戴。status/idle 队事件刻意不投影（每条都会唤醒 leader 起一个自动 turn）。加入/退出通知是增量流，晚挂载客户端仍需要一个不会唤醒 leader 的 roster 快照/查询，才能声称拿到了权威当前成员表。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：managed-agent 公共契约投影（#13785 M1a/M2/M3）与客户端干预动词（M4）仍是设计面；foreground 嵌套 subagent 今天不投影自身帧（真机验过：parentToolCallId 仅一层、depth 取值仅 1），故 depth ≥ 2 身份暂无 wire 生产者——嵌套树仍是记录投影工作（M1a）；跨 session 的 teammate 投影属 M1b/M3。mailbox 消费与模型可见投递不是事务；进程崩溃或会话销毁后的安全重投递留到后续，可逆 close 时保留队列不构成这一保证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：身份字段为 additive。审批回收需要本轮配套 CLI/bridge；忽略新增私有通知的旧 bridge 仍保留此前的陈旧审批行为。不添加 daemon REST 路由、public mediator API、依赖或持久化格式。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #13785（不用 closing 关键字引用：公共契约里程碑仍是开放的设计工作）。

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(rewind): resolve legacy turns by source identity
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Conversation rewind associates the visible user message, model-history anchor and recorded boundary by a unique source identity, or refuses before mutation. Legacy records can recover a conversation-only identity from their existing record UUID; that key cannot authorize file restore. Retry, resume, compression sidecars and JSON history rollback preserve the association.

The live Ink selector omits identity-less targets. ACP keeps raw file-snapshot positions, while daemon-backed Web Shell, VS Code and SDK consumers use the existing admitted prompt identity to select and apply a rewind. A retry can create a gap in raw positions; neither the displayed ordinal nor the rank in a filtered catalog is an identity. Admission reuses the existing optimistic-message binding, including a failed submission retried without appending another row.

## Why it's needed

A legacy placeholder-shaped prompt could disappear from the visible transcript while remaining in model context. Independent position counting also misaligned recorder boundaries when a retry added a snapshot without adding a user turn. The retained ACP producer exposed that gap to clients: after A failed and was retried, editing B could report no snapshot; with another turn C, ordinal matching could select B instead of C.

This follows #9437. Stable identified-turn support in #9466 and retained-snapshot counter seeding in #13729 are already merged and are not reimplemented here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resume `hello`, `[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`, `world` and their replies. Rewind the second prompt: the visible and next-request histories should retain only `hello` and its reply. A recovered record key must not restore files.
- Fail A, retry it successfully, then submit B. Edit B and resend: A remains, the original B/reply disappear and the edited B appears once. Repeat with chat recording disabled.
- After the same retry, submit B and C, then edit C: B must remain in the next model request. The raw catalog can be `[0,2,3]`; the selected target must still be C.
- Cancel a new prompt before output: return its text to the composer and remove only its own turn when the daemon confirms the association. Missing or duplicate identity must not fall back to another turn.
- Check a retained target after a compressed prefix, a tool-loop cancellation and a JSON history echo. A continuation belongs to its turn but is not a second prompt anchor. Unique source associations resolve; missing or duplicated associations refuse before mutation. Rewind metadata must not reach the model.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The [current local runtime report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6311356723) covers delivered `f2002a5864`: two baseline reproductions and seven passing candidate runs, recording on/off, real daemon/ACP/SDK, actual provider-request receipts and matched captures. It compares the current review repair, not the whole PR against original main. Earlier reports remain historical and are not relabeled as evidence for this revision.

Local focused checks: build, typecheck, changed-file lint/format, and 963 tests across the relevant core, CLI, ACP bridge, SDK, Web Shell and VS Code cases passed. This is not a full-suite run. The previously reported local AppContainer/jsdom limitation did not recur with the synchronized dependencies: the selected rewind cases passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ focused checks and real local daemon/browser verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.22.3, isolated checkout and profiles, actual source CLI/ACP daemon with repository Web Shell and SDK source. The model boundary is a deterministic loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, not a real model. Provider request receipts, HTTP/SSE, DOM, screenshots and owned-process cleanup are retained locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Identity-less or ambiguous legacy history deliberately refuses conversation rewind rather than guessing. File restore still requires a real file-snapshot identity. Legacy numeric rewind notifications retain their old interpretation for older senders.
- Daemon client changes are included only to complete the retained producer contract and remove the demonstrated wrong-target regression. No new daemon route, persisted schema, identity counter, setting or dependency. The old proposed local binding event is not added; existing admission binding is reused.
- Native model-driven compression, Windows/Linux runtime behavior, actual VS Code host execution and changed-file byte restoration were not exercised in this local UI run. Compressed-prefix and embedded-client behavior have focused regression tests.
- Remaining unrelated Suggestions stay in #13869. #13794 stays deferred; the unwired OpenTUI selector and broader cleanup are not part of this repair. No full test suite, passive CI wait, approval or merge is performed.

prs.body:
> **Merge readiness (2026-10-23)** — current head **`10955836eb`**, `mergeable: MERGEABLE`, and the only remaining step is **one re-approval** (the two 10-17 approvals were dismissed automatically by the head change described below).
>
> - Head `10955836eb` = `4f52d9435f` + a **merge of `main` (`623cb40cf5`)** to clear the `CONFLICTING` state. No rebase, no force-push, and **no code change beyond two text-conflict resolutions**: `docs/users/features/channels/overview.md` (option table) and `packages/channels/wecom/src/WeComAdapter.ts` (import block). Why a merge rather than a rebase: the repository squash-merges PRs (e.g. #14343 landed as single-parent `a6ab061fe5`), so branch-internal merge commits never enter `main` history.
> - Verified at this head: qqbot **707/707** (media 26 / cron 36 / stream 279 / send 175 / events 133 / persistence 30 / api 28), WeCom **147/147**, `tsc`/Prettier/ESLint clean, no conflict markers; 18 of the 20 net-diff files are byte-identical to git's automatic merge ([details](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13882#issuecomment-6295780024)).
> - **One hunk worth a manual glance**: the `WeComAdapter.ts` import block — the two sides interleave `splitMarkdown` chunking (#14043) and `singleScopeRoutingKey` routing (this PR) in the same file, so that resolution is test-verified but not provably identical to either automatic merge side.
> - Why this is one PR (CONTRIBUTING §2, >2,000 changed lines): `QQChannel.ts` is a single session-routing rewrite, and the four mirrored suites (`cron` / `events` / `send` / `stream`) exercise the same scenario matrix; splitting would duplicate the fixtures and leave the tree in a state with mixed routing semantics.
> - Prior review rounds: round-4 verification by @wenshao (2,700 assertions, 0 failures) and an independent Critical-only pass by @qqqys. The automated reviewer times out at its full 360-minute budget on this PR (it did on the previous head as well), so it does not produce a verdict by itself.

---

> **Historical update (round 5)** — head `87a6b5ff76fcb521ab8026b33c5c67aadf4d0281` at that time: **2 commits** on top of `bc534b3adf` (`f8dff632bb`, `87a6b5ff76`), touching only `packages/channels/qqbot/src/QQChannel.ts` (+59/−17), `cron.test.ts` (+306/−0) and `stream.test.ts` (+39/−0). The failure-exit P2 raised by @wenshao and independently confirmed by @qqqys is fixed there, with 9 new regression cases; see the [review reply](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13882#issuecomment-6220957169) for the per-exit behaviour, the mutation evidence, and the residuals that are disclosed rather than fixed. `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` shows as failing only because the job was **cancelled at 29m07s** (fork lane cap), not because a test failed.

> **Migrated from #13250 on 2026-10-11 — identical code, identical head SHA.**
>
> `#13250` was stuck on a GitHub-side artifact, not a code problem: an invisible `CHANGES_REQUESTED` left behind by the now-deleted `qwen-code-ci-bot` account. That PR reports `reviews: 0`, `reviewThreads: 0` and zero review comments, its timeline contains no `reviewed` / `review_dismissed` event, and the account itself returns 404 — yet `reviewDecision` stayed `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, and because the `main` ruleset sets `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push: false`, 90+ pushes never cleared it. A review that no longer exists cannot be dismissed by the author.
>
> Everything else on `#13250` was healthy: content CI was green (25 pass / 7 skipped; the only three failures were `CI_BOT_PAT` 403s from that suspended account), the branch was conflict-free against `main`, and the `main` ruleset declares no required status checks.
>
> This PR carries the **same commit** — `0851c08947d57c9323da7f518cbaafe3723ac5a3` — re-pointed through a new fork branch so it can start from a clean review state. Nothing was rebased, squashed or changed in the move, so the maintainer round-4 verification (`merge-ready` on correctness, 2554/2554 scripted assertions, head `0851c08947` against base `43a6e1e5e4`) still refers to exactly this code.

## What this PR does

Restores per-group session isolation for the QQ Bot channel. Removes the forced `sessionScope: 'single'` override that the constructor applied to its own copy of the config whenever `groupAllPolicy` was `keyword` or `all` (introduced during PR #6457 review); the channel now respects the configured scope and warns when a non-shared scope is combined with full-message group mode. Reply streaming keeps a per-session anchor and carries it across seal and cancel boundaries, so a cancelled or superseded turn still flushes against its own `msg_id` (per-message wire anchoring itself landed on `main` in #10145; what this change owns is the boundary machinery around it). Orphaned persisted routing entries from the old single-scope layout are purged on startup, and the QQ channel now declares `thread` as its default session scope so zero-config deployments get per-group shared context by default.

## Supersedes #8241

This is the same change as #8241, carried to a fresh PR after 22 review rounds and 83 blocker-signalling threads. The pipeline's own reports said each round re-read the entire diff (its incremental anchor was lost), so rounds spent their budget re-deriving earlier findings and the thread never converged; the newest round posted zero new findings, and every Critical posted across all rounds is fixed here with a pinning test and a mutation proof. No code changed in the move.

The branch is merged up to `main` at `1a933f7b5e`, which includes the QQ Bot inbound-media PR (#12850) that landed while #8241 was open. The only conflict was an additive stub in a test double in `events.test.ts` (`getResponseMessageId` from this change, `prepareThenHandleInbound` from the media work); both were kept. The package's suite is 692 tests green at this head — the merge base `543f03e5b1` runs 357, so this change adds 335 tests to that baseline (the 41 the inbound-media PR brought are included in those 357). On the previous head, `Qwen Code CI` was fully green, including `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`, which had been red for every head since round 18 over `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` (#10490), a host-gate flake that `main` fixed in #13094 and that merging `main` cleared.

## Why it's needed

The forced scope never reached the router. `start.ts` and `daemon-worker.ts` call `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)` with the *parsed* config, before `QQChannel`'s constructor rewrites its own copy — so the override changed what `QQChannel` believed, not how sessions were actually routed. That split brain produced two defects on `main`:

1. **Full-message group mode never actually got shared group context.** Routing stayed `user`-scoped, so group traffic was fragmented into one session per sender — the opposite of what the override existed to guarantee.
2. **`QQChannel` still believed it was `single`**, so every `sessionScope === 'single'` gate inside it fired against user-scoped routing — for example, a DM was treated as a shared session and `/clear` demanded an extra `confirm`.

The "everything collapsed into one `__single__` session, with context leaking across groups and into DMs" symptom is real, but it requires `sessionScope: "single"` to be set explicitly — which is what the docs recommended for `groupAllPolicy` users. The `replyMsgId` concurrency issue that motivated the override was never actually resolved by it, only hidden.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the unit suite: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 8 files, 692 tests pass (357 at the merge base `543f03e5b1`, so this change adds 335; the inbound-media work's 41 are already inside those 357).
- Config-level behavior: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and no explicit `sessionScope`, the channel must not emit the scope-forcing WARNING and must route group messages per group (`<channel>:<group_openid>`) and DMs per user (`<channel>:<user_openid>`).
- Concurrent streaming: two users messaging in the same group while the bot is mid-stream must keep their replies anchored to their own `msg_id` (no cross-threading) — covered by the new stream tests.
- Cancel behavior: interrupting a turn (`/cancel` or steer) must flush the buffered partial reply before tearing down stream state — partial output is not dropped (regression test pins this).
- The streaming-ownership invariants the review rounds converged on have their own acceptance block: a settling flush chain must not write shared per-session state once the session was torn down or the turn was superseded (`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal routing/session behavior, no user-visible UI change. Before: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"`, group traffic was fragmented per sender while `QQChannel` believed it was running one shared session. After: per-group shared sessions with cross-group isolation, and the channel's belief matches the router.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 692 passed; `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` (in the package) — clean; `eslint` on changed source — clean; `prettier --check` — clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Beyond the QQ channel this diff also touches two shared surfaces, both of which were needed to make the scope default usable: `parseChannelConfig` and the daemon's channel-settings store now share one `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)` helper, so saving a `multiSession` channel without a stored scope resolves `"user"` instead of tripping `ChannelBase`'s construction-time invariant; and the Web Shell channel editor no longer pre-fills a plugin's non-`user` default for a `multiSession` instance, which otherwise made that save fail (`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`). An explicitly stored or submitted non-`user` scope on a `multiSession` channel is still rejected.
- Main risk or tradeoff: the effective session scope for any QQ deployment that omitted `sessionScope` changes from the global `user` default to this plugin's `thread` default (`config-utils.ts` fills `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'`). This applies to **every** such config — not just `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` users — including plain `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` deployments, which go from per-sender contexts to per-group shared context. The tradeoff is deliberate (per-group context is what full-message group mode was always supposed to mean), and `sessionScope: "user"` restores the old behaviour per deployment.
- Not validated / out of scope: live end-to-end verification needs real QQ credentials and was not run in CI; macOS and Windows were not exercised in CI (Linux lanes only).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no config-format change. A group thread session is a shared session, so the commands that act on it (`/clear`, `/who`, `/status`, `/loop`, `/btw`) and the permission answers (`/approve`, `/approve-always`, `/deny`) are restricted to the members listed in the channel's `operators` (`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` reads only `operators`; `allowedUsers` and `senderPolicy` do not grant them). `operators` is unset by default, so a zero-config QQ group has no member who can run those commands and no one who can answer a permission request raised in it; set `operators` to the QQ user ids that should steer the group's session — the channel now warns at startup when group access is enabled on a shared scope with `operators` empty. Measured consequence of leaving it unset: a tool call that needs approval has no one who can answer it, so the requester and every other member are refused, the tool never runs, and the group's session is held by that pending prompt until `AcpBridge` times it out (300 s) — `/cancel` queues behind it too. Deployments that never show a permission prompt (for example `yolo`) are unaffected. (`!` host-shell stays disabled in every QQ group chat regardless of scope.) On startup the channel reports unroutable persisted routes: the `<channel>:__single__` entries left over from the forced single-scope era, and — whenever the effective scope is not `user` — this channel's own three-part `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` keys, which under `thread`/`chat_thread` can never resolve again and count against the bridge's per-workspace session cap on every restart. Deleting them is opt-in: with `purgeLegacySessions` unset (its default, `false`) the channel logs the count and removes nothing; with `purgeLegacySessions: true` it writes a rescue copy of the routes about to be removed (`qq-sessions-purged.json`) before the first deletion, so a legacy conversation can be rebuilt by hand. History behind them is not migrated in either mode (it cannot be split per group). Ownership is decided by each entry's recorded target channel, never by key prefix, so a sibling channel's routes are untouched, and the purge runs after restore so the first boot still re-attaches the entries once before releasing them. Cancelled turns now flush their buffered partial reply before the stream state is torn down, so partial output is no longer lost. Release note: the effective default session scope for QQ deployments that omit `sessionScope` changes from `user` to `thread`; group sessions are shared sessions, so `operators` must be configured for members to answer permission prompts or run session-control commands; the legacy-route purge is opt-in and removes nothing by default.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8238

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

修复 QQ Bot channel 的会话隔离：删除 `groupAllPolicy=keyword/all` 时构造器对自己那份配置强制写入 `sessionScope='single'` 的逻辑（PR #6457 review 期间引入），改为尊重配置，并在"非共享 scope + 全量群消息模式"组合下发出 WARNING。流式回复按 session 锚定 `msg_id`，同群并发用户不再互相串线。启动时清理旧的 single-scope 布局遗留的、已无法解析的持久化路由条目；QQ channel 声明默认 `sessionScope` 为 `thread`，零配置部署默认获得"每群共享上下文"。

## 承接 #8241

与 #8241 是同一份改动，迁移到新 PR：原线程已经历 22 轮评审、累计 83 个未决阻塞线程，而流水线自己的报告说明每轮都在重读整个 diff（增量锚点丢失），预算被用于反复重推既有发现，始终没有收敛；最新一轮已零新发现，而历轮提出的所有 Critical 在本树中均已修复，每一条都有固定行为的测试与变异证明。迁移过程未改动任何代码。

分支已与 `main`（`1a933f7b5e`）合并，其中包含 #8241 还开着时合入的 QQ Bot 入站媒体 PR（#12850）。唯一的冲突是 `events.test.ts` 里测试替身上的一处新增（本改动的 `getResponseMessageId` 与媒体改动的 `prepareThenHandleInbound`），两侧都保留。合并后该包 692 个测试全绿 —— merge base `543f03e5b1` 为 357，故本改动相对该基线新增 335 个（媒体 PR 带入的 41 个已含在这 357 内）。上一个 head 上 `Qwen Code CI` 已全绿，包括 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`：它自第 18 轮起一直红，原因是 `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts`（#10490）的 runner 门禁，`main` 已在 #13094 修复，合并 `main` 后即转绿。

## 为什么需要它

强制 scope 从未真正传到 router。`start.ts` 与 `daemon-worker.ts` 用**解析后的**配置调用 `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)`，而 `QQChannel` 的构造器只是改写了自己那份副本 —— 于是这个强制改变的是 `QQChannel` 的认知，而不是真实路由。这一"两个真相"在 `main` 上产生两个缺陷：

1. **全量群消息模式从未真正获得共享群上下文。** 路由仍是 `user` scope，群消息按发送者碎片化 —— 与该强制想要保证的完全相反。
2. **`QQChannel` 自认为 `single`**，于是它内部所有 `sessionScope === 'single'` 判定都作用在 user 路由上 —— 例如私聊被当成共享会话，`/clear` 会多要一次 `confirm`。

"所有群/私聊折叠进一个 `__single__` 会话、上下文互相泄漏"这个现象确实存在，但前提是显式设置 `sessionScope: "single"`（文档当时正是这样向 `groupAllPolicy` 用户推荐的）。当年为掩盖 `replyMsgId` 并发问题而引入的强制从未真正解决该问题，只是把它藏了起来。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 跑单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 8 个文件、692 个测试通过（merge base `543f03e5b1` 为 357，故相对该基线新增 335 个）。
- 配置层行为：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 且未显式设置 `sessionScope` 时，不得出现"强制 scope"的 WARNING，且群消息按群路由（`<channel>:<group_openid>`）、私聊按用户路由（`<channel>:<user_openid>`）。
- 并发流式：同群两个用户在 bot 流式输出期间发消息，各自回复必须锚定到自己的 `msg_id`（不串线）—— 由新增 stream 测试覆盖。
- 取消行为：中断一个 turn（`/cancel` 或 steer）必须先 flush 已缓冲的部分回复再清理流状态 —— 部分输出不丢（有回归测试固定）。
- 各轮评审收敛出的流式归属不变量有独立验收块：会话已被拆除或 turn 已被后继取代后，正在收尾的 flush 链不得再写共享的 per-session 状态（`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`）。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 属内部路由/会话行为，无用户可见的 TUI 变化。改动前：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 下群消息按发送者碎片化，而 `QQChannel` 自认为在跑一个共享会话。改动后：每群共享会话且跨群隔离，channel 的认知与 router 一致。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 692 通过；包内 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` —— clean；改动源码 `eslint` —— clean；`prettier --check` —— clean。

## 风险与范围

- 除 QQ channel 外，本 diff 还触及两个共享面，都是让新的 scope 默认值可用所必需的：`parseChannelConfig` 与 daemon 的 channel-settings store 现共用同一个 `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)`，因此保存一个未存 `sessionScope` 的 `multiSession` channel 会解析为 `"user"`，不再触发 `ChannelBase` 的构造期不变量；Web Shell 的 channel 编辑器也不再为 `multiSession` 实例预填插件的非 `user` 默认值（此前会使保存失败：`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`）。显式存储或提交的非 `user` scope 在 `multiSession` channel 上仍会被拒绝。
- 主要风险或取舍：任何省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效 scope 会从全局默认 `user` 变为本插件的 `thread` 默认（`config-utils.ts` 按 `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'` 填充）。这适用于**所有**这类配置 —— 不只是 `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` 用户 —— 也包括普通的 `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` 部署，它们会从"按发送者独立上下文"变为"按群共享上下文"。这个取舍是有意的（全量群消息模式本就应当意味着每群上下文），需要旧行为时按部署设置 `sessionScope: "user"` 即可。
- 未验证或超出范围：真实端到端验证需要真实 QQ 凭据，CI 未跑；CI 只在 Linux 通道跑，macOS 与 Windows 未覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：配置格式无变化。群聊线程是共享会话，因此作用于该会话的命令（`/clear`、`/who`、`/status`、`/loop`、`/btw`）与权限应答（`/approve`、`/approve-always`、`/deny`）仅限 `operators` 中列出的成员（`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` 只读 `operators`；`allowedUsers` 与 `senderPolicy` 不授予这些权限）。`operators` 默认未设置，因此零配置 QQ 群里没有任何成员可执行这些命令，群内发起的权限请求也无人可应答；需要时请把应当操作该群会话的 QQ 用户 id 填入 `operators` —— 群访问开启而共享 scope 下 `operators` 为空时，channel 现会在启动时告警。实测后果：一旦有工具调用需要审批，群里没有人能应答该请求（提问者本人与所有成员都会被拒），工具不会执行，且该待审批提示会占住群的会话，直到 `AcpBridge` 超时（300 秒）才释放 —— `/cancel` 同样会被排队。从不弹出权限提示的部署（例如 `yolo`）不受影响。（`!` 主机 shell 在所有 QQ 群聊中一律禁用，与 scope 无关。）启动时会检查无法解析的持久化路由：强制 single-scope 时代遗留的 `<channel>:__single__` 条目，以及生效 scope 非 `user` 时本 channel 自己的三段式 `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` 键 —— 在 `thread`/`chat_thread` 下它们永远无法再解析，且每次重启都会占用 bridge 的 per-workspace 会话上限。删除是可选开启的：`purgeLegacySessions` 未设置（默认 `false`）时只打印计数、不删除任何内容；设为 `true` 时会在首次删除前先把待删路由写入救援副本（`qq-sessions-purged.json`），以便手工恢复。无论哪种模式，其历史都不做迁移（无法按群拆分）。归属按条目记录的 target channel 判定，不按键前缀，因此不会误伤兄弟 channel 的路由；清理发生在 restore 之后，首次启动仍会先重新挂载一次再释放。取消的 turn 现在会先 flush 缓冲的部分回复再拆流状态，部分输出不再丢失。发布说明：省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效默认 scope 从 `user` 变为 `thread`；群会话即共享会话，成员需被列入 `operators` 才能应答权限请求或执行会话控制命令。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #8238

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): scope the sdk-java test job lock to the cache write-back (#15278)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted Java test job now resolves Maven dependencies from a job-local repository seeded from the host cache, runs the sdk-java and managed-agent suites without the per-host lock, and takes that lock only for the optional cache write-back. A write-back lock that cannot be acquired within its budget now warns and skips the copy instead of failing a step whose suite already passed; the same rule applies to the MariaDB integration lane's write-back.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent gate failed on main commit `6fb149d6d8fd` before any Java test ran. Both attempts of the fast-tier job were head of the sdk-java host-lock queue and waited the full 5400 s — tickets 239 and 257, on two different hosts — and the annotations name `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`. The test job held the lock across the 925 s suite, so a long sibling hold starved the fast tier and the gate then failed with the suite. The lock queue is shared across the ECS pool, so raising the wait again would only lower the probability.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Inspect the two lock-bearing steps: every Maven command is above the acquisition; the step seeds `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` with `cp -aln` and passes `-Dmaven.repo.local`; the write-back follows the suite and closes fd 9 on its children.
- Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. The new skip tests fail if either best-effort guard or either bare-lock fallback assignment is removed.
- On the ECS pool, a fast-tier job should start Maven immediately; a busy or stale host lock should only produce `Maven cache write-back skipped`, with the job green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 257 (fast)` — no Maven ran. After (pinned by tests): the suite runs unlocked from the job-local repository; a failed write-back acquisition logs `Maven cache write-back skipped` and exits 0. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox with Node 22. No Java/MySQL toolchain is available, so the ECS pool path is pending CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the seed adds a hardlink copy to each self-hosted leg; the MariaDB lane already uses the same pattern. Under contention the write-back can be skipped, so the next job re-resolves some artifacts.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS host-lock queue and the Java/MySQL suites; no Java toolchain here, so CI is the final gate. The 5400 s budget and the `lock not acquired within` substring are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) and [中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15278

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

自托管的 Java 测试 job 现在从宿主机缓存播种的 job 本地仓库解析 Maven 依赖，在不再持有每主机锁的情况下运行 sdk-java 和 managed-agent 套件，仅在可选的缓存写回时取锁。写回时预算内拿不到锁的，现在只记录警告并跳过复制，而不是让套件已经通过的 step 失败；MariaDB 集成通道的写回也适用同一规则。

## 为什么需要

Managed Agent gate 在 main 的 `6fb149d6d8fd` 上、任何 Java 测试运行之前就失败了。fast 档 job 的两次尝试都作为 sdk-java 宿主锁队列的队首等满了 5400 秒 —— 票据 239 和 257，位于两台不同主机 —— 注解写的是 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`。测试 job 把锁持在 925 秒的套件之上，因此某个很长的兄弟持锁饿死了 fast 档，随后 gate 因 suite 失败。锁队列在整个 ECS 池上共享，所以再次提高等待预算只会降低概率。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 检查两个取锁 step：所有 Maven 命令都在取锁之前；step 用 `cp -aln` 播种 `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` 并传入 `-Dmaven.repo.local`；写回在套件之后，且其子进程关闭 fd 9。
- 运行 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`。删除任一尽力而为保护或任一裸锁回退赋值，新增的跳过测试就会失败。
- 在 ECS 池上，fast 档 job 应立即启动 Maven；繁忙或过期的宿主锁只应产生 `Maven cache write-back skipped`，job 保持绿色。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：`sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 257 (fast)` —— Maven 没有运行。After（由测试钉住）：套件从 job 本地仓库无锁运行；写回取锁失败时记录 `Maven cache write-back skipped` 并以 0 退出。UI 变更：N/A。

### 测试平台

|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 沙箱，Node 22。没有 Java/MySQL 工具链，因此 ECS 池路径待 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：播种会给每个自托管 leg 增加一次硬链接复制；MariaDB 通道已经在使用同一模式。竞争下写回可能被跳过，下一个 job 需要重新解析部分依赖。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 宿主锁队列和 Java/MySQL 套件；本环境没有 Java 工具链，因此 CI 是最终 gate。5400 秒预算和 `lock not acquired within` 子串保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) 和 [中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15278
