prs.title: feat(web-shell): create workspaces from a Git URL
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Git repository source to the Web Shell Add-workspace dialog. A user can paste a clone URL, choose a new target directory, watch clone progress, cancel it, and land in the cloned workspace without leaving the browser.

The daemon performs the clone as an asynchronous job, so a long clone does not exceed the client's mutation budget and remains observable. A successful clone is registered through the existing workspace route, which keeps capacity, nesting, persistence, and the daemon's trust policy in one place.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-git-clone-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-git-clone-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

Before this change the dialog could only register a directory that already existed on the daemon host or create an empty directory. Starting from a repository meant leaving the browser, cloning in a terminal on that machine, and registering the path afterwards. On a remote daemon that detour is the main usability gap in workspace creation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a daemon from this branch on a host with `git`, open the Web Shell, and open Add Workspace. A source selector should offer "Existing directory" and "Git repository"; a daemon without `git` or without dynamic registration should not offer the Git source.
2. Choose "Git repository", enter a repository URL the host can reach, and enter an absolute target path whose parent exists and whose final component does not. Submit and confirm the progress panel advances, the dialog closes after success, and the workspace opens with the repository content.
3. Start another clone and cancel it. The progress panel should return to a terminal cancelled state and the target directory should not remain.
4. Try an existing target, a relative target, and an `ext::` URL. Each should fail with a clear error and leave no new directory.
5. Confirm a successful clone appears in the workspace list like any manually registered directory. Trust is whatever the daemon's folder-trust policy assigns; the clone path does not grant trust.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — the Add-workspace dialog only offers a directory path:

![Before: directory-only Add Workspace dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-before.png)

After — choose the Git repository source and fill the URL and target:

![After: Git repository source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-source.png)

After — pick the clone parent from folder suggestions:

![After: clone target suggestions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-suggestions.png)

After — clone progress with cancel:

![After: clone progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-progress.png)

The progress capture holds a running job at 42% so the transient panel stays visible.

The screenshots come from the real Web Shell served by a local build; the base capture uses the installed 0.26.0 daemon. The daemon flow was also verified end to end against a real local bare repository: capability advertisement, 202 job creation, progress to 100%, cloned content, registration, and the `target_nested`, `target_exists`, `invalid_url`, and `invalid_target` rejections.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local build (`npm run build` plus the CLI package build with a 6 GB heap), daemon started from `packages/cli/dist/index.js`, local bare Git fixture, Node.js 24.22.1, git 2.43.7.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: clone jobs are process-local. A daemon restart forgets a running job, and a clone that completes after the page closes leaves an unregistered directory that the user can add manually.
- Not validated / out of scope: browser-level E2E (no browser binaries), macOS and Windows hosts, cloning through the in-place remote-daemon add proxy, shallow clones, branch/tag selection, submodules, and Git LFS.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The capability is additive; older daemons omit it and older clients ignore it.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 的「添加工作区」对话框里新增 Git 仓库来源。用户可以粘贴 clone 地址、选择一个尚不存在的目标目录、查看 clone 进度、取消任务，并在完成后直接进入该工作区，无需离开浏览器。

守护进程把 clone 作为异步任务执行，因此长时间 clone 不会超过客户端的变更预算，并且始终可观察。clone 成功后通过现有工作区注册接口完成注册，容量、嵌套、持久化和守护进程信任策略仍然只有一份实现。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-git-clone-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-git-clone-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## 为什么需要

变更前，对话框只能注册守护进程主机上已存在的目录，或创建一个空目录。从仓库开始工作意味着先离开浏览器，在那台机器的终端里 clone，再回来注册路径。对远程守护进程来说，这段绕行是工作区创建中最明显的体验缺口。

## Reviewer Test Plan / 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在装有 `git` 的主机上从本分支启动守护进程，打开 Web Shell 并打开「添加工作区」。来源选择器应提供「已有目录」和「Git 仓库」；没有 `git` 或没有动态注册能力的守护进程不应提供 Git 来源。
2. 选择「Git 仓库」，输入主机可访问的仓库地址，以及父目录已存在、最后一级尚不存在的绝对目标路径。提交后确认进度面板推进，成功后对话框关闭并进入包含仓库内容的工作区。
3. 再启动一次 clone 并取消。进度面板应进入已取消的终态，目标目录不应残留。
4. 尝试已存在的目标、相对路径目标和 `ext::` 地址。每种情况都应以清晰错误失败，且不留下新目录。
5. 确认 clone 成功的工作区像手动注册的目录一样出现在工作区列表中。信任状态由守护进程的 folder-trust 策略决定；clone 路径本身不授予信任。

### 证据（Before & After）

变更前 ——「添加工作区」只提供目录路径：

![变更前：只有目录路径的添加工作区对话框](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-before.png)

变更后 —— 选择 Git 仓库来源并填写地址与目标目录：

![变更后：Git 仓库来源](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-source.png)

变更后 —— 从目录建议中选择 clone 父目录：

![变更后：clone 目标目录建议](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-suggestions.png)

变更后 —— clone 进度与取消：

![变更后：clone 进度](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-progress.png)

进度截图把运行中的任务固定在 42%，以便拍到瞬时面板。

截图来自本地构建实际服务的 Web Shell；变更前截图使用已安装的 0.26.0 daemon。守护进程流程也已用真实本地 bare 仓库完成端到端验证：能力通告、202 任务创建、进度到 100%、clone 内容、注册，以及 `target_nested`、`target_exists`、`invalid_url`、`invalid_target` 拒绝。

### 测试环境

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ |
| Windows | ⚠️ |
| Linux | ✅ |

### 环境

本地构建（`npm run build` 以及用 6 GB 堆构建 CLI 包），从 `packages/cli/dist/index.js` 启动守护进程，使用本地 bare Git 仓库，Node.js 24.22.1，git 2.43.7。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：clone 任务状态是进程内的。守护进程重启会忘记运行中的任务；页面关闭后才完成的 clone 会留下未注册目录，用户可以手动添加。
- 未验证 / 范围外：浏览器级 E2E（没有浏览器二进制）、macOS 与 Windows 主机、经就地远程守护进程添加代理的 clone、浅克隆、分支/tag 选择、submodule 和 Git LFS。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。能力是增量式的；旧守护进程不宣告它，旧客户端会忽略它。

## 关联 Issue

N/A

</details>

prs.title: ci: retain raw JUnit reports for same-repo runs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Retains raw JUnit reports from same-repository CI runs for seven days, using the existing artifact upload step. Fork pull requests keep their existing artifact name. Missing reports are ignored, and the existing always/skip/profile conditions still govern collection.

## Why it's needed

[Run 39960587721](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39960587721/job/120438314967) reported an XML parse error at line 51090, column 185, but retained only smoke and disk-pressure artifacts. Without the original XML, the malformed bytes cannot be checked independently of log rendering. This change preserves that evidence for future runs.

The report publisher remains advisory as established in #15322, and genuine test failures still fail CI. The separate test fixes remain in #15364. This PR does not identify or fix the historical XML corruption's root cause.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a full same-repository PR or push run that generates reports, confirm the test-results-22.x-ubuntu-latest artifact contains the original package JUnit reports, including when tests or report publication fail. On a fork PR, confirm the existing test-results-fork-22.x-ubuntu-latest name is retained. Skipped CI and non-full profiles should not upload reports; a run without reports should not fail for missing files. Reports expire after seven days.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Previously, raw JUnit artifacts were uploaded only for fork PRs. The changed workflow also retains them for same-repository PRs and pushes.

Local validation on Node 22.22.0: `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` passed; actionlint (schema/expression checks), ESLint for the changed test, Prettier, and `git diff --check` passed. The 12 suites that consume the CI definition passed with 1265 tests and 9 skips across the initial run and one retry. The cleanup suite initially could not load the core entry while the fresh-worktree build was still running; all 23 of its tests passed when rerun after the build. The updated routing suite covers same-repository PRs, fork PRs, pushes, skipped/non-full profiles, artifact settings, and preserved failure semantics.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ workflow contract tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ hosted artifact upload not yet verified |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: additional artifact storage, bounded to seven days; fork report retention is also seven days.
- Not validated / out of scope: actual hosted artifact transfer, the exact historical malformed XML trigger, and any reporter repair.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the fork artifact name, report publisher tolerance, and unit-test exit behavior are preserved.

## Linked Issues

Related: #15322, #15364. No issue is closed by this diagnostic change.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

复用现有制品上传步骤，为同仓库 CI 运行保留原始 JUnit 报告七天。Fork PR 保持原有制品名称。缺失报告会被忽略，采集仍受现有 always/skip/profile 条件控制。

## 为什么需要

[运行 39960587721](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39960587721/job/120438314967) 在第 51090 行、第 185 列报告 XML 解析错误，但只保留了 smoke 和磁盘压力制品。没有原始 XML，就无法脱离日志渲染检查异常字节。此改动为后续运行保留这些证据。

报告发布器继续保持 #15322 引入的非阻断行为，真正的测试失败仍会使 CI 失败。独立的测试修复保留在 #15364。本 PR 不认定或修复历史 XML 损坏的根因。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

对于会生成报告的 full 同仓库 PR 或 push 运行，确认 test-results-22.x-ubuntu-latest 制品包含原始包级 JUnit 报告，包括测试或报告发布失败的情况。对于 fork PR，确认保留 test-results-fork-22.x-ubuntu-latest 名称。跳过 CI 或非 full profile 不应上传报告；没有报告的运行不应因文件缺失而失败。报告七天后过期。

### 前后对照证据

不涉及 UI。此前只有 fork PR 上传原始 JUnit 制品；修改后的 workflow 也为同仓库 PR 和 push 保留报告。

本地使用 Node 22.22.0 验证：`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 通过；actionlint（结构与表达式检查）、改动测试的 ESLint、Prettier 和 `git diff --check` 通过。读取 CI 定义的 12 个套件在初次运行和一次重试中共 1265 项通过、9 项跳过。清理套件首次运行时，新 worktree 的构建尚未结束，无法加载 core 入口；构建完成后重跑，其全部 23 项测试通过。更新后的路由套件覆盖同仓库 PR、fork PR、push、跳过 CI/非 full profile、制品配置和保持不变的失败语义。

- 主要风险或权衡：增加制品存储，保留期限制为七天；fork 报告同样保留七天。

prs.title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite outside the host lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test lane now seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache and runs the sdk-java suite, the SDK install, and the managed-agent H2 suite from that copy without the per-host lock. It takes the ticketed host lock only for the final cache write-back. A write-back lock that cannot be acquired within its budget now warns and skips the copy instead of failing a step whose suite already passed.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent gate failed on main commit `28c53fb50291` before any Java test ran. Both attempts of the fast-tier job were head of the sdk-java host-lock queue and waited the full 5400 seconds (tickets 258 and 271, on two different hosts), with the annotations naming `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`. The test step held the lock across a ~925-second suite, so one sibling hold could exhaust the fast tier's entire budget. The MariaDB lane already scopes the same lock to its write-back; this applies that established pattern to the remaining lock site, so the suite starts immediately and only the optional cache copy can be delayed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step: the seed and every `mvn` command come before the lock acquisition, and the acquisition plus the `timeout 300 find … -links 1 -exec cp` write-back follow it. The write-back's `mkdir` and `find` children close fd 9 so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock.

Stub `sdk_java_lock_acquire` to return 1 (the focused workflow test does this in a scratch HOME) and confirm the step logs `Maven cache write-back skipped`, exits 0, and never creates `~/.m2/repository`. The focused Vitest files under Verification pin the new ordering, the skip guard, and the workflow size baseline.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI plumbing, not user-visible.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Sandboxed Linux checkout; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and focused Vitest only. There is no Java/Maven toolchain locally, so the Java lanes were not executed; CI is the final validation.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every self-hosted Java leg now seeds from the host cache into a job-local repository and publishes only its nlink-1 delta; a missed write-back leaves the host cache slightly staler for the next job, which re-resolves it. This is the same tradeoff the MariaDB lane has used since #15128.
- Not validated / out of scope: the ECS pool and its shared lock queue are not available locally, and the full Java/MySQL suites were not run here. The MariaDB write-back site keeps its existing fail-closed behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15285

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

self-hosted SDK Java 测试通道现在先从宿主缓存播种 job 本地 Maven 仓库，再从该副本运行 sdk-java 套件、SDK install 和 managed-agent H2 套件，全程不持 per-host 锁。只有最后的缓存写回才获取带票据的宿主锁。写回取锁在预算内拿不到时，现在只记录警告并跳过复制，而不是让一个套件已经通过的 step 失败。

## 为什么需要

Managed Agent gate 在 main 的 `28c53fb50291` 上、任何 Java 测试开始之前就失败了。fast 档 job 的两次尝试都以队首身份等满了 5400 秒（票据 258 和 271，来自两台不同主机），注解点名 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`。test step 把锁持在约 925 秒的套件之上，因此一次同侪持锁就可能耗尽 fast 档的全部预算。MariaDB 通道已经把同一把锁限定在写回阶段；本 PR 把这个已经验证过的模式应用到剩余的取锁点，使套件立即开始，只有可选的缓存复制可能被延迟。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

检查 `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step：播种和每一条 `mvn` 命令都在取锁之前，取锁以及 `timeout 300 find … -links 1 -exec cp` 写回都在其后。写回的 `mkdir` 和 `find` 子进程会关闭 fd 9，因此被取消 job 的幸存进程无法继续持有锁。

把 `sdk_java_lock_acquire` 打桩为返回 1（聚焦工作流测试会在临时 HOME 中这样做），确认 step 打印 `Maven cache write-back skipped`、以 0 退出，并且从不创建 `~/.m2/repository`。验证章节中的聚焦 Vitest 文件 pin 住了新的顺序、跳过保护以及工作流尺寸基线。

N/A —— CI 管线改动，没有用户可见面。

|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

沙箱 Linux 检出；只运行了 `npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint` 和聚焦 Vitest。本地没有 Java/Maven 工具链，因此没有执行 Java 通道；CI 是最终验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：每个 self-hosted Java leg 现在都从宿主缓存播种到 job 本地仓库，并且只发布自己 nlink 为 1 的增量；错过的写回会让宿主缓存对下一个 job 稍微更旧，下一个 job 会重新解析。MariaDB 通道自 #15128 起就在使用同样的取舍。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本地没有 ECS 池及其共享锁队列，也没有运行完整的 Java/MySQL 套件。MariaDB 写回点保留现有的 fail-closed 行为。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15285

prs.title: feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。
- 验证可变标签、非法版本、缺少参数、制品不存在、校验不匹配和包内程序版本不匹配。失败必须保留旧安装，并清理锁与临时文件。
- 非独立安装应返回非零退出码，提示手动安装指定版本，不输出未固定版本的包管理器升级命令。
- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

验证通过：完整构建、工作区类型检查、bundle、170 项相关测试，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查。最终验证使用 npm 锁文件；可选 pnpm 布局触发了无关的文档导出体积限制，npm 构建通过了同一门禁。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

### 验证环境

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

## 风险与范围

- 显式指定版本允许重装和降级；所有独立升级入口都会在激活前核对版本一致性。
- 未覆盖 Windows 延迟替换、完整发布包验收、daemon/UI 升级编排或版本审核策略。
- 未指定参数时保留现有行为；非法版本校验更加严格。

关联并关闭 #11484。

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. A direct ACP prompt above the new text-resource replay limit now returns invalid parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源在 Daemon 向其他客户端回显前被拒绝。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和 Daemon 回显前拒绝。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源在实时回显前被拒绝。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。超过新文本资源回放上限的直接 ACP Prompt 现在返回参数错误。

prs.title: feat(cli): raise workspace skill install limits
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Since 2026-07-17 (#7018) the native skill installer has used one hardcoded budget for zip, GitHub, and local-folder installs alike: 6 MiB compressed, 6 MiB uncompressed, 2 MiB per file, and 128 files. This change splits the transport ceiling from the on-disk ceiling. A ZIP uploaded as base64 inside the existing JSON install request may be at most 7,864,071 raw bytes, which is the largest archive that still fits under the unchanged 10 MiB JSON body when the skill name is at its maximum legal length. Once the bytes are on disk, a skill may contain up to 2000 files, 32 MiB each, and 64 MiB in total. Accepted files are streamed or copied into the staging directory the installer already creates, then checked, renamed, and rolled back as before. Web Shell uses the same raw-byte ZIP ceiling and no longer describes every size failure as a 6 MB ZIP.

## Why it's needed

The 6 MiB figure was the in-memory unzip budget, not a judgment about how large a skill should be. A ZIP is sent as base64 inside JSON, and the daemon parser is `express.json({ limit: '10mb' })`, so 6 MiB of raw bytes becomes about 8 MiB of base64 and stays under that parser. The same 6 MiB was then applied again to the uncompressed tree, which meant GitHub and folder installs were capped even though their bytes never enter that JSON body. The 2 MiB per-file cap and the 128-file cap had no finer written rationale. The tests treated the whole set as a zip-bomb guard.

Those caps reject ordinary skills: one PDF, wasm module, or SQLite file; a reference tree with more than 128 small files; or a text zip that expands past 6 MiB. Codex's skill installer has no such caps, and its plugin bundles allow a 100 MiB download and 512 MiB extracted. This change does not copy those numbers. It only separates the transport cap from the on-disk cap, raises the on-disk cap to 64 MiB total, 32 MiB per file, and 2000 files, and stops holding the expanded package in the daemon heap. Streaming avoids retaining the expanded package. ZIP installs still retain up to 7,864,071 compressed bytes plus the accepted JSON body, and manifest validation reads the staged SKILL.md into a string (up to 32 MiB).

What stays the same: the global JSON limit is still `10mb`, on purpose, because it covers every JSON route. An incompressible archive that cannot fit in 7,864,071 raw bytes is installed from GitHub or a local folder, and still stops at 64 MiB once expanded. Path length 512, path depth 16, symlink rejection, manifest checks, and staging rollback are unchanged. The other skill download path is not changed.

The ceilings and the decision to stream into the existing staging directory are specified in [the English design](docs/design/2026-10-21-workspace-skill-installer-limits.md) and [the Chinese design](docs/design/2026-10-21-workspace-skill-installer-limits.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that a skill the old caps rejected now installs, and that each new ceiling still fails closed. A folder or ZIP whose expanded size is over 6 MiB but within 64 MiB, with no single file over 32 MiB and no more than 2000 files, should install and leave no staging directory. A file of 2 MiB plus one byte should install. One file of 32 MiB plus one byte, a tree whose sizes sum to 64 MiB plus one byte, and a package of 2001 files should be rejected, and the workspace should not keep a partial skill or a staging directory. A raw ZIP larger than 7,864,071 bytes should fail with the archive-size error before it is unzipped. A highly compressible ZIP that would expand past 64 MiB should still be rejected. In Web Shell, a selected ZIP larger than 7,864,071 bytes should show the ZIP sentence and should not upload. A server size failure should show the 32 MiB / 64 MiB sentence, and too many files should show the 2000-file sentence, in both languages. The daemon JSON limit should still be `10mb`.

The focused installer tests cover the at-limit and one-byte-over cases. Sparse folder files are used so the test process does not allocate the 32 MiB or 64 MiB bodies. A GitHub response whose `content-length` is one byte over the per-file cap is rejected without a 32 MiB body, and a streamed body of that same size returns 413 and cancels the read. Recovery regression tests additionally cover a partial Contents API download followed by git fallback, and concurrent installs of names sharing an artifact prefix. The fallback discards the partial attempt; cleanup preserves the other skill’s complete staged tree. The reproduction and verification plan is recorded locally under .qwen/e2e-tests/.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

CLI installer/recovery tests 46/46, Web Shell install-dialog tests 17/17, direct compiled-installer recovery scenarios 4/4, full build and typecheck, bundle, targeted ESLint and Prettier. No interactive browser session in this follow-up.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a ZIP install still holds the JSON body and the decoded archive until the handler returns, up to the 10 MiB body plus 7,864,071 archive bytes and streaming buffers; manifest parsing additionally reads up to 32 MiB into a string. Expanded file bodies are written to the staging directory and are not retained. Staging can hold 64 MiB. Replacing a skill briefly keeps a backup of the previous tree, and the git fallback temporarily keeps both the checkout and staging copy. The checkout is materialized before size checks and is not bounded by the 64 MiB staging cap. The existing 30-second client timeout and same-name cross-process/directory-alias concurrency remain follow-up work.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full monorepo suite, an interactive Web Shell session, and Windows or Linux locally. The other skill downloader and the global JSON limit are intentionally untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: file-count failures now use `skill_too_many_files` instead of `invalid_skill_package`, and the messages include the 2000 cap. Size failures stay `skill_package_too_large`. No stored data migration.

## Linked Issues

None.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

自 2026-07-17（#7018）起，原生技能安装器对 ZIP、GitHub 和本地文件夹使用同一套写死的预算：压缩后 6 MiB、解压后 6 MiB、单文件 2 MiB、文件数 128。这次把传输上限和磁盘上限拆开。ZIP 仍以 base64 放在现有的 JSON 安装请求里，原始压缩包最大 7,864,071 字节。这是技能名取合法最大长度时，仍能放进未改动的 10 MiB JSON 正文的最大原始 ZIP。字节落到磁盘之后，技能最多可以有 2000 个文件、单文件 32 MiB、合计 64 MiB。通过检查的文件会流式写入或复制到安装器原本就会创建的暂存目录，然后再做校验、重命名和回滚。Web Shell 使用同一个原始字节上限，并且不再把每一次大小失败都说成 6 MB 的 ZIP。

## 为什么需要

6 MiB 是当时的内存解压预算，不是对技能该有多大的判断。ZIP 以 base64 放在 JSON 里，daemon 的解析器是 `express.json({ limit: '10mb' })`，所以 6 MiB 原始字节变成大约 8 MiB 的 base64，仍低于这个解析器。同一个 6 MiB 又被用在未压缩的整棵树上，于是 GitHub 和文件夹安装也被卡住，即使它们的字节根本不进入那个 JSON 正文。单文件 2 MiB 和 128 个文件没有更细的书面理由。测试把整套限制当成 zip bomb 防护。

这些上限会拒绝普通技能：一个 PDF、wasm 模块或 SQLite 文件；超过 128 个小文件的参考目录；或者解压后超过 6 MiB 的文本 ZIP。Codex 的技能安装器没有这类上限，它的插件包允许下载 100 MiB、解压 512 MiB。这次不照搬那些数字。只把传输上限和磁盘上限分开，把磁盘上限提高到合计 64 MiB、单文件 32 MiB、2000 个文件，并且不再把展开后的包留在 daemon 堆上。流式写入避免保留整个展开后的包。ZIP 安装仍保留最多 7,864,071 字节的压缩包和已接受的 JSON 正文；清单校验还会把已暂存的 SKILL.md 读成字符串（最多 32 MiB）。

保持不变的部分：全局 JSON 限制仍是 `10mb`，这是有意的，因为它覆盖每一条 JSON 路由。放不进 7,864,071 原始字节的不可压缩包，改走 GitHub 或本地文件夹，展开后仍停在 64 MiB。路径长度 512、路径深度 16、符号链接拒绝、清单检查和暂存回滚都不改。另一条技能下载路径也不改。

上限，以及流进现有暂存目录这一决定，写在[英文设计](docs/design/2026-10-21-workspace-skill-installer-limits.md)和[中文设计](docs/design/2026-10-21-workspace-skill-installer-limits.zh-CN.md)里。

## 评审人测试计划

### 如何验证

确认以前会被旧上限拒绝的技能现在可以安装，同时每个新上限仍然会失败并收干净。文件夹或 ZIP 展开后超过 6 MiB、但不超过 64 MiB，且单文件不超过 32 MiB、文件数不超过 2000 时，应当安装成功，并且不留下暂存目录。2 MiB 再加 1 字节的文件应当可以安装。单文件 32 MiB 再加 1 字节、大小合计 64 MiB 再加 1 字节、以及 2001 个文件，都应当被拒绝，工作区里不应留下半截技能或暂存目录。原始 ZIP 大于 7,864,071 字节时，应在解压前以压缩包大小错误失败。一个会展开超过 64 MiB 的高压缩比 ZIP 仍应被拒绝。在 Web Shell 里，选中的 ZIP 大于 7,864,071 字节时应显示 ZIP 那句文案，并且不上传。服务端的大小失败应显示 32 MiB / 64 MiB 那句，文件过多应显示 2000 个文件那句，中英文都要核对。daemon 的 JSON 限制应仍是 `10mb`。

聚焦的安装器测试覆盖了刚好达到上限和超出 1 字节的情况。文件夹用例用稀疏文件，测试进程不会分配那 32 MiB 或 64 MiB 的正文。`content-length` 比单文件上限多 1 字节的 GitHub 响应会在不需要 32 MiB 正文的情况下被拒绝；一段达到同样大小的流式正文返回 413，并取消读取。恢复路径回归测试还覆盖 Contents API 部分下载后回退 git，以及名称共享安装产物前缀的并发安装。回退会丢弃未完成的尝试；清理保留另一个技能的完整暂存树。复现与验证计划记录在本地 .qwen/e2e-tests/。

### 证据（改前与改后）

不适用。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 运行环境

CLI 安装器与恢复测试 46/46，Web Shell 对话框测试 17/17，直接编译产物恢复场景 4/4，完整构建和类型检查、bundle、定向 ESLint 和 Prettier。本轮没有交互式浏览器验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：ZIP 安装在处理函数返回前仍持有 JSON 正文和解码后的压缩包，最多为 10 MiB 正文、7,864,071 字节压缩包和流式缓冲；清单解析还会把最多 32 MiB 读成字符串。展开后的文件正文写入暂存目录，不再留在内存里。暂存目录最多 64 MiB。替换已有技能时，旧树的备份会短时间同时存在；git 回退在删除检出前会同时保留临时检出和暂存副本；检出先于大小检查落盘，不受 64 MiB 暂存上限约束。现有的客户端 30 秒超时，以及同名安装的跨进程或目录别名并发问题留待后续处理。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：完整的 monorepo 测试套件、交互式 Web Shell 会话，以及本机上的 Windows 和 Linux。另一条技能下载器和全局 JSON 限制是有意不改的。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移：文件数失败现在使用 `skill_too_many_files`，不再使用 `invalid_skill_package`，文案里带有 2000 这个上限。大小失败仍是 `skill_package_too_large`。没有已存储数据的迁移。

## 关联问题

无。

prs.title: feat(serve): give managed workspace sessions todo_write (#15076)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives a Managed Agent Workspace Session the `todo_write` tool through one new tool profile, `hosted-workspace-files/3`, which declares everything `hosted-workspace-files/2` declares plus `todo_write`. Existing profiles keep their exact vocabulary. A new profile version rather than a wider `/2` follows the reasoning that introduced `/2` for `glob`: a profile name is persisted with the Session definition, so widening `/2` would hand a saved Session a tool its earlier turns never had.

There is no `hosted-workspace-shell/3`. `#15330`, merged into `main` before this branch landed, unified Shell under `hosted-workspace-shell/1`, removed `/2`, and made `AgentDefinitionCompiler` refuse every other `hosted-workspace-shell/…` identifier even when the deployment allow-lists it. A second Shell profile is therefore unreachable, and the Shell half is dropped rather than carried as dead code.

`web_fetch` is not part of this change: `main` shipped it for the files profiles with its own argument and destination checks, so this branch inherits it. `files/3` therefore declares everything `files/2` declares — `web_fetch` and `glob` included — plus `todo_write`. The merge that brought it in keeps both names in every allowlist: the native-tool continuation set, the native-batch set, the Worker's admitted names, and both copies of the Java preview set.

`todo_write` runs inside the Runtime Worker and writes no Workspace file: the list is bookkeeping in the Worker's runtime directory. Admission validates the argument shape before the Runtime is acquired, so a malformed call earns a model-correctable refusal, is committed as a tool result like any other refused call, and spends no durable Runtime work. Under the `default` and `auto-edit` approval modes the tool is pre-approved, because it changes no file the user owns. The executor Worker sets `todoWriteEnabled` explicitly, which is the flag core uses to decide whether this tool exists at all, so the profile opts in rather than bypassing a default.

Only the executor lane registers the tool. The provider lane serves the resident and CSI sessions, whose manifests are a closed set, so it stays byte-identical to `main` — the same boundary the `glob` change kept.

The task list is scoped to one turn, and the tool description says so. The Worker's tool set is keyed by a Runtime session id the Harness derives per turn, and the Worker's runtime directory is per Runtime instance, so a stored list does not reach the next turn. The reminder a local session shows is injected by the model loop in the Harness, which never sees this Worker's configuration, so no reminder is claimed.

The Java control plane is taught `files/3` in the same change, because a TypeScript-only profile leaves the two planes disagreeing: `supportsApprovalSelection` admits it, `ManagedSessionStore.approvalSelection` — the reader behind `approval:query` — returns its selection, and the `ma_turn` insert and the turn-snapshot reader name it, so its turns persist and read back their approval snapshot. Without that reader, the Harness answers `null` and the Session fails on its first tool call, before the pre-approved `todo_write` can dispatch. `isPublicShell` stays `/1`-only per `#15330`. Plan mode stays unavailable on `files/3`: the creation gate and session options keep their `FILES || isPublicShell` form, and `supportsPlanMode` now applies the same profile filter before `supportsApprovalSelection`, otherwise admitting `files/3` to approval selection would silently hand it Plan mode that the Harness refuses.

`main` later added the managed automation gate and shipped its own fix for the parity test that `#15330` broke; this branch now merges both, and `capability-parity.test.ts` matches `main` byte-for-byte. The only conflict was the executor's tool registry, where both sides appended an entry: `todo_write` and `ManagedAutomationGateTool` now sit side by side in the admitted names and in `createManagedToolSet`.

## Why it's needed

A Managed Session had six tools and no plan surface of its own, so a long multi-step task had no record of what the agent intended. The legacy path shows a task list; the Managed path showed nothing. `todo_write` is the low-risk half of the original request: it changes no file the user owns, adds no outbound access, needs no Session Store schema change, and needs no Java Broker change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create a Hosted Session with `toolProfile: "hosted-workspace-files/3"` and ask for a multi-step plan: expect a `todo_write` call that runs without an approval request even under the `default` approval mode, and expect the result to report the list. Ask again in a later turn and expect the model to resend the whole list, because the stored list does not survive the turn.

Then create a Session with `hosted-workspace-files/2` or `hosted-workspace-shell/1`: `todo_write` must be refused with the existing profile refusal and nothing is acquired on the Runtime. A `web_fetch` call is refused on every profile. A definition that pins `hosted-workspace-shell/2` or `hosted-workspace-shell/3` must be refused at compile time as a noncanonical Shell identifier.

A malformed list, such as a missing `status`, an empty `id`, or a `blockedBy` that is a string instead of an array, must come back as a refusal the model can correct, with no acquisition, reservation or dispatch.

A resident or CSI Session must still see exactly its closed tool set: adding `todo_write` to that lane is the regression this PR fixed, and the suite below pins it.

For the control plane, create a `files/3` Session with a Workspace and an approval selection: the selection must be accepted rather than refused with `400 invalid_hosted_approval_selection`, the turn row must carry its approval mode and revision, and a Plan-mode selection must still be refused.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for terminal output — the evidence is the tables below.

Measured on the merge head (`21b04efece`, `main` at `38b25118fc`), macOS arm64, Node 22, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9:

| Check | Command | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Typecheck | `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json` | exit 0 |
| Java checkstyle (the CI gate that failed on the previous head) | `mvn -q checkstyle:check` | exit 0 |
| Java consumer classes | `mvn clean test -Dtest=ManagedActionsTest,ManagedApprovalChangeTest,QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest,AgentDefinitionCompilerTest,WorkspaceProfileLifecycleTest,ManagedWorkspaceAdmissionTest,ManagedAgentSessionCapabilitiesTest` | **419 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors** |
| TS profile, parity, recovery, tool-turn, harness tables, executor | `npx vitest run --coverage.enabled=false` over those six files, `-t 'todo_write\|web_fetch\|admits exactly\|recovers every saved\|refuses an unknown\|parity\|queries live policy only for eligible profile\|preserves approval selection'` | **247 passed, 1312 skipped** |

The typecheck needs the larger heap on this machine: at the default limit `tsc` dies with `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit` on this tree, which is a toolchain limit rather than a type error.

Two CI reds on earlier heads were not this branch's code. The `Lint & Static` failure at `41dcb66e16` was the freshness gate asking for `main`'s lint change; it cleared when `main` was merged. The `web-shell E2E Smoke` failure at `f3f4bedfd2` ran `web-shell.message-deletion.spec.ts` before `main` fixed its hover-menu corridor in `#15404`, so the branch was four commits behind that spec; merging `main` brings the fix and the two other web-shell spec adjustments, none of which touch the Managed Agent serve path or the Java control plane.

Mutations: the two paths the `main` merge touched — `declaresTodoTool` and the `approval:query` reader — were re-measured at `5a83bb6c8b`; the rest were measured at `503cf8394e`, and `ManagedAgentStore` has zero diff since then. Each mutant was reverted and `cmp`-compared byte-identical before the next one:

| Removed | Result |
| --- | --- |
| the Plan-profile filter before `supportsApprovalSelection` in `supportsPlanMode` | **1 failed** — `keepsPlanModeOnlyOnTheProfilesThatDeclareIt[3]`, `expected: false` |
| `declaresTodoTool()` returning true for `files/3` | **1 failed** — `declares todo_write on hosted-workspace-files/3`, `expected [ 'read_file', 'write_file', …(3) ] to include 'todo_write'` |
| `files/3` from the three `ma_turn` insert lists | **1 failed** — `snapshotsTheApprovalSelectionOnTurnsOfTheNewProfileVersions[1]`, `expected: WebShellApprovalSelection[mode=default, revision=0, planMode=false]` |
| `FILES_V3` from `ManagedSessionStore.approvalSelection` | **1 failed** — `liveApprovalReadsReturnTheSelectionForTheFilesV3Profile`, `Expecting actual not to be null` |
| `HOSTED_TODO_WRITE_TOOL` from the preview test's declared set | **1 failed** — `admits exactly the declared native tools to the version 2 input preview`, `expected [ 'read_file', 'write_file', …(15) ] to include 'todo_write'` |

The earlier round's mutations — the `content` bound, the preservation sentence, the dispatch payload, the search predicate and the runtime-root scrub — were measured on `41dcb66e16`, before `main` was merged. Those code paths are unchanged by the merge, and they are not relabelled here as if re-measured on this head. `todo_write` in `NATIVE_TOOLS` remains unpinned: no test builds a `[todo_write, write_file]` batch under an approval.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22 workspace plus JDK 21 + Maven for the Java consumer classes. No full Java→Harness→Broker→Worker deployment was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new profile widens the tool surface only for Sessions that explicitly pin `files/3`; no existing Session changes behaviour. The Shell half is gone because `#15330` made a second Shell identifier unreachable, so Shell Sessions do not get `todo_write` from this PR. The task list is per turn, which is a real limitation of this architecture rather than of the profile: making it survive a turn needs the Harness to supply a stable Session identity to the Worker, which is a protocol change listed as follow-up work.
- Not validated / out of scope: `NATIVE_TOOLS` and `captureNativeBatch` are not behaviourally pinned. Each `todo_write` turn leaves a bounded `todos/<key>.json` under the runtime directory that nothing deletes; cleanup needs a Session-close hook the Worker does not have. The profiles are not enabled in the production connector, and enabling one still needs every Worker upgraded and old incarnations drained first. Windows and Linux were not exercised, and there is no end-to-end run against a full Managed deployment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `managed-runtime-tools/1` keeps its identity, no Session Store schema changes, and existing `/1` and `/2` Sessions are unaffected. The merge removes nothing this branch had shipped: `hosted-workspace-shell/2` disappeared from `main`, not from here.

## Design documents

- English: [docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.md](docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.md)
- Chinese: [docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #15076

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

通过一个新的工具 profile —— `hosted-workspace-files/3` —— 为 Managed Agent 的 Workspace 会话提供 `todo_write`。它在 `hosted-workspace-files/2` 的全部声明之上只增加这一个工具，既有 profile 的工具集合保持不变。采用新版本而不是加宽 `/2`，沿用当初为 `glob` 引入 `/2` 的理由：profile 名称随 Session 定义持久化，加宽 `/2` 会让已保存的会话获得此前轮次从未提供的工具。

不存在 `hosted-workspace-shell/3`。先于本分支合并的 `#15330` 把 Shell 统一到 `hosted-workspace-shell/1`、移除了 `/2`，并让 `AgentDefinitionCompiler` 拒绝其他 `hosted-workspace-shell/…` 标识——即使部署侧允许列表包含它。第二个 Shell profile 因此不可达，所以这一半直接移除，而不是留作死代码。

更早的版本还包含原生 `web_fetch`，这一半继续不交付：issue 上有维护者裁定暂缓，且 files profile 的会话没有 shell，在那里抓取会新开出站路径。共享核心的 `web_fetch` 源码与本 PR 之前一致，也没有 Worker 准入该工具。

`todo_write` 在 Runtime Worker 内执行，不写 Workspace 文件：清单是 Worker 运行目录里的记账数据。准入在获取 Runtime 之前校验参数形状，畸形调用得到模型可纠正的拒绝，不消耗持久化 Runtime 工作。在 `default` 与 `auto-edit` 下预先批准，因为它不改用户拥有的文件。executor 车道的 Worker 显式设置 `todoWriteEnabled`，是 profile 主动开启而不是绕过默认值。只有 executor 车道注册该工具，provider 车道与 `main` 逐字节一致。

任务清单只作用于一轮，工具描述也这样写。要跨轮存活，需要 Harness 向 Worker 提供稳定的会话身份，属于协议变更，列为后续工作。

Java 控制面在同一次改动里认识 `files/3`：`supportsApprovalSelection` 接纳它，`ManagedSessionStore.approvalSelection`（`approval:query` 的读取点）返回它的选择，`ma_turn` 插入与轮次快照读取也都点名它，因此它的轮次能持久化并读回审批快照。缺了那个读取点，Harness 会拿到 `null`，会话在第一个工具调用就失败，连预批准的 `todo_write` 都到不了派发。按 `#15330`，`isPublicShell` 保持只认 `/1`。Plan mode 在 `files/3` 上仍不可用：创建门禁与会话选项沿用 `FILES || isPublicShell`，而 `supportsPlanMode` 现在先应用同一 profile 过滤再调用 `supportsApprovalSelection`——否则把 `files/3` 纳入审批选择会顺带给它 Harness 所拒绝的 Plan mode。

`main` 随后加入了 managed automation gate，并自行修复了 `#15330` 弄坏的 parity 测试；本分支现已合并两者，`capability-parity.test.ts` 与 `main` 逐字节一致。唯一冲突在执行器的工具注册表——两侧各自追加了一项：`todo_write` 与 `ManagedAutomationGateTool` 现在并列出现在准入名单与 `createManagedToolSet` 中。

## 为什么需要

Managed 会话此前只有六个工具，没有自己的计划面，多步长任务的意图没有记录。旧路径有任务清单，Managed 路径什么都没有。`todo_write` 是原始需求中风险较低的一半：不改用户拥有的文件、不新增出站访问、不需要改 Session Store schema、也不需要改 Java Broker。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

用 `toolProfile: "hosted-workspace-files/3"` 创建 Hosted Session，要求给出多步计划：预期出现 `todo_write` 调用，即使在 `default` 下也不产生审批请求，且结果报告该清单。后续轮次再要求一次，预期模型重发整份清单，因为存储的清单不跨轮存活。

再用 `hosted-workspace-files/2` 或 `hosted-workspace-shell/1` 创建会话：`todo_write` 必须以既有的 profile 拒绝被否决，且 Runtime 上不获取任何东西。`web_fetch` 在所有 profile 上都被拒绝。固定 `hosted-workspace-shell/2` 或 `hosted-workspace-shell/3` 的定义必须在编译期作为非规范 Shell 标识被拒绝。

畸形清单必须作为模型可纠正的拒绝返回，且不获取、不预留、不派发。resident 或 CSI 会话必须仍然只看到自己的封闭工具集。

控制面侧：创建一个带 Workspace 的 `files/3` 会话并带审批选择，选择必须被接受而不是以 `400 invalid_hosted_approval_selection` 拒绝；轮次行必须带上审批模式与版本；Plan mode 选择必须仍被拒绝。

### 证据（前后对比）

终端输出无变化——证据是下表的实测结果。

在合并 head（`d79d1d3561`，`main` 为 `43d0d50e2c`）、macOS arm64、Node 22、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.9 上实测：

| 检查 | 命令 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 类型检查 | `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json` | exit 0 |
| Java 消费方类 | `mvn clean test -Dtest=ManagedActionsTest,ManagedApprovalChangeTest,QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest,AgentDefinitionCompilerTest,WorkspaceProfileLifecycleTest,ManagedWorkspaceAdmissionTest,ManagedAgentSessionCapabilitiesTest` | **417 用例，0 失败，0 错误** |
| TS profile/parity/recovery/tool-turn/harness 两表 | 上述五个文件 + `-t 'todo_write\|glob\|admits exactly\|recovers every saved\|refuses an unknown\|parity\|queries live policy only for eligible profile\|preserves approval selection'` | **267 通过，1192 跳过** |
| 执行器与 automation gate | 执行器、gate-tool、gate 三个套件 + `-t 'todo_write\|automation gate\|scrub\|gate'` | **5 通过，135 跳过** |

本机类型检查需要更大堆：默认上限下 `tsc` 在这棵树上会以 `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit` 退出，这是工具链限制而非类型错误。

变异验证测于 `503cf8394e`；它们触及的两个文件（`ManagedAgentStore`、`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`）自该提交起 diff 为 0，每次变异后还原并 `cmp` 逐字节一致：

| 移除的东西 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `supportsPlanMode` 中 `supportsApprovalSelection` 之前的 Plan profile 过滤 | **1 红** —— `keepsPlanModeOnlyOnTheProfilesThatDeclareIt[3]`，`expected: false` |
| `declaresTodoTool()` 对 `files/3` 返回 true | **1 红** —— `declares todo_write on hosted-workspace-files/3`，`expected [ 'read_file', 'write_file', …(2) ] to include 'todo_write'` |
| 三处 `ma_turn` 插入语句里的 `files/3` | **1 红** —— `snapshotsTheApprovalSelectionOnTurnsOfTheNewProfileVersions[1]`，`expected: WebShellApprovalSelection[mode=default, revision=0, planMode=false]` |
| `ManagedSessionStore.approvalSelection` 里的 `FILES_V3` | **1 红** —— `liveApprovalReadsReturnTheSelectionForTheFilesV3Profile`，`Expecting actual not to be null` |
| preview 测试 declared 集合里的 `HOSTED_TODO_WRITE_TOOL` | **1 红** —— `admits exactly the declared native tools to the version 2 input preview`，`expected [ 'read_file', 'write_file', …(15) ] to include 'todo_write'` |

上一轮的变异（`content` 上限、保留规则语句、派发 payload、搜索谓词、运行时根擦除）测于 `41dcb66e16`，在合并之前；这些代码路径未被合并改动，此处不把它们改标成在新 head 重测。`NATIVE_TOOLS` 里的 `todo_write` 仍未被固定——没有用例构造 `[todo_write, write_file]` 批次走审批。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

本机 Node 22 工作区，Java 用 JDK 21 + Maven。未跑完整 Java→Harness→Broker→Worker 部署。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新 profile 只对显式固定 `files/3` 的会话扩大工具面，既有会话行为不变。Shell 一半已移除，因为 `#15330` 让第二个 Shell 标识不可达，因此 Shell 会话不会从本 PR 获得 `todo_write`。任务清单只作用于一轮，这是架构现状；跨轮存活需要 Harness 提供稳定会话身份，属于协议变更，列为后续工作。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：`NATIVE_TOOLS` 与 `captureNativeBatch` 没有被行为测试固定；每次 `todo_write` 轮次会在运行时目录留下一个有界的 `todos/<key>.json`，无人删除。这些 profile 未在生产 connector 启用；启用仍需先升级所有 Worker 并排空旧实例。Windows 与 Linux 未实测，也没有针对完整 Managed 部署的端到端运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`managed-runtime-tools/1` 身份不变，Session Store schema 不变，既有 `/1` 与 `/2` 会话不受影响。合并没有移除本分支交付过的东西：`hosted-workspace-shell/2` 是从 `main` 消失的，不是这里。

prs.title: feat(memory): add deterministic Codex source previews
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a shared in-memory preview foundation for Codex memory imports. A versioned set of relative Markdown paths and contents produces contextual sections, project/user/unassigned groups, supporting references, stable identities, warnings and conservative usage estimates. Parsing preserves task qualifiers across mixed project heading depths and remains deterministic across file order and locale.

Includes the complete English/Chinese import contract, a ten-PR dependency sequence and acceptance conditions. This is the first incremental PR alongside #14281, which remains open. Code and tests total 826 added lines; documentation adds 128 lines and is excluded from the agreed 1,000-line cap.

## Why it's needed

Local and cloud clients need the same interpretation of historical memory before explicitly selecting what to consolidate. A deterministic, bounded preview can be reviewed independently of model execution, durable jobs and publication recovery, while preserving the complete delivery contract for those later stages.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Preview a synthetic source set with two projects, an explicit user-preference summary, a referenced distilled Markdown resource and a missing reference. Confirm contextual sections, independent support selection, project isolation, warnings and unassigned ambiguous scopes.
- Reorder source files and vary locale-sensitive comparison behavior. Confirm identical preview output and stable IDs/digest; reorder sections and confirm their content identities remain stable.
- Mix shallow project tasks with another project's deeper headings. Every selectable section containing the task fact must retain its qualifier, and neither project may acquire the other's facts.
- Submit traversal/raw-session/configuration paths, excessive Markdown complexity, oversized sources and oversized sections. Confirm bounded rejection, or visible unselectable sections, without truncation. Estimates must exclude unselectable sections, respect count/UTF-8 batch limits, conservatively bound scope splits and report zero usage for empty selections.
- Confirm parser/estimator execution needs no model, authentication, native memory or filesystem input. This PR introduces internal modules only; public CLI and HTTP entry points are later integrations.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. The installed baseline CLI (0.18.5-preview.0) rejected the import command; this PR does not claim that command is now available. A mixed-heading-depth probe initially reproduced a selectable fact losing its qualifier; after the fix, the same built-module probe returned only the complete Alpha task and isolated Beta section.

Final local verification passed: 31 CLI tests, 4 core tests and 12 independent built-module probe groups. Filesystem/network interception around parser/estimator calls recorded no attempts; Node's initial module loading is outside that assertion. Full workspace build, typecheck and bundle passed, together with focused ESLint, formatting and bilingual contract checks. Two full self-audit passes were clean; a second independent local medium review reported no further findings. These are local checks, not formal approval.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests and synthetic module probes |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.17.0, pnpm 11.24.0, synthetic source envelopes and isolated probe runtime. No actual user memory or production provider was used. The final base includes main's independently merged duplicate-import repair (#15146); no unrelated repair is included here.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: scope inference remains a hint requiring explicit destination mapping; usage estimates are conservative reservations, not provider billing quotes. This crosses CLI/core and requests maintainer review of that small shared boundary.
- Not validated / out of scope: production semantic consolidation, local directory collection, CLI import, HTTP routes/capability, model execution, durable tasks, native-memory publication and operating-system-specific recovery. Their contracts and acceptance criteria are documented for later PRs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive internal foundation; no migration of experimental import state. PR #14281 remains open, and overlapping work will be reconciled after whichever path lands first.

Complete synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/codex-memory-preview/docs/design/external-memory-import.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/codex-memory-preview/docs/design/external-memory-import.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related parallel implementation: #14281. This PR does not supersede or close it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变更

为 Codex 记忆导入提供共享的内存预览基础。版本化的相对 Markdown 路径与内容会生成带上下文的章节、project/user/unassigned 分组、支持引用、稳定身份、警告和保守用量估算。解析在不同项目标题深度混合时保留任务限定条件，不受文件顺序和区域排序影响。

包含完整同步的中英文导入契约、十个 PR 的依赖顺序和验收条件。这是与 #14281 并行的首个增量 PR，原 PR 保持开放。代码和测试共新增 826 行；文档另增 128 行，不计入约定的 1,000 行上限。

## 为什么需要

本地和云端客户端需要在明确选择整理内容前，对历史记忆采用相同解释。确定性、有界的预览可以独立于模型执行、持久任务和发布恢复接受评审，同时保留后续阶段的完整交付契约。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 预览包含两个项目、明确用户偏好摘要、被引用的提炼 Markdown 资源和一个缺失引用的合成来源。确认上下文章节、支持资源独立选择、项目隔离、警告，以及歧义范围保持未分配。
- 重排来源文件并改变区域比较行为。确认预览输出及 ID/digest 不变；重排章节后确认其内容身份仍然稳定。
- 混合浅层项目任务和另一项目的深层标题。任何包含任务事实的可选章节都必须保留其限定条件，两个项目的事实不能混入对方。
- 提交路径穿越/原始会话/配置路径、过高 Markdown 复杂度、过大来源和过大章节。确认有界拒绝，或将章节显示为不可选，而不截断内容。估算必须排除不可选章节，遵守章节数/UTF-8 字节批次限制，为范围拆分提供保守上界，空选择用量为零。
- 确认解析/估算无需模型、认证、原生记忆或文件系统输入。本 PR 仅引入内部模块，公开 CLI 和 HTTP 入口属于后续接入。

### 前后证据

UI 不适用。已安装基线 CLI（0.18.5-preview.0）拒绝导入命令；本 PR 不声称该命令现在已经可用。混合标题深度探针最初复现了可选事实缺少限定条件的问题；修复后，同一成品模块探针只返回完整 Alpha 任务和隔离的 Beta 章节。

最终本地验证通过：31 个 CLI 测试、4 个 core 测试和 12 组独立成品模块探针。对解析/估算调用进行文件系统/网络拦截，未记录到访问尝试；该断言不包含 Node 初始模块加载。全工作区 build、typecheck、bundle，以及定向 ESLint、格式和双语契约检查均通过。两次完整自审未发现问题，第二轮独立本地 medium 评审无新增发现。这些是本地检查，不是正式批准。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build、typecheck、bundle、定向测试和合成模块探针 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 等待 CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 等待 CI |

### 环境

Node 22.17.0、pnpm 11.24.0、合成来源信封和隔离探针 runtime。未使用实际用户记忆或生产服务商。最终基线包含 main 独立合入的重复 import 修复（#15146），本 PR 不包含无关修复。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：范围推断只是提示，仍需明确映射目标；用量估算是保守预留，不是服务商账单报价。此次跨 CLI/core 的小型共享边界需要 maintainer 评审。
- 未验证或不在范围内：生产语义整理、本地目录收集、CLI 导入、HTTP 路由/能力声明、模型执行、持久任务、原生记忆发布及操作系统相关恢复。后续 PR 的契约和验收条件已记录。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：新增内部基础能力，不迁移实验导入状态。PR #14281 保持开放，后续按哪条路径先合入协调重叠工作。

完整同步设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/codex-memory-preview/docs/design/external-memory-import.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/codex-memory-preview/docs/design/external-memory-import.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联事项

并行完整实现：#14281。本 PR 不替代或关闭它。

</details>

prs.title: fix(serve): revalidate skill snapshots in the background
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Workspace Skill inventory queries return a retained snapshot immediately and revalidate in the background, with starts throttled to once per second. A background task releases its shared slot after five seconds so another read can retry. Slow successful observations can still update the snapshot, provided the workspace generation is valid and no observation started later has already published. Optional metadata exposes observation age, staleness, and shared-slot occupancy.

Cold reads, deletion, and enablement identity resolution wait for a real observation, honoring ACP's configured timeout and preserving daemon-local fallback. They do not impose the background slot deadline. Only error-free initialized observations replace retained data. Errored child replies preserve a warm snapshot and its timestamp; cold and foreground reads attempt local fallback and return retryable unavailability if neither source succeeds. A valid empty catalog remains distinct from unavailability.

## Why it's needed

The previous five-second cache hides runtime watcher updates until its freshness window expires and makes the next caller wait. Replaying retained inventory when the runtime is unavailable also renews its timestamp. This change keeps warm reads responsive and makes observation age visible without allowing slow but healthy runtime responses to freeze the inventory permanently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Query while revalidation is pending: warm reads should return immediately, share the current slot, and start at most once per second. Have the child return a different inventory every six seconds and poll every second: the inventory should keep advancing even when retries begin before earlier observations finish. Complete a newer observation before an older one, including across clock rollback, and confirm that the older result cannot overwrite it. An old completion must not clear a retry's slot.

Invalidate the inventory or retire its owning workspace during a read and verify that the old observation cannot publish. A superseded cold caller receives a newer retained snapshot if one exists, otherwise its own uncached observation without metadata. Cold reads should survive the five-second background deadline and retain local fallback after ACP timeout. Deletion must use current inventory; enablement must preserve catalog identity even inside the ordinary read throttle window. Let ACP become unavailable or return initialized inventory with errors and confirm retained data keeps its contents and observation timestamp while age increases. Without a retained snapshot, verify successful local fallback, and initialized:false when both sources fail; valid empty inventories should still succeed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original baseline showed no revalidation at 4,999 ms and a blocking read at 5,000 ms. Independent follow-up reproduction at c136ce2 found that changing 2.5-second observations advanced through child-2/3/4, while changing 6-second observations stayed at child-1 for all three warm polls. The corrected regression now passes both timing arms, continuous one-second polling, and out-of-order completion with clock rollback.

Build, bundle, full typecheck, targeted lint/format and 182 facade/regression tests passed on the current repair. Independent regression verification (22/22) and built-CLI HTTP smoke passed. The erroneous initialized reply was reproduced on the prior head in three failing cases; removing only the new publication error guard makes the warm-retention test fail again. The HTTP smoke does not inject erroneous ACP replies; those are tested at the facade boundary. On the previous revision, the 1,900-test HTTP/startup run had 1,898 passes and two socket/502 failures; both failed cases passed in isolation. That broader run was not repeated for this repair.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Build/bundle/typecheck/lint/format, 182 facade/regression tests and independent HTTP smoke passed. Broader HTTP/startup results above belong to the previous revision. |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Earlier-head facade/server suites and HTTP smoke passed; see prior validation comments. Current revision awaits CI. |

## Risk & Scope

- The five-second background slot deadline does not cancel ACP execution. Late observations can publish under generation and publication-order guards; invalidated observations cannot publish. Cold and mutation observations can wait for ACP's configured request timeout plus local fallback.
- Observation age includes collection time and does not prove filesystem or session freshness. `refreshing` describes the shared slot, excluding observations still running after slot timeout.
- Successful explicit preheat invalidates retained inventory, including an already-live child. Closed or draining workspace runtimes reject reads. A deletion whose catalog cannot be enumerated fails with 503 rather than claiming the Skill does not exist.
- Foreground mutation fallback refreshes the local enumerator to observe external installations; repeated mutations may enumerate repeatedly. Status reads do not invoke session-affecting Skill refresh commands. No idle polling or frontend timer is introduced.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skills-snapshot-background-refresh/docs/design/workspace-skills-background-refresh.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skills-snapshot-background-refresh/docs/design/workspace-skills-background-refresh.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #8079 and #8080.

观测年龄包含采集耗时，不代表文件或所有会话的新鲜度；refreshing 仅表示共享位置是否被占用。显式预热成功会使已有快照失效，即使子进程已存活。退役或 draining 工作区拒绝读取。删除时无法枚举清单返回 503。前台变更回退会刷新本地枚举缓存，连续变更可能重复扫描；纯状态查询不调用影响会话的刷新命令，也不增加空闲轮询或前端定时器。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): guard lifecycle renewal scheduling during shutdown (#15208)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Guards the lifecycle coordinator's lease renewal scheduling so a shutdown cannot leave a `RejectedExecutionException` escaping on the shared executor.

## Why it's needed

The failing MySQL lane's only error annotation other than the step's exit code was `java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException` from `SessionLifecycleCoordinator$$Lambda`: a delivery task already queued on the shared executor reached `deliver()` after `@PreDestroy stopRenewals()` had terminated the renewal scheduler, and `scheduleWithFixedDelay` threw on that executor thread. The named CSI integration test passes repeatedly on the base, and the same shutdown exception reproduces locally, so the fix targets the uncaught coordinator task rather than the CSI final-output assertions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the coordinator test class; it should pass without any rejected-task output. To see the old behavior, replace the `RejectedExecutionException` catch with a non-matching exception and rerun the new test; it fails with the same `ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor` rejection.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest` printed `RejectedExecutionException: Task ... SessionLifecycleCoordinator$$Lambda ... rejected from ... [Terminated]`. After: the class passes with no rejected task. The reported CSI test passes 6/6 on the base and 1/1 after the change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.9.11, MySQL 8.4.6, Node 22.23.2.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: a delivery interrupted at shutdown stays claimed until its lease expires; the existing recovery scan re-drives expired leased operations.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full MySQL suite on the self-hosted runner. The full unit suite here hit four sandbox-only failures (`/etc/machine-id` is absent and the POSIX locale cannot encode the Chinese fixture path).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15208

## 为什么需要

失败的 MySQL 任务中，除步骤退出码外唯一的错误注解是来自 `SessionLifecycleCoordinator$$Lambda` 的 `java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException`：一个已排入共享执行器的投递任务在 `@PreDestroy stopRenewals()` 终止续租调度器之后才进入 `deliver()`，于是 `scheduleWithFixedDelay` 在该执行器线程上抛异常。被点名的 CSI 集成测试在基线上反复通过，且该关机异常可在本地复现，因此修复针对未捕获的协调器任务，而不是 CSI 最终输出的断言。

prs.title: feat(cli): attach a terminal to daemon sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`qwen attach` lets a terminal rejoin an existing local daemon session. It selects the daemon discovery record, loads the session through the TypeScript SDK, renders the normalized assistant and thought stream, and sends each line typed on stdin as a prompt. Bearer credentials come from `--token`, `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN`, or the pid-scoped sidecar written by `daemon start --save-token`. The event stream starts before stdin is accepted, readline echoes each line once, and a fresh prompt appears after each turn settles.

This also publishes the SDK's UI event normalizer as its own subpath so the CLI and Web Shell consume the same event projection, while browser consumers that never render normalized events do not pay for it in the default daemon bundle.

## Why it's needed

Daemon sessions outlive the terminal that created them, but until now a terminal user had no direct way to re-enter one: they had to use Web Shell or build an SDK client. This closes that gap without inventing a second transport; it reuses the daemon's existing SSE and prompt routes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start an isolated daemon and create a session, then attach to it:

```bash
QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/qwen-attach-review node packages/cli/dist/index.js daemon start --port 0 --no-web --wait --json
node --input-type=module -e "import { DaemonClient, DaemonSessionClient } from '@qwen-code/sdk/daemon'; const c = new DaemonClient({ baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:<port>' }); const s = await DaemonSessionClient.createOrAttach(c, { cwd: process.cwd() }); console.log(s.session.sessionId);"
QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/qwen-attach-review node packages/cli/dist/index.js attach --port <port> --session <session-id>
```

Confirm that `attach` prints its `> ` prompt, sends a typed line as a prompt, and renders the assistant response. Pressing Ctrl+C must exit the terminal client without stopping the daemon session. Also confirm that no daemon, multiple daemons without `--port`, and a bearer daemon without a token each fail with an actionable message rather than a stack trace.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: there was no terminal path back into a daemon session. After: a live attach run rendered `Yellow`; a clean pty run observed the assistant token `elephant` in the stream (the input did not contain it), a fresh `> ` after the turn, and exactly one echoed input line. Ctrl+C exited only the attach process, and the daemon was stopped separately.

The unit suite covers target selection, token precedence (flag, environment, sidecar), and command registration:

```text
✓ src/commands/attach.test.ts (11 tests)
Test Files  1 passed (1)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Windows and Linux were not tested locally; CI covers them. The live attach check used a macOS pty.

### Environment (optional)

Built CLI from this branch; isolated `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`; local daemon with `--no-web`; session created through the TypeScript SDK.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a text-only terminal client. Pending permission requests are announced with their options but are not approved from the terminal yet, so a tool that needs approval must be completed through Web Shell or another client.
- Not validated / out of scope: session discovery/listing, tool cards, diffs, images, attachments, interactive permission selection, and Windows terminal behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The SDK gains a new `@qwen-code/sdk/daemon/ui` subpath; existing daemon exports are unchanged.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/daemon-attach/docs/design/2026-10-21-daemon-attach.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/daemon-attach/docs/design/2026-10-21-daemon-attach.zh-CN.md). Both versions carry the same scope, decisions, limitations, and verification criteria.

## Linked Issues

N/A — part of the ongoing daemon usability work.

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：终端无法回到已有 daemon session。After：真实 attach 运行渲染了 `Yellow`；一次输入不含预期词的干净 pty 运行在输出中观察到 assistant token `elephant`，turn 后出现新的 `> `，输入回显恰好一次。随后 Ctrl+C 只退出 attach 进程，daemon 由单独命令停止。

## 风险与范围
