prs.title: fix(cli): keep reaping a review command's tree on a busy machine and under old bash
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Two fixes to the reaping wrapper that #15352 put around each review build-test command. Both come from the interrupt failure reported in the review of #15367.

- **The process walk no longer stops early on a busy machine.** The wrapper passed awk the expanded `/proc/[0-9]*/stat` list. awk stops at the first file it cannot open: mawk (Debian's and Ubuntu's awk), gawk 4.0 and busybox awk all do. A process that exits between the glob and the read leaves exactly such a file. Nothing after that file is read, wherever it falls in the list, and on a busy machine something exits during almost every walk: in the measurements below, the command's tree went unkilled every time. The files now go through `cat`, which skips one that has vanished. The `ps` branch (macOS) is unchanged.
- **The interrupt test accepts bash's exit 130.** bash before 5.0, which includes macOS's `/bin/sh` (bash 3.2), exits 130 on the re-raised SIGINT instead of dying of it. The test expected `signal === 'SIGINT'`, so it fails on macOS. The wrapper's doc comment notes the difference.

## Why it's needed

The reap is what keeps a timed-out suite's workers from running on unattended; #15352 measured 28 GB and the kernel's OOM killer when they did. On an idle machine the walk can finish before anything exits, which is why the measurements in #15352 saw no leak. Most machines are not idle. On a shared machine in ordinary use, starting about 680 processes a second, the wrapper on `main` left every grandchild running in 40 of 40 runs. The CI runners for this PR's own checks ran at a load of 76–88, and a Web Shell host also runs the daemon serving the review.

The test fix matters because the macOS lane runs only in the nightly schedule, and the workflow treats a red nightly as a blocker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `npx vitest run src/commands/review/build-test.test.ts -t 'takes its process tree'` from `packages/cli`. The new test, `kills the whole tree while older processes exit during the walk`, runs the deadline kill while a loop starts a 1 s `sleep` every 2 ms. The deadline is shorter than a `sleep` lives, so the processes that exit during the walk started before the command did. It skips where there is no `/proc`.
- For the interrupt test under an older bash, run it in a private mount namespace with that bash as `/bin/sh`, so that the host's `/bin/sh` is left alone. As root, with a bash build at `$BASH`:

  ```sh
  printf '#!/usr/bin/bash\nexec %s --posix "$@"\n' "$BASH" > /tmp/sh-old && chmod +x /tmp/sh-old
  unshare -m --propagation private bash -c 'mount --bind /tmp/sh-old /bin/sh &&
    cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/build-test.test.ts -t "takes its process tree"'
  ```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Deadline kills of a command with four `sleep 300` grandchildren, x86_64 Debian 13 (mawk). The figures are grandchildren left running:

| Machine state | `main` | #15367 | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A shared machine in ordinary use: load 0.5–1.7, about 640 processes, about 680 new pids a second from other work. 2 × 20 runs, alternating | **80 of 80, twice** | **80 of 80, twice** | 0 of 80, twice |
| Older processes exiting during the walk: a loop starting `sleep 1` every 2 ms, 600 ms deadline (the new test's shape). 20 runs | **80 of 80** | — | 0 of 80 |
| The same loop with `sleep 0.5`, 300 ms deadline. 30 runs | **120 of 120** | **120 of 120** | 0 of 120 |

At a quiet moment the walk can finish before anything exits; an earlier run on this machine saw 0 of 120 with #15367's wrapper. The measurements in #15352 were on an otherwise idle host, which is why they saw no leak.

awk given a missing file before a readable one prints nothing for the readable one. mawk 1.3.4 exits 2, gawk 4.0.2 (CentOS 7) exits 2 with `fatal: cannot open file`, and busybox awk exits 1.

The new test fails on `main`'s walk in 3 of 3 runs and passes with this change. A failing run no longer leaks its grandchildren: each one is checked, and `gone` kills any it finds alive.

The three tests that were already there, run with each bash as `/bin/sh` (musl builds from the `bash:<version>` images, in POSIX mode):

| `/bin/sh` | `main` | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bash 3.2.57 (macOS's version) | interrupt test fails: `expected null to be 'SIGINT'` | pass |
| bash 4.2.53 | interrupt test fails: `expected null to be 'SIGINT'` | pass |
| bash 5.2.37 | pass | pass |
| dash (Ubuntu CI) | pass | pass |

With this PR, all four tests pass under bash 3.2 and 4.2 as `/bin/sh`, the new test included.

A driver that starts the wrapper with default signal dispositions and then signals it, on an otherwise idle machine, gave the following results. On macOS, 3.2.57, 4.2.53, 4.2.46 and 5.2.37, the `main` wrapper and the one in #15367 gave the same results. Versions 4.3, 4.4 and 5.0 were run with the #15367 wrapper only.

| Shell as `sh` | SIGINT | SIGTERM (the deadline) | Grandchild after either |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bash 3.2.57 on macOS 10.15 (the real `/bin/sh`) | exit 130 | dies of SIGTERM | gone |
| bash 4.2.46 on CentOS 7 (gawk 4.0.2, procps-ng) | exit 130 | dies of SIGTERM | gone |
| bash 3.2.57, 4.2.53, 4.3, 4.4 | exit 130 | dies of SIGTERM | gone |
| bash 5.0, 5.2.37 | dies of SIGINT | dies of SIGTERM | gone |

The review command tests pass (132 files), as do eslint with `--max-warnings 0` and the cli typecheck.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ The wrapper was run with the real `/bin/sh` on macOS 10.15 (bash 3.2.57). The vitest suite was not run there, because that machine has no Node. The churn test skips on macOS, where the walk uses `ps` |
| 🪟 Windows | ➖ Unchanged (these tests skip on win32) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ x86_64, Node 22, with dash and with bash 3.2 / 4.2 / 5.2 as `/bin/sh`; CentOS 7 container for bash 4.2.46 and gawk 4.0.2 |

### Environment (optional)

x86_64 Debian 13 (mawk 1.3.4), Node 22; bash builds from the official `bash:3.2`, `4.2`, `4.3`, `4.4`, `5.0` and `5.2` images; `centos:7`; macOS 10.15.7.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The walk adds a `cat` process.
  - The interrupt test no longer tells a re-raised SIGINT from a plain `exit 130`. bash before 5.0 does not make that distinction itself. The grandchild check, which is what the test is for, is unchanged.
  - The new test starts a few hundred short `sleep` processes for about 1.3 s, all in one process group that it kills afterwards.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The macOS nightly itself. It runs after this is merged.
  - On bash before 5.0, a killed command's output also gains a job notice such as `sh: line 2: … Killed ( eval "$cmd" )`. That is cosmetic and left as is.
  - This PR and #15367 both edit `REAPING_SHELL`, on lines one apart. Whichever merges second needs `main` merged in.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15352; raised in the review of #15367.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

对 #15352 给每条评审 build-test 命令加的回收包装器做两处修复，都源自 #15367 评审中报告的中断失败。

- **繁忙机器上，进程遍历不再中途停下。** 包装器原来把展开后的 `/proc/[0-9]*/stat` 列表直接交给 awk。awk 遇到第一个打不开的文件就会停下：mawk（Debian 和 Ubuntu 的默认 awk）、gawk 4.0 和 busybox awk 都是这样。在 glob 展开之后、读取之前退出的进程，正好会留下这样一个文件。不管这个文件排在列表的哪个位置，它后面的文件都不会再被读取。繁忙的机器上几乎每次遍历期间都有进程退出：在下面的测量里，命令的进程树每一次都没被杀掉。现在这些文件改为经由 `cat` 读取，`cat` 会跳过已消失的文件。`ps` 分支（macOS）不变。
- **中断测试接受 bash 的退出码 130。** bash 5.0 之前的版本（包括 macOS 的 `/bin/sh`，即 bash 3.2）收到重新发出的 SIGINT 时，会以 130 退出，而不是死于该信号。测试原来断言 `signal === 'SIGINT'`，所以在 macOS 上失败。包装器的文档注释写明了这一差异。

## Why it's needed

回收的作用，就是让超时套件的 worker 不会在无人看管的情况下继续运行；#15352 实测过它们继续运行时涨到 28 GB、触发内核 OOM killer 的情况。在空闲机器上，遍历可能在任何进程退出之前就完成，所以 #15352 的测量没有看到泄漏。但大多数机器并不空闲。在一台正常使用、每秒启动约 680 个进程的共享机器上，`main` 上的包装器在 40 次运行中每次都让所有孙进程继续运行。本 PR 自己的 CI runner 负载在 76–88 之间，Web Shell 主机上还运行着为评审服务的守护进程。

测试的修复也有必要：macOS 的 lane 只在 nightly 定时任务里运行，而 workflow 把 nightly 变红视为 blocker。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- 在 `packages/cli` 下执行 `npx vitest run src/commands/review/build-test.test.ts -t 'takes its process tree'`。新测试 `kills the whole tree while older processes exit during the walk` 会在一个每 2 毫秒启动一个 1 秒 `sleep` 的循环运行期间，执行一次时限杀进程。时限比 `sleep` 的寿命短，所以遍历期间退出的进程都早于命令启动。没有 `/proc` 的平台会跳过这个测试。
- 要在旧版 bash 下跑中断测试，可以在私有 mount namespace 里把那个 bash 当作 `/bin/sh`，这样宿主机的 `/bin/sh` 不受影响。以 root 身份执行，`$BASH` 是一个 bash 可执行文件：

  ```sh
  printf '#!/usr/bin/bash\nexec %s --posix "$@"\n' "$BASH" > /tmp/sh-old && chmod +x /tmp/sh-old
  unshare -m --propagation private bash -c 'mount --bind /tmp/sh-old /bin/sh &&
    cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/build-test.test.ts -t "takes its process tree"'
  ```

### Evidence (Before & After)

对带有 4 个 `sleep 300` 孙进程的命令执行时限杀进程，x86_64 Debian 13（mawk）。表中数字是仍在运行的孙进程：

| 机器状态 | `main` | #15367 | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 一台正常使用中的共享机器：负载 0.5–1.7，约 640 个进程，其他工作每秒产生约 680 个新 pid。2 × 20 次，交替运行 | **两次都是 80 / 80** | **两次都是 80 / 80** | 两次都是 0 / 80 |
| 遍历期间有更早的进程退出：一个每 2 毫秒启动一个 `sleep 1` 的循环，时限 600 毫秒（新测试的形态）。20 次 | **80 / 80** | — | 0 / 80 |
| 同样的循环换成 `sleep 0.5`，时限 300 毫秒。30 次 | **120 / 120** | **120 / 120** | 0 / 120 |

在机器安静的时刻，遍历可能在任何进程退出之前就完成；之前在这台机器上用 #15367 的包装器跑过一次，结果是 0 / 120。#15352 的测量是在一台没有其他负载的主机上做的，所以没有看到泄漏。

当一个缺失的文件排在一个可读文件之前时，awk 对那个可读文件什么也不输出：mawk 1.3.4 以 2 退出，gawk 4.0.2（CentOS 7）以 2 退出并报 `fatal: cannot open file`，busybox awk 以 1 退出。

新测试在 `main` 的遍历方式下 3 次运行全部失败，加上本改动后通过。失败的运行也不会再泄漏孙进程：每个孙进程都会被检查，`gone` 会杀掉仍然存活的那个。

原有的三个测试，分别用各版本 bash 作为 `/bin/sh` 运行（使用 `bash:<版本>` 镜像里的 musl 构建，POSIX 模式）：

| `/bin/sh` | `main` | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bash 3.2.57（macOS 的版本） | 中断测试失败：`expected null to be 'SIGINT'` | 通过 |
| bash 4.2.53 | 中断测试失败：`expected null to be 'SIGINT'` | 通过 |
| bash 5.2.37 | 通过 | 通过 |
| dash（Ubuntu CI） | 通过 | 通过 |

加上本 PR 后，在 bash 3.2 和 4.2 作为 `/bin/sh` 时，包括新测试在内的 4 个测试全部通过。

用一个以默认信号处置启动包装器、再给它发信号的驱动脚本，在没有其他负载的机器上得到下面的结果。在 macOS、3.2.57、4.2.53、4.2.46 和 5.2.37 上，`main` 的包装器和 #15367 里的包装器结果相同；4.3、4.4 和 5.0 只用 #15367 的包装器跑过：

| 作为 `sh` 的 shell | SIGINT | SIGTERM（时限） | 两种情况下的孙进程 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| macOS 10.15 上的 bash 3.2.57（真实的 `/bin/sh`） | 以 130 退出 | 死于 SIGTERM | 已回收 |
| CentOS 7 上的 bash 4.2.46（gawk 4.0.2、procps-ng） | 以 130 退出 | 死于 SIGTERM | 已回收 |
| bash 3.2.57、4.2.53、4.3、4.4 | 以 130 退出 | 死于 SIGTERM | 已回收 |
| bash 5.0、5.2.37 | 死于 SIGINT | 死于 SIGTERM | 已回收 |

评审命令的测试全部通过（132 个文件），eslint `--max-warnings 0` 和 cli 类型检查通过。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 在 macOS 10.15 上用真实的 `/bin/sh`（bash 3.2.57）运行了包装器。没有在那台机器上跑 vitest，因为它没有 Node。macOS 上遍历走的是 `ps`，抖动测试会跳过 |
| 🪟 Windows | ➖ 不变（这些测试在 win32 上跳过） |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ x86_64，Node 22，分别用 dash 和 bash 3.2 / 4.2 / 5.2 作为 `/bin/sh`；用 CentOS 7 容器验证了 bash 4.2.46 和 gawk 4.0.2 |

### Environment (optional)

x86_64 Debian 13（mawk 1.3.4），Node 22；bash 来自官方 `bash:3.2`、`4.2`、`4.3`、`4.4`、`5.0`、`5.2` 镜像；`centos:7`；macOS 10.15.7。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：
  - 遍历多了一个 `cat` 进程。
  - 中断测试不再区分"重新发出的 SIGINT"和"直接 `exit 130`"。bash 5.0 之前的版本本身就不做这个区分。测试真正要验证的孙进程检查没有变。
  - 新测试会在约 1.3 秒内启动几百个短命的 `sleep` 进程，它们都在同一个进程组里，测试结束后会被整组杀掉。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - macOS nightly 本身。它会在本 PR 合入之后运行。
  - 在 bash 5.0 之前的版本上，被杀命令的输出里还会多一行作业通知，例如 `sh: line 2: … Killed ( eval "$cmd" )`。这只是外观问题，保持不变。
  - 本 PR 和 #15367 都修改了 `REAPING_SHELL`，改动位置只隔一行。后合入的那个需要先合并 `main`。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## Linked Issues

#15352 的后续；在 #15367 的评审中提出。

</details>

prs.title: feat(runtime-broker): add HTTP-backed external scratch workers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in `external-scratch` Runtime provider that delegates Session worker placement to an operator-run HTTP service. The Broker persists a deterministic request handle before provisioning, retains attestation and ownership checks, and retries the original resource after a lost provision response or transient confirmation failure. Infrastructure SDKs remain outside this repository.

This experimental increment implements allocation, attestation and recovery. Source inspection shows that, in the Spring server, a Session without a Workspace binding has no Hosted tool profile: Session creation does not warm a worker, while ordinary Turn dispatch warms one asynchronously without establishing a Hosted tool consumer. That Spring path has not been observed in a running integration. Hosted Workspace integration and production remote-tool use remain follow-up work.

## Why it's needed

The intended deployment keeps Managed Agent Server and Hosted Harness central while allocating tool workers on an existing sandbox or container platform. The HTTP boundary lets an operator own allocation without adding vendor SDKs to the Broker. This increment establishes that placement boundary; it does not complete the remote-tool workflow.

The protocol has provision and read-only observe endpoints. There is no release-to-kill mapping because release can be invoked by an operation that has lost ownership. The provider must persist the mapping from each logical request handle to its original physical resource.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configuration remains opt-in, requires session isolation, accepts a worker-local cwd without requiring that directory on the Java host, and rejects managed Workspace features.
- Losing the first provision response after allocation must retain the request identity and logical handle; retry must not allocate a replacement worker.
- Temporary observation uncertainty must preserve the original READY binding for confirmation. A later positive observation must independently re-attest the same worker; endpoint or identity drift must be rejected.
- Recreating Broker and provisioner instances must observe the original handle without allocating a replacement. The new integration scenario reuses in-memory repositories; it does not establish whole-process or database crash durability.
- Real file write, edit and read operations should reach the CLI worker. Retrying the original write must not overwrite a later edit. These Broker-level operations do not establish a Spring Hosted tool consumer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original failure at `6ae13e2e` was fixed by `48de7795`, which re-acquires the Session after Broker recreation before issuing new executions. The test retains the binding, lease, single-allocation, duplicate-write and file-read assertions.

Completed evidence is commit-specific:
- `48de7795`: [full Java run 39938851567](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567) completed successfully. [Hosted fault-gate job 120365028331](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567/job/120365028331) reports `ExternalRuntimeWorkerFaultGateTest`: 1 test, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped.
- `fcd18bdb`: [Hosted fault-gate job 120425385493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39954747157/job/120425385493) also executed that test successfully. That workflow had an EventTransport multi-node failure; its rerun is separate and is not counted as a full-workflow pass. The cause of that failure is not yet established.

These historical passes do not certify later commits. The latest review response below links the full-tier run for the documentation update's exact head; its result remains pending. No current-head pass or merge approval is claimed.

The scenario uses actual Broker/HTTP client/CLI worker code and a loopback operator fixture, with shared in-memory repositories across instance recreation. It does not prove vendor sandbox interoperability, whole-process/database crash durability, or Spring Hosted tool execution. Earlier local reports with incomplete sibling-SDK provenance remain historical only.

The bilingual design now documents the re-acquire requirement and the source-inspected caller boundary: Spring scratch Turn dispatch warms a worker but does not establish a Hosted tool consumer. Workspace caller acquisition paths do not prove external-scratch restart integration.

## Notes

- UNKNOWN outcomes retain retry eligibility; GONE does not authorize a replacement or stopped-writer cleanup.
- Closing a Session does not stop its worker. Physical resource lifetime remains the provider's TTL or operator responsibility.
- Each Broker retains at most 1024 placement seeds. Closing Sessions and provider TTL expiry do not evict those entries. Exhaustion rejects a new seed with retryable HTTP 503 `runtime_external_capacity`; closing the Broker clears its cache but does not stop remote workers.
- Vendor resource allocation, remote image/entrypoint/lifetime validation, Workspace storage registration, boot-v2, public Hosted tools, shell capture/publication and automatic stopped-writer recovery remain outside this increment.
- Opt-in only, with no database migration and no change to existing provider defaults. Protocol v1 uses a logical `{requestId: provisionRequestId}` handle which the provider must bind durably to the original resource.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.zh-CN.md).

## Related Issues

Related to #15247. This does not close the broader Hosted Workspace objective.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增可选的 `external-scratch` Runtime provider，将 Session worker 的分配交给运营方提供的 HTTP 服务。Broker 在分配前持久化确定性的请求 handle，保留认证和所有权检查，并在分配响应丢失或暂时无法确认时重试原资源。厂商 SDK 留在仓库外部。

本实验性增量实现分配、认证和恢复。源码显示，Spring 服务中没有 Workspace 绑定的 Session 不带 Hosted 工具 profile：创建 Session 不预热 worker，普通 Turn 会异步预热，但不会因此建立 Hosted 工具消费者。这条 Spring 路径尚未经过实际运行验证。Hosted Workspace 集成及生产远程工具使用留待后续。

## 为什么需要

目标部署将 Managed Agent Server 与 Hosted Harness 保持在中心服务，通过既有沙箱或容器平台分配工具 worker。HTTP 边界让运营方负责资源分配，无需向 Broker 引入厂商 SDK。本增量建立分配边界，尚未完成整个远程工具流程。

协议提供 provision 和只读 observe。release 不映射为销毁资源，因为失去所有权的操作也可能调用 release。provider 必须持久保存逻辑请求 handle 与原物理资源的对应关系。

## 评审验证计划

- 配置保持可选启用，要求 Session 隔离；worker-local cwd 不要求在 Java 主机存在，且拒绝受管 Workspace 功能。
- 首次分配后丢失响应，重试应保持请求身份和逻辑 handle，不重复创建 worker。
- 暂时无法观测时保留原 READY 绑定；恢复观测后对同一 worker 重新认证，并拒绝 endpoint 或身份漂移。
- 重建 Broker 和 provisioner 实例时只观测原 handle，不重新分配。新集成场景复用内存仓库，不证明完整进程或数据库崩溃恢复。
- 真实文件写入、编辑和读取应到达 CLI worker；重试旧写入不能覆盖后续编辑。这些 Broker 级操作不证明 Spring Hosted 工具消费者已接通。

## 验证证据

`6ae13e2e` 上的原始失败已由 `48de7795` 修复：Broker 实例重建后，测试先重新 acquire Session，再创建新执行，保留 binding、lease、单次分配、重复写保护和文件读取断言。

已完成的证据按提交区分：
- `48de7795`：[完整 Java run 39938851567](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567) 成功；[Hosted fault-gate job 120365028331](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567/job/120365028331) 中 `ExternalRuntimeWorkerFaultGateTest` 实际执行，1 项、0 失败、0 错误、0 跳过。
- `fcd18bdb`：[Hosted fault-gate job 120425385493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39954747157/job/120425385493) 也实际执行并通过该测试。该工作流另有 EventTransport 多节点失败，其重跑单独处理，不计作完整工作流通过；该失败根因尚未确定。

历史通过不代表后续提交通过。下方最新评审回复提供本次文档更新对应 head 的 full-tier run 链接，结果仍待完成，不宣称当前 head 已通过或可以合并。

测试使用真实 Broker、HTTP client 和 CLI worker，以及 loopback 运营方 fixture；实例重建间共享内存仓库。它不证明厂商沙箱互通、完整进程或数据库崩溃持久性，也不证明 Spring Hosted 工具执行。此前未完整确定 sibling SDK 来源的本地报告仅作历史参考。

双语设计文档已补充重新 acquire 的要求及源码核实的调用方边界：Spring scratch Turn 分发会预热 worker，但没有建立 Hosted 工具消费者；Workspace 调用方已有的 acquire 流程不能证明 external-scratch 重启集成。

## 注意事项

- UNKNOWN 保持可重试；GONE 不授权重新分配或清理 stopped writer。
- 关闭 Session 不停止 worker，物理资源寿命由 provider TTL 或运营方管理。
- 每个 Broker 最多保留 1024 个 placement seed。Session 关闭或 provider TTL 到期不会释放缓存槽位。容量耗尽时，新 seed 返回可重试 HTTP 503 `runtime_external_capacity`；关闭 Broker 清空缓存，但不停止远程 worker。
- 厂商分配、远程镜像/入口/进程寿命、Workspace 存储注册、boot-v2、公开 Hosted 工具、shell capture/publication 及自动 stopped-writer 恢复不在本增量范围。
- 可选启用，无数据库迁移，现有 provider 默认值不变。协议 v1 使用 `{requestId: provisionRequestId}` 逻辑 handle，要求 provider 持久绑定原资源。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.zh-CN.md)。

关联 #15247；本 PR 不关闭更完整的 Hosted Workspace 目标。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): shrink tool results to the headroom left before auto-compaction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is close to auto-compaction, shrink the next request's tool results to its remaining headroom. Use only the same chat's last successful usage report for the current provider route and unchanged history prefix. System instructions, session context and tool declarations must match that report; equivalent refreshes preserve it, while changed inputs and obsolete in-flight responses invalidate it without clearing usage counters. Explicit truncation settings take priority.

Measure headroom against auto-compaction and share the selected budget across the batch, charging protected text, media and framing first. Keep the tighter aggregate budget and avoid cutting results twice. If an allocation cannot fit a complete truncation notice, preserve the batch for normal compaction and hard-limit admission. When an artifact path cannot fit, use a complete pointerless notice. Save full originals through the existing best-effort persistence path whenever results are shortened. Before persistence, resolve any read that the selected preview would shorten. If a regular-chat read cannot be traced to a path in model history, preserve the entire batch for normal compaction and overflow handling so worker cache residency still matches the full content the model receives.

Defaults stay at 25,000 characters / 1,000 lines. Result-size accounting moved to #13652. Design: [English](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.zh-CN.md).

## Why it is needed

#2566: static tool budgets can push a long session over the compaction trigger prematurely. A hard-ceiling anchor cuts too late; an obsolete usage anchor cuts against the wrong context. At the other extreme, sub-notice allocations erased failure diagnostics and could advertise a nonexistent partial artifact path. A supported PreToolUse repair can supply a read path while recorded model arguments remain `{}`; shortening that result without notifying the worker could then make a later read incorrectly omit the full body.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Near the auto trigger, return a large result: it should shrink to available headroom. Far from or past auto, or after restore/route change/explicit settings, it should keep the static behavior.
- Change fixed inputs, including during a held response: stale usage should not reanchor. Equivalent refreshes should retain the headroom anchor and usage counters.
- Leave only enough headroom for an empty or incomplete notice: original output and error should reach normal compaction admission. A larger but path-insufficient preview should contain a complete notice, a nonempty error indication and no partial recovery path.
- Check the complete persisted original after a meaningful cut and verify user/protected text and previous file-read rights survive.
- Repair an empty-argument read through PreToolUse: the full result should remain in request/history before persistence, and a later unchanged-file placeholder should be valid. With a resolvable original path, normal shortening should notify the worker, preserve prior-read rights and allow a subsequent full reread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

[Current before/after report and actual tmux excerpts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599#issuecomment-6080873864). The current repair passed 35 focused pressure cases, affected Core build/typecheck and static checks. The first full-file run passed 589/590; a media fixture lacking its recorded read call was corrected, and its original media headroom assertions plus inode invalidation passed in the final pressure group. No fresh all-590 pass is claimed.

Actual compiled-Core API/tmux controls exercise the hook and separate worker cache: repaired original `{}` preserves 20,033 characters, while resolvable original path still shortens to 2,576 characters, notifies the worker and rereads the full body. Each makes two controlled generation calls; all 11 watched compiled modules loaded with matching hashes. The generator and compaction boundary are controlled (NOOP), with observer loader/assertion failures retained. The resolved-control mutable cache receipt reflects a later reread, not a frozen after-cut snapshot. Earlier tiny-budget and CLI/TUI evidence stays tied to its tested commit.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, current commit `224c21e8212e33e9889a6c3d4dfead08f3757c15`. At that commit the focused suites pass (`llm-chat` 623, `tool-response-finalizer` 48, `microcompact` 103, plus `truncation`/`goal-turn-integration`/`fileReadCache`/`agent` 531) with Core typecheck, ESLint and Prettier clean; the R12-1 and R13-1 regression cases were mutation-checked red against the pre-fix code. Current necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

The tiny-budget fallback and unresolved-read whole-batch preservation can require normal compaction instead of suppressing text. The latter deliberately may exceed the selected finite character budget; existing compaction, hard admission and overflow handling apply, potentially adding text or compaction. It does not guarantee exact token admission. A pointerless preview omits detailed content when it cannot fit; persistence remains best effort under existing disk limits. Shortened file reads disarm quote-back residency while retaining prior-read rights; uniquely correlated shell shortening leaves file-read residency intact. Existing fork ownership remains unchanged. Unresolved would-cut reads in regular chat now preserve the full batch before persistence; there is no worker API change or blanket cache clear that revokes prior-read rights. The current controlled-Core fixture does not establish a new CLI, browser, real-model or cross-platform result. Line caps and defaults do not adapt.

## Linked Issues

Closes #2566
Result-size accounting split to #13652 (#11536).

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

接近自动压缩时，根据同一聊天、同一路由且固定输入和历史仍有效的成功用量报告缩小下一请求的工具结果；等价刷新保留依据，内容变化或在途旧响应不重建过期依据，也不清空用量计数。保护文本、媒体和结构先计入余量，与聚合预算取较紧值且不重复裁剪。放不下完整提示时保留原文交给压缩/硬上限准入；完整路径放不下时只发送完整无指针提示，正常裁剪仍尽力保存完整原文。默认25k字符/1000行保持不变，结果统计另在#13652。

本次修复 PreToolUse 补齐实际读取路径、历史原始参数仍为 `{}` 的缓存缺口。落盘前先检查最终预览将裁剪的读取，普通聊天无法定位路径时保留整个批次，确保 worker 驻留状态与模型实际收到的内容一致；可定位读取仍正常裁剪、通知 worker 并保留先读权限，没有新增 worker API。例外批次可能超过有限字符预算，交由正常压缩、硬准入或溢出处理，可能增加文本和压缩，不能声称精确 token 准入。双语设计同步记录。

当前提交 `224c21e8212e3` 的聚焦套件全部通过（`llm-chat` 623、`tool-response-finalizer` 48、`microcompact` 103，以及 `truncation`/`goal-turn-integration`/`fileReadCache`/`agent` 531），Core 类型检查、ESLint、Prettier 干净；R12-1/R13-1 的回归用例均经变异验证在修复前为红。首次全文件589/590通过，媒体fixture未记录读取调用；补齐路径关联后，原媒体预算断言和inode解除断言在最终压力组通过，未冒称全590重新通过。实际编译Core API/tmux中，修正读取保留20,033字符；可定位读取仍裁到2,576字符、通知worker，随后完整重读。每种两次受控生成调用、11个加载模块散列匹配；generator/NOOP压缩是控制边界。保留loader和观察断言失败及修正后的结果。控制中二次读取会更新缓存对象，不能将序列化结果视为裁剪后的冻结快照。历史极小预算及CLI/TUI证据保留原提交，本轮不冒称新CLI、Docker、浏览器、真实模型或真实压缩验收。CI、人工批准、合并和发布独立判断。

prs.title: fix(cua): sign Windows UIAccess workers before publishing
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Branch dry runs now test-sign the optional Windows UIAccess worker by submitting it directly to the SignPath REST API with the repository's `SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN`, verify the test certificate, package it, and clean-install the SDK with UIAccess explicitly enabled, checking the deployed signature. Release builds keep shipping the unsigned worker and install in ordinary mode, so Windows releases never depend on a production certificate. No signing private key is imported into CI.

Draft criterion updated 2026-10-23: this PR delivers the CI-signed install path. Windows runtime acceptance (native module load on real hardware, interactive UIAccess input, native ARM64 execution) is release acceptance tracked under #14539, not a merge gate for this PR.

## Why it's needed

The UIAccess installer requires a valid signature, but no CI run ever exercised the signed install path. An earlier attempt used SignPath's GitHub connector, which needs the SignPath GitHub App for origin verification; this repository cannot install that App. The `test-signing` policy does not require origin verification, so the direct API works with the existing token. Windows uses ordinary input delivery by default; the certificate requirement applies only when opting into UIAccess with `CUA_DRIVER_USE_UIACCESS=1`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run a branch `workflow_dispatch` with `dry_run=true`. Both Windows jobs must log a completed SignPath signing request, then install the SDK with UIAccess enabled and a `Valid` Program Files worker signature. Tag refs and publishing runs must skip test signing, keep the worker unsigned, and verify that ordinary installation deploys no UIAccess worker. All release and npm publication jobs must stay skipped on dry runs.

Shipping a publicly trusted UIAccess worker needs a certificate from a publicly trusted CA issued to a validated legal entity and is outside this PR. ARM64 build success on an x64 runner does not establish native ARM64 execution.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no CI path signed the worker or exercised the signed install, and the GitHub connector failed with `Failed to retrieve GitHub App token` ([run 39793940639](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39793940639)). After: [run 39809916847](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39809916847) at `f5f3426d` completed SignPath signing requests for both x64 and ARM64 and passed the signed UIAccess SDK install on both. The downloaded x64 worker carries signer `Test certificate for 'Qwen Code [OSS]'`, SHA-1 `0B27B4BA9D646BCDB1FD59B4F229C0DAA7E8EEF0`. The run's later `@qwen-code/cua-sdk package dry-run` failed because `0.26.0` is already on npm (`You cannot publish over the previously published versions`); it is unrelated to this change.

Local: the three workflow suites (153 passed, 2 skipped), formatting, PowerShell parsing and actionlint (only the pre-existing `macos-26` label warning). Earlier at `51ba47dc`: 9 native-assets tests and 29 Windows fixture-based SDK tests passed. [Evidence and dispositions](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12442#issuecomment-6341752216).

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| macOS | Local workflow/static checks; signer extraction from the CI-signed x64 worker |
| Windows | CI: test signing plus signed UIAccess SDK install on x64 and ARM64 (x64 runner). Remote host: 29/29 fixture SDK tests; native load and interactive UIAccess input not yet run |
| Linux | No new runtime claim |

## Risk & Scope

- Test trust is imported only into disposable hosted Windows runners after the signer fingerprint matches. Release builds never call SignPath and never import a root.
- The packaged-install check uses a local native payload override, so it does not cover public download/checksum behavior. Native module loading on a real machine, UIAccess input and native ARM64 execution remain acceptance work.
- No release, npm publication, new driver version, installer redesign, or retroactive repair of unsigned assets is included.
- Design: [English](docs/design/windows-cua-signpath.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/windows-cua-signpath.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #12394 and #14539. Keep release acceptance open until a publicly trusted signing source and Windows runtime validation are in place.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

分支 dry run 现在用仓库的 `SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN` 直接调用 SignPath REST API，对可选的 Windows UIAccess worker 做测试签名，校验测试证书后打包，并显式启用 UIAccess 全新安装 SDK、检查部署后的签名。发布构建继续携带未签名 worker 并以普通模式安装，因此 Windows 发布不依赖生产证书。CI 不导入私有签名密钥。

2026-10-23 更新 Draft 判据：本 PR 交付 CI 签名安装链路。Windows 运行时验收（真机原生模块加载、交互式 UIAccess 输入、ARM64 实机执行）属于发布验收，在 #14539 中继续跟踪，不作为本 PR 的合入门禁。

## 为什么需要

UIAccess 安装器要求有效签名，但此前没有任何 CI 运行验证过签名安装路径。早先尝试使用 SignPath 的 GitHub 连接器，它需要 SignPath GitHub App 做来源验证，本仓库无法安装该 App。`test-signing` 策略不要求来源验证，因此可直接用现有 Token 调用 API。Windows 默认使用普通输入路径；证书要求只适用于通过 `CUA_DRIVER_USE_UIACCESS=1` 主动启用 UIAccess 的情况。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

以 `dry_run=true` 执行分支 `workflow_dispatch`。两个 Windows job 都必须记录已完成的 SignPath 签名请求，随后在启用 UIAccess 的情况下安装 SDK，Program Files 中的 worker 签名状态为 `Valid`。tag ref 和发布运行必须跳过测试签名、保持 worker 未签名，并检查普通安装不部署 UIAccess worker。dry run 中所有 release 和 npm 发布 job 必须跳过。

发布公开受信任的 UIAccess worker，需要由公开受信任 CA 签发给经过验证的法律实体的证书，不在本 PR 范围内。x64 runner 上 ARM64 构建成功不能证明 ARM64 实机运行成功。

### 证据（Before & After）

之前：没有 CI 路径签名 worker 或验证签名安装，GitHub 连接器报错 `Failed to retrieve GitHub App token`（[run 39793940639](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39793940639)）。之后：`f5f3426d` 上的 [run 39809916847](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39809916847) 为 x64 和 ARM64 完成 SignPath 签名请求，两者的签名 UIAccess SDK 安装均通过。下载的 x64 worker 签名者为 `Test certificate for 'Qwen Code [OSS]'`，SHA-1 `0B27B4BA9D646BCDB1FD59B4F229C0DAA7E8EEF0`。该运行后续的 `@qwen-code/cua-sdk package dry-run` 失败，原因是 `0.26.0` 已发布到 npm（`You cannot publish over the previously published versions`），与本改动无关。

本地：三个工作流测试套件（153 项通过，2 项跳过）、格式、PowerShell 语法解析和 actionlint（仅既有的 `macos-26` 标签警告）。此前在 `51ba47dc`：9 项 native-assets 测试和 29 项 Windows fixture SDK 测试通过。[证据与分类](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12442#issuecomment-6341752216)。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| macOS | 本地工作流与静态检查；从 CI 签名的 x64 worker 中提取签名者 |
| Windows | CI：x64 与 ARM64 测试签名及签名 UIAccess SDK 安装（x64 runner）。远程主机：29/29 fixture SDK 测试；原生加载与交互式 UIAccess 输入尚未执行 |
| Linux | 不声明新的运行验证 |

## 风险与范围

- 测试信任仅在签名者指纹匹配后导入一次性托管 Windows runner。发布构建从不调用 SignPath，也不导入根证书。
- 打包安装检查使用本地原生产物覆盖，不覆盖公开下载与校验和流程。真实机器上的原生模块加载、UIAccess 输入及 ARM64 实机运行仍需验收。
- 不包含 release、npm 发布、新驱动版本、安装器重构或旧未签名产物的追溯修复。
- 设计：[English](docs/design/windows-cua-signpath.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/windows-cua-signpath.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issues

Refs #12394 和 #14539。公开受信任的签名来源与 Windows 运行验证到位前，发布验收保持开放。

</details>

prs.title: perf(memory): retain unchanged legacy catalog snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keep an unchanged legacy memory catalog at a stable position in conversation history. A loaded update appends a full snapshot that supersedes older catalogs, including removed entries. Resume restores the snapshots, repeated unchanged Retry records reconstruct as one snapshot, and requests with legacy memory suppressed omit catalog snapshots. Compression and output budgets include visible pending and retained snapshots, including after failure, replay and history restoration.

## Why it's needed

#15020 protects the DashScope cache anchor by skipping the volatile catalog-bearing message, but the request-only catalog still moves behind new turns and tool results. Stable snapshots let later requests reuse that part of the prefix without moving mutable catalog data into the system prompt. Catalog context also stays separate from real user intent in permissions, titles and summaries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable legacy memory with indexed project and user topics. Send consecutive prompts and trigger a real file read. The unchanged catalog should remain once at its original history position, including during tool continuation.
2. Load a changed catalog and resume the session. The old snapshot should remain unchanged; the new full snapshot should append once. A later return to an earlier catalog version must still append when it differs from the latest retained version.
3. Disable legacy memory or switch to structured recall. Main and compression requests should omit marked catalogs while retaining ordinary user text and pending tool results. Re-enable memory: input budgets must include the now-visible catalogs.
4. Interrupt and retry the original prompt, then resume the same session. Live and restored model history should each contain one unchanged snapshot. The append-only journal may retain two records; user records and parent lineage must remain intact. Fresh plan reminders should still appear when required.
5. Trigger compression and a reply without usage, then continue. A reseeded catalog must contribute to the next budget gate exactly once, including after startup-context restoration; compaction removing the latest snapshot must permit reseeding. Automatic titles should retain real dialogue while excluding hook context and resident-catalog headings.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Final affected-suite validation records **2,462 passes and one existing skip**, with build, bundle, typecheck, scoped lint/format and the normal pre-commit hook passing. Two independent source audits are reconciled to the final candidate. A separate complete bilingual runtime comment records exact identities, retained failures, native Retry/compression observations and historical live measurements. In one live comparison with one warmup and two measured main turns, cached/input rose from **90.797% to 99.591%**, and measured-main uncached input fell **3,276 → 146**. Including warmup and auxiliaries, uncached input rose **41,672 → 48,084**: no overall cost improvement is established. Candidate ran before the completed baseline; cache heat and draining canceled auxiliary responses limit interpretation. Offline native TUI Retry/resume now records **[1,1,1]** snapshots versus **[1,1,2]** before, with both normal exits; provider-backed Retry remains untested. A third clean local pass by the Qwen Code `/review` engine was still running when this PR was opened; Critical claims it returned so far were traced and not substantiated, and its final result will be posted here.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Local build and affected suites; bounded native witnesses and historical CLI/TUI runs, with limits in the runtime comment |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment

macOS arm64. The matched comparison and historical live runs used `qwen3.8-max` through the DashScope-compatible token-plan endpoint; mechanism witnesses use controlled model responses and make no live API calls. Local project-memory fixtures require `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1`.

## Risk & Scope

- Old catalog contents remain in model history until normal compression and in stored transcript records afterward. The latest full snapshot takes precedence. History can grow after updates; this is not a global memory budget or pruning mechanism.
- Refresh timing is unchanged. Re-enabling retained catalogs invalidates older usage counts and temporarily falls back to local estimates. CJK fixtures verify local estimated coverage, not provider-tokenizer accuracy; synthetic usage is not provider telemetry.
- Native compression-filtering evidence covers cold compression only. Shared-path native execution, a final provider-backed Retry pair, independent disk-deletion refresh, other providers and a large-catalog performance matrix remain unvalidated. Historical measurements are not final-candidate measurements.
- No configuration migration is required. Backward resume into older releases was not tested. Non-blocking review notes remain in a separate follow-up comment.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #15027 and #11550. This addresses the moving unchanged catalog; broader provider-aware cost and benchmark work in #15027 remains open. Historical measurement corrections: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15027#issuecomment-6320584483.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

将未变化的旧版记忆目录保留在对话历史的固定位置。加载更新后追加一份完整快照，替代旧目录，包括已删除条目。恢复会话时还原快照，Retry 重复记录中的未变快照重建为一份；禁止访问旧版记忆的请求排除目录快照。压缩和输出预算计入可见的待追加及保留快照，包括失败、重放及历史恢复之后。

## 为什么需要

#15020 在选择 DashScope 缓存锚点时跳过带目录的可变消息，但仅供请求使用的目录仍会移动到新轮次和工具结果之后。稳定快照让后续请求能够复用这部分前缀，无需将可变目录放进系统提示词。权限、标题和摘要中的目录上下文也与真实用户意图区分。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 开启旧版记忆，准备已建立索引的项目和用户主题。连续发送提示词并触发真实文件读取。未变化目录应只在原历史位置出现一次，工具续轮也应如此。
2. 加载更新目录并恢复会话。旧快照保持不变，新完整快照只追加一次。之后回到早期目录版本时，只要与最新保留版本不同，仍应追加。
3. 关闭旧版记忆或切换至结构化召回。主请求和压缩请求应排除标记目录，保留普通用户文本及待处理工具结果。重新启用记忆后，输入预算必须包含现已可见的目录。
4. 中断后重试原始 prompt，再恢复同一会话。Live 和恢复后的模型历史均应包含一份未变快照。仅追加日志可保留两条记录；用户记录和父链必须保持完整。需要时仍应出现新的计划提醒。
5. 触发压缩并收到不含 usage 的回复，再继续。重新注入的目录必须恰好计入下一次预算门槛一次，包括启动上下文恢复之后；压缩移除最新快照后必须允许重新注入。自动标题应保留真实对话，排除 hook 上下文及驻留目录标题。

### 修改前后证据

最终受影响套件记录为 **2,462 项通过、一项既有 skip**，构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint/format 及正常 pre-commit 钩子均通过。两份独立源码审计已核对至最终候选。另附完整双语运行评论，记录精确身份、保留的失败、原生 Retry/压缩观测及历史线上测量。一次线上比较包含一轮预热和两轮测量主请求，缓存/输入比例从 **90.797% 升至 99.591%**，测量主请求未缓存输入由 **3,276 降至 146**。含预热和辅助请求的未缓存输入反而由 **41,672 增至 48,084**，不能证明整体费用改善。候选先于完整基线执行；缓存热度及取消后继续读取辅助响应限制了结论。离线原生 TUI Retry/恢复快照序列为 **[1,1,1]**，before 为 **[1,1,2]**，两次均正常退出；真实提供商 Retry 仍未验证。开启本 PR 时，本地 Qwen Code `/review` 引擎的完整评审仍在运行；其已返回的 Critical 候选经调用链核查均未成立，最终结果将补充在本 PR 中。

### 本地测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | 本地构建和受影响套件；有边界的原生用例及历史 CLI/TUI 运行，限制详见运行评论 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

macOS arm64。配对比较及历史线上运行通过 DashScope 兼容 token-plan 端点调用 `qwen3.8-max`；机制原生用例使用受控模型响应，没有真实 API 调用。本地项目记忆夹具要求 `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1`。

## 风险与范围

- 旧目录内容会留在模型历史中直到常规压缩，之后仍保存在会话记录中；以最新完整快照为准。更新后历史可能增长，这不是全局记忆预算或自动清理机制。
- 刷新时机不变。重新启用保留目录时，会清除旧用量计数并暂时改用本地估算。CJK 夹具验证本地估算覆盖，不验证提供商 tokenizer 准确性；合成 usage 不是提供商遥测。
- 原生压缩过滤证据仅覆盖冷压缩。共享分支原生执行、最终提供商 Retry 配对、独立磁盘删除刷新、其他提供商及大目录性能矩阵仍未验证。历史测量不是最终候选测量。
- 无需配置迁移。未测试用旧版本恢复新会话。非阻塞评审事项保留在单独的后续评论中。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15027 和 #11550。本 PR 处理未变化目录的位置移动问题；#15027 中更广泛的跨提供商成本和基准测试工作保持开放。历史测量更正见 https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15027#issuecomment-6320584483。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): Replace synthesized tool-result placeholders with late real results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a model stream dies after tool-call chunks were already yielded (a transient SSE cut, a stream guard firing, etc.), the session keeps the partial tool-call turn, and the next unrelated send's orphan-repair pass synthesizes a placeholder error response ("Tool execution result was not recorded…") so the wire stays well-formed. The tools themselves keep running and usually succeed. Previously, when the scheduler's real result then arrived, it was discarded as a duplicate because the placeholder already answered the call id — so the model permanently believed a successful edit/write/command had failed, re-applied landed edits, and announced failures that never happened. With this change, the tool-completion handler checks whether the existing answer is one of those synthesized placeholders: if so, the real result replaces it in place (same slot, pairing preserved) and is recorded to the session transcript; only a genuine duplicate — a real response already present for the same id — is still dropped.

## Why it's needed

Issue #15297 measured this at scale: 43 of 1275 tool calls in a five-hour window lost their results to the model even though client telemetry recorded success and side effects were on disk, producing exactly the false "edits were not recorded" belief and costly re-read/re-apply loops. The placeholder-versus-real ordering gap turned every transient stream cut into a durable false belief about the working tree. This PR closes that gap; it deliberately does not attempt to address whatever cut the reporter's streams in the first place — that investigation continues in the issue (the reporter's debug logs, specifically the `error=` field on `[PARTIAL_PUSH]`, remain the discriminator).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The race itself needs a provider stream cut mid-turn, so the verification is mechanism-level: `packages/core` gains a regression test that plants the placeholder in history, replaces it with the real result, then sends and asserts the outbound request carries the real output exactly once and never the sentinel; `packages/cli` gains a regression test driving the tool-completion handler with a synthesized placeholder present, asserting the real result replaces it (and is recorded) instead of being dropped. Both fail without the production change (mutation-checked). Existing repair/dedup suites (`llm-chat.test.ts` 614 tests, `use-llm-stream.test.tsx` 321 tests, `client.test.ts` + `session-recovery.test.ts` 546 tests) pass unchanged. A reviewer can confirm by reading the dedup branch in the tool-completion handler and running the two new tests.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no TUI-visible surface change; the fix changes what the model sees in history and on the wire, pinned by the new wire-level unit test). Before: debug log shows `[REPAIR] Dropping N late tool result(s)` and the transcript keeps a phantom unanswered functionCall. After: the log shows `[REPAIR] Replaced synthesized placeholder(s) with late real tool result(s)` and the transcript records the real result.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local build of the branch (`npm run build`); unit/integration suites via vitest. No live provider was involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: when the placeholder was already included in an intervening request, the model may have already reacted to the "not recorded" error; after replacement its next request carries the real result, so it can self-correct. This late correction is the intended trade-off and strictly improves on the previous permanent false belief.
- Not validated / out of scope: the original stream-cut trigger (needs the reporter's debug logs; provider- and platform-specific), Windows/Linux runtime behavior, and a live end-to-end staging of the race in the TUI (the interleave timing is not deterministically stageable through the interactive admission path; the wire contract is pinned at request-construction level instead).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New internal accessors are additive; behavior for genuine duplicates is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15297 (fixes the result-delivery half; the stream-cut trigger investigation stays open there).

N/A（无 TUI 可见界面变化；本修复改变的是模型在 history 和线上协议中看到的内容，已由新的线级单元测试锁定）。修复前：debug 日志出现 `[REPAIR] Dropping N late tool result(s)`，转录里留下一个没有应答的幽灵 functionCall。修复后：日志出现 `[REPAIR] Replaced synthesized placeholder(s) with late real tool result(s)`，转录记录真实结果。

prs.title: perf(ci): scope PR lint and reuse static build outputs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Scopes file-local lint to the PR diff from its merge base. ESLint, Prettier and YAML checks use changed complete files; workflow changes retain full actionlint and shell changes recheck shell entrypoints. Rule, configuration and dependency changes, missing history and non-PR runs retain full scans.

Lint & Static now installs dependencies without the repository's prepare build/bundle, then reuses its existing clean CLI closure build before i18n, schema and notice checks. The redundant core rebuild is removed. Both primary hosted jobs use the existing pnpm store cache action.

## Why it's needed

In [the motivating run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39977456043/job/120499922868), installation including lifecycle scripts took 9m23 and whole-repository ESLint took 4m51 before the run was cancelled. Installation reported 1,922 reused packages and zero downloads; root prepare alone took about 7m23, while linter setup took about 0.6s. The later closure check is configured to rebuild the CLI closure. These timings establish the bottlenecks, not a measured speedup for this PR.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/pr-incremental-static/docs/design/incremental-pr-lint.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/pr-incremental-static/docs/design/incremental-pr-lint.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- The final lint-scope, existing lint and CI lane suites passed 86/86 tests (32 new incremental cases). They exercise real Git histories, configuration invalidation, renames/deletions, shallow history, special filenames, ignored files and linter failures.
- After the review round (`6d579338`): `scripts/tests/lint-scope.test.js` 36/36 — the four added cases pin `.mts`/`.cts` selection against the full lane, the `integration-tests/terminal-bench/` exclusion, one Prettier run reporting every failing directory, and the fixture's linter temp dir — plus `scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js` 38/38, `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` 114 passed (2 skipped) and `.github/scripts/check-lint-gate-freshness.test.mjs` 9/9. ESLint and Prettier are clean on the changed set.
- From a fresh checkout, install with `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE=1 QWEN_SKIP_NOTICE_GENERATION=1 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Run `npm run check:serve-fast-path-bundle` followed directly by `npm run check:core-subpath-exports`. All 310 core subpath specifiers resolved locally without rebuilding core again.
- Run i18n, schema and both notice generators; confirm no tracked output changes. Full ESLint, build, typecheck, lockfile/isolation/dependency-direction checks, pinned actionlint 1.7.12 and YAML lint passed locally.
- A source-only seven-file commit passed actual incremental ESLint and Prettier. Check ordinary PR logs for incremental selection and verify dependency/configuration PRs fall back to full scans.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. The required build and generated-output checks remain enabled; only their duplicate work and file selection change.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Tested locally |
| Windows | Not tested; incremental lint runs in the Linux CI lane |
| Linux | Awaiting CI |

## Risk & Scope

- Full scans remain the fallback when history cannot prove the merge base, and on main. Incremental checks cover whole files, not changed lines.
- The existing Linux disk telemetry fixture reads `/proc/meminfo` and fails on macOS; it requires Linux validation. Same-runner CI timing comparison remains pending.
- Dependency lifecycle scripts and patch-package remain enabled. Skip flags apply only to the lint installation step, so explicit schema/notice checks still execute.
- ShellCheck retains its existing full-lane execution when shell inputs change. Its legacy pipeline masks checker failures; enabling strict failure needs separate baseline cleanup and is not bundled into this optimization.
- No runner concurrency, required-check policy or application behavior changes.
- `.github/workflows/.size-baseline` now records `ci.yml` at 151690 bytes. Lint & Static failed the workflow-size ratchet at 152080 against a recorded 147136 with a 4096-byte allowance; the overage is this PR's opt-in step plus `ci.yml` growth that landed on main without a same-PR bump, which is the drift that ratchet exists to surface. The fetch step's comment was cut to four lines and the mechanism moved into both design docs.

## Linked Issues

Motivated by the CI run linked above; no issue closure.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的修改

按 PR 与共同祖先的差异缩小文件级 lint 范围。ESLint、Prettier 和 YAML 检查变更的完整文件；工作流变更保留全量 actionlint，shell 变更重新检查 shell 入口。规则、配置、依赖变化、历史缺失及非 PR 运行保留全量扫描。

Lint & Static 安装依赖时跳过仓库自身的 prepare 构建与打包，随后复用已有的干净 CLI 闭包构建，在此之后运行 i18n、schema 和 notice 检查。移除重复的 core 构建。两个主要 hosted 任务使用现有 pnpm store 缓存 action。

## 修改原因

[触发本次优化的运行](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39977456043/job/120499922868)中，包含生命周期脚本的安装用了 9 分 23 秒，全仓 ESLint 用了 4 分 51 秒，随后运行被取消。安装日志记录复用了 1,922 个包、下载数为零；root prepare 单独用了约 7 分 23 秒，而 linter setup 约 0.6 秒。后续闭包检查配置为重新构建 CLI 闭包。这些时间说明瓶颈位置，并非本 PR 已测得的提速比例。

设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/pr-incremental-static/docs/design/incremental-pr-lint.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/pr-incremental-static/docs/design/incremental-pr-lint.zh-CN.md)。

## 评审验证计划

### 验证方法

- 最终 lint-scope、现有 lint 和 CI 任务测试共 86/86 通过，其中 32 项新增增量用例。覆盖真实 Git 历史、配置失效、重命名与删除、浅历史、特殊文件名、忽略文件和检查器失败。
- 评审轮之后（`6d579338`）：`scripts/tests/lint-scope.test.js` 36/36 —— 新增的 4 个用例分别钉住 `.mts`/`.cts` 与全量通道的对齐、`integration-tests/terminal-bench/` 排除、Prettier 一次运行报告所有失败目录、以及 fixture 内的 linter 临时目录 —— 另有 `scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js` 38/38、`scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` 114 通过（2 跳过）、`.github/scripts/check-lint-gate-freshness.test.mjs` 9/9。改动文件 ESLint 与 Prettier 均通过。
- 在全新 checkout 中使用 `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE=1 QWEN_SKIP_NOTICE_GENERATION=1 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 安装。运行 `npm run check:serve-fast-path-bundle` 后直接运行 `npm run check:core-subpath-exports`。本地没有额外重建 core，310 个 core 子路径全部解析成功。
- 运行 i18n、schema 和两份 notice 生成器，确认没有跟踪产物变化。本地全量 ESLint、build、typecheck、锁文件/隔离/依赖方向检查、固定版本 actionlint 1.7.12 和 YAML lint 均通过。
- 一个只改源码的 7 文件提交通过了真实增量 ESLint 和 Prettier。请确认普通 PR 日志显示增量选择，依赖或配置变更 PR 回退全量。

### 前后对比证据

不涉及 UI。必需构建和生成产物检查继续执行，只改变重复工作和文件选择。

### 验证平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 已在本地验证 |
| Windows | 未验证；增量 lint 在 Linux CI 任务运行 |
| Linux | 等待 CI |

## 风险与范围

- 无法证明共同祖先的历史和 main 继续全量扫描。增量检查完整文件，不只检查修改行。
- 现有 Linux 磁盘遥测测试读取 `/proc/meminfo`，在 macOS 失败，需由 Linux 验证。同类 runner 的 CI 耗时对比仍待完成。
- 保留依赖生命周期脚本和 patch-package。跳过标志只作用于 lint 安装步骤，因此显式 schema/notice 检查继续执行。
- ShellCheck 在 shell 输入变化时保留现有全量执行方式。旧管道会吞掉检查器失败状态；严格失败需要单独清理基线，不混入本次优化。
- 不改变 runner 并发、必需检查策略或应用行为。
- `.github/workflows/.size-baseline` 现记录 `ci.yml` 为 151690 字节。Lint & Static 在 workflow-size 棘轮上失败：文件当时 152080 字节，记录值 147136、允许 4096 字节；超出部分来自本 PR 新增的开关步骤，以及 main 上未同 PR 更新基线的 `ci.yml` 增长——这正是该棘轮要暴露的漂移。该步骤的注释压缩到四行，机制说明移入中英文设计文档。

## 关联问题

由上面的 CI 运行触发，不关闭 issue。

</details>

prs.title: test(scripts): pin newline-bearing takeover round seed bodies
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two fixtures to the existing takeover-round-seed behavioral harness in `scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js`, so that both newline-bearing comment-body shapes are pinned: a leading-newline body must fail closed (`'|'`) and a trailing-newline body must still engage (`'add|4'`). Test-only — no production code, workflow, or operator-guide change.

## Why it's needed

The harness replayed every documented body shape except ones carrying a newline, so a trim regression in the route step could flip a documented outcome while the whole suite stayed green.

The two shapes are trimmed by different mechanisms, which is why one fixture cannot cover both:

- Leading newline — the line-oriented `sed` at `qwen-autofix.yml:419` strips nothing from a blank first line and the surrounding `$(...)` strips only *trailing* newlines, so `BODY_TRIMMED` keeps the leading `\n`. The end-anchored `from N` regex at `yml:427` still matches, but `BASH_REMATCH[1]` is then `'\n@qwen-code /takeover'`, which fails the `TAKEOVER_COMMAND` comparison at `yml:432`, so `CMD` stays empty. In production a leading-whitespace body is stopped even earlier by the job-level prefilter at `yml:245` (the operator guide says so at `qwen-autofix-round-seed.md:120-122`), so this fixture pins the in-job trim's own fail-closed behavior — defense in depth.
- Trailing newline — that newline is removed by the `$(...)` command substitution, not by the `sed`. This is a different mechanism from the trailing-space case already pinned at `:6027`, and that difference is the fixture's whole value.

Production and the operator guide were already correct; the only defect was the missing pin.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Whole-file run (never `-t`):

```
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js
```

Expected: `Test Files 1 failed (1)`, `Tests 8 failed | 317 passed | 14 skipped (339)`, and the harness `behaviorally parses the takeover round seed and keeps every other body closed` green (`✓`). The total stays 339 because both fixtures live inside the existing `it()`.

The gap was first reproduced by grep against `main` @ `949a71e29b`: `grep -n 'seedOf([^)]*\\n' scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js` exited 1 (a true zero, with a control case proving the pattern can match, and the file asserted non-empty at 1357510 bytes / 31202 lines / 10 `seedOf(` first). After this PR that grep matches the new positive assertion.

**Dual-arm mutation probe.** `qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js:44` reads `.github/workflows/qwen-autofix.yml` via `readFileSync`, so a local yml edit flows into the replay. Each arm mutates `yml:419` only, is measured twice (unmodified suite, then suite with the new fixtures), and the yml is restored byte-identically afterwards.

| Arm | Mutation at `yml:419` | Transcript 1: unmodified suite | Transcript 2: with the new fixtures |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| A | `sed` also deletes whitespace-only lines (`-e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d'`) | harness **green** (`✓`), `8 failed \| 317 passed \| 14 skipped (339)` | harness **red** (`×`), `9 failed \| 316 passed \| 14 skipped (339)`; `AssertionError: expected 'add\|4' to be '\|'` at `:6082` — the leading-newline fixture flipped |
| B | the `$(...)` trailing-newline strip is broken (`; printf x` inside the substitution, then `${BODY_TRIMMED%x}`) | harness **green** (`✓`), `8 failed \| 317 passed \| 14 skipped (339)` | harness **red** (`×`), `9 failed \| 316 passed \| 14 skipped (339)`; `AssertionError: expected '\|' to be 'add\|4'` at `:6038` — the trailing-newline fixture flipped |

Transcript 1 is the reproduction: under each mutation the behavior changes and the unmodified suite does not notice. Transcript 2 is the pin working.

**Declared deviation from the handed-off acceptance text.** The acceptance text asked for "the same mutation turns the NEW fixtures RED" (plural). That is unsatisfiable and was re-derived independently: arm A reds only the leading-newline fixture and arm B reds only the trailing-newline fixture, because each mutation removes a different one of the two trim mechanisms. It was therefore implemented as two arms, each witnessing exactly one fixture. No arm was observed reddening both, and no arm was reported as having done so.

`sha256sum .github/workflows/qwen-autofix.yml` before the first mutation and after the final restore are identical: `3c0c63e44e14316a813733b230faf9777bf03881a57932d2a103c751bc617231`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — there is no user-visible CLI, TUI, Web UI or Web Shell surface in this change; it is a test-only pin inside an existing harness, so there is nothing to screenshot or record. The behavioral evidence is the mutation table above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅    |

Windows is N/A at config level rather than by a guard in this file: `scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts:17-31` excludes `scripts/tests/qwen-*-workflow.test.js` on win32 (line 26). No `skipIf` was added here — the harness at `:5966` is a bare `it(`, and a platform guard would be redundant dead code on main.

### Environment (optional)

Local vitest under donor-hardlinked `node_modules`; no install or build was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none functional — the diff adds assertions only. The residual risk is a wrongly-worded comment attributing behavior to the wrong trim mechanism; both comments name the specific yml line and mechanism, and both attributions were confirmed by the mutation arms rather than by reading alone.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 8 pre-existing resident failures in this file are unchanged and were not touched. Attribution is by sorted failure-name set — `comm -13` of the baseline set against this run's set is empty (the resident set did not grow) and `comm -23` is empty (none disappeared). Baseline: `Tests 8 failed | 317 passed | 14 skipped (339)`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Lint/format: `eslint` exits 0 and `prettier --check` reports "All matched files use Prettier code style!" on the changed file. Typecheck: N/A (`scripts/tests` has no TypeScript target).
- Diff scope: `git show --stat HEAD` lists exactly one file, `scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js` (1 file changed, 22 insertions). The temporarily mutated `qwen-autofix.yml` never appeared in `git status --porcelain` at commit time, and the working tree was clean.

## Linked Issues

Refs #9644 — deliberately not a closing keyword. This PR addresses exactly one finding from that issue (`rc:3827428069`, test-only: the missing newline-bearing `seedOf()` pin) and no other finding listed there, so it must not auto-close the issue on merge.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 `scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js` 既有的 takeover round seed 行为化测试里补两个 fixture，把两种带换行的评论正文形态都钉住：前导换行的正文必须 fail closed（`'|'`），尾随换行的正文必须仍然生效（`'add|4'`）。纯测试改动 —— 没有动生产代码、workflow 或操作指南。

## 为什么需要

原来的 harness 把每一种有文档记载的正文形态都重放过，唯独没有带换行的，所以 route step 里一旦出现 trim 回归，就能把一个有文档记载的结论翻面，而整个测试套件仍然是绿的。

这两种形态由不同机制完成 trim，这也是为什么一个 fixture 覆盖不了两者：

- 前导换行 —— `qwen-autofix.yml:419` 那个按行工作的 `sed` 对空的首行什么都不删，而外层 `$(...)` 只删*尾随*换行，所以 `BODY_TRIMMED` 会保留前导 `\n`。`yml:427` 那个尾部锚定的 `from N` 正则仍然匹配，但此时 `BASH_REMATCH[1]` 是 `'\n@qwen-code /takeover'`，过不了 `yml:432` 的 `TAKEOVER_COMMAND` 比较，于是 `CMD` 保持为空。生产环境里带前导空白的正文更早就被 `yml:245` 的 job 级预筛拦掉了（操作指南在 `qwen-autofix-round-seed.md:120-122` 也这么写），所以这个 fixture 钉的是 job 内 trim 自身的 fail-closed 行为 —— 属于纵深防御。
- 尾随换行 —— 这个换行是被 `$(...)` 命令替换删掉的，不是被 `sed` 删掉的。这与 `:6027` 已经钉住的尾随空格是不同机制，而这个差别正是该 fixture 的全部价值。

生产代码和操作指南本来就是对的；唯一的缺陷是缺这个钉子。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

整文件运行（不用 `-t`）：

```
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js
```

预期：`Test Files 1 failed (1)`、`Tests 8 failed | 317 passed | 14 skipped (339)`，且 harness `behaviorally parses the takeover round seed and keeps every other body closed` 为绿（`✓`）。总数仍是 339，因为两个 fixture 都在既有的 `it()` 里面。

缺口最初是用 grep 在 `main` @ `949a71e29b` 上复现的：`grep -n 'seedOf([^)]*\\n' scripts/tests/qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js` 退出码为 1（真零命中；同时有对照用例证明该 pattern 能命中，并且先断言文件非空 —— 1357510 字节 / 31202 行 / 10 个 `seedOf(`）。本 PR 之后该 grep 会命中新增的正向断言。

**双臂变异探针。** `qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js:44` 通过 `readFileSync` 读 `.github/workflows/qwen-autofix.yml`，所以本地改 yml 会流进重放。每一臂只改 `yml:419`，各测两次（先未修改的套件，再带新 fixture 的套件），事后把 yml 按字节还原。

| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| A | `sed` 额外删除纯空白行（`-e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d'`） | harness **绿**（`✓`），`8 failed \| 317 passed \| 14 skipped (339)` | harness **红**（`×`），`9 failed \| 316 passed \| 14 skipped (339)`；`AssertionError: expected 'add\|4' to be '\|'` 在 `:6082` —— 前导换行 fixture 翻面 |
| B | 破坏 `$(...)` 的尾随换行剥离（替换内追加 `; printf x`，再用 `${BODY_TRIMMED%x}` 去掉） | harness **绿**（`✓`），`8 failed \| 317 passed \| 14 skipped (339)` | harness **红**（`×`），`9 failed \| 316 passed \| 14 skipped (339)`；`AssertionError: expected '\|' to be 'add\|4'` 在 `:6038` —— 尾随换行 fixture 翻面 |

记录 1 就是复现：每一臂下行为都变了，而未修改的套件毫无察觉。记录 2 说明钉子生效。

**对交接验收文案的偏离声明。** 验收文案要求「同一个变异让新 fixture 变红」（复数）。这是不可满足的，并且已被独立重新推导：A 臂只会让前导换行 fixture 变红，B 臂只会让尾随换行 fixture 变红，因为两个变异各自破坏的是两种 trim 机制中的一种。因此实现为两臂，每臂恰好见证一个 fixture。没有观察到任何一臂同时让两个 fixture 变红，也没有如此上报。

第一次变异前与最后一次还原后的 `sha256sum .github/workflows/qwen-autofix.yml` 完全一致：`3c0c63e44e14316a813733b230faf9777bf03881a57932d2a103c751bc617231`。

N/A —— 本次改动没有任何用户可见的 CLI、TUI、Web UI 或 Web Shell 面，它只是既有 harness 内部的纯测试钉子，所以没有可截图或录屏的对象。行为证据就是上面的变异表。

- 主要风险或取舍：功能上无风险 —— diff 只新增断言。残余风险是注释措辞把行为归因到错误的 trim 机制；两条注释都点名了具体 yml 行号与机制，且两处归因都由变异臂实测确认，而非仅靠阅读。

prs.title: test(review): witness the unasserted halves of two Aone routing pins
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the missing half of two existing review-provider pins. Both tests already claimed a negative in their title ("…and pays no re-query", "…and never touches gh") but only asserted the positive half, so the negative was unobserved: a regression that reintroduced it kept the whole suite green. Test-only change — no production file is touched.

`submit-aone.test.ts`: the Aone receipt pin now witnesses that the Aone reader's `composeUrl` is never called when the pre-write read served no `detailUrl`. That method was previously left as the real implementation by the module mock (which overrode only `submitAoneReview`), and it degrades to `''` on any failure, so a re-query for the MR link was invisible to every assertion while still costing a blocking `a1 repo mr view`. The assertion is scoped to the **Aone** reader on purpose: the GitHub post path composes its own link through `githubReader.composeUrl`, which is a different call site and not what this pin rules on.

`test-plan.test.ts`: the handler-wiring pin now witnesses zero `gh` invocations on the Aone `--host` path. `./lib/gh.js` was imported unmocked and nothing observed the gh seam, so an added `gh pr view` fallback — a dropped `args.host`, or a handler reverted to `runTestPlan(args)` — stayed green. The spy target is `gh` itself, **not** `getGhHost`/`setGhHost`: this pin's own harness calls the real `getGhHost()`/`setGhHost()` to save and restore the host, so asserting on those would be a guaranteed false red. The mock therefore spreads `...actual` and overrides only `gh`, keeping the harness's host save/restore working on the real functions.

## Why it's needed

These are the two deferred findings from #9698. Both are missing-witness gaps: the code is correct today, but the test that is supposed to protect the invariant does not actually observe it. A pin whose title promises a negative and whose body never asserts it gives false confidence — the next contributor can reintroduce a blocking platform call on the Aone path and see 100% green.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Both findings are missing-witness gaps, so there is no runtime behaviour to reproduce — the defect *is* that a mutation stays green. Reproduced by mutation instead, two arms per finding, on `5a0be334`:

**Arm A — the gap (pristine test files from `origin/main`, mutated production):**

- Finding 1: insert an `aoneReader.composeUrl(Number(args.pr), args.repo)` re-query into the Aone submit path in `submit.ts`, immediately before `const postedUrl = result.webUrl;` (plus the `aoneReader` import). `npx vitest run src/commands/review/submit-aone.test.ts` → **rc=0, 98 passed (98)**. That greenness is the defect.
- Finding 2: insert `try { void fetchPrBody(String(args.repo ?? ''), String(args.pr ?? '')); } catch {}` into the `--host` handler in `test-plan.ts`, immediately after `setGhHost(args.host);`. `npx vitest run src/commands/review/test-plan.test.ts` → **rc=0, 104 passed (104)**.

**Arm A positive control (proves each inserted line really executes, so the green above is not a vacuous no-op):** replace the inserted call with `throw new Error('MUTATION-EXECUTED-F1')` / `-F2` at the *same* insertion point, pristine tests.

- Finding 1 → **rc=1**, 13 failures across the Aone routing suite.
- Finding 2 → **rc=1**, 2 failures, both in `describe('the handler wiring — the integration point of the Aone fix')`.

**Arm B — the fix (this PR's tests, production unmodified, then re-mutated):**

- Production unmodified: `submit-aone.test.ts` → **rc=0, 98 passed (98)**; `test-plan.test.ts` → **rc=0, 104 passed (104)**.
- Re-apply the same mutation: `submit-aone.test.ts` → **rc=1, 1 failed | 97 passed**, and the single failure is exactly `the Aone success JSON carries NO url key when the pre-write read served no detailUrl — and pays no re-query`. `test-plan.test.ts` → **rc=1, 1 failed | 103 passed**, and the single failure is exactly `an Aone --host routes the body through the reader, gates first, and never touches gh`.

Production files were restored from a pre-mutation copy and verified byte-identical: `git diff --numstat` reports zero changed entries for `submit.ts`, `test-plan.ts`, `lib/platform/aone.ts` and `lib/gh.ts`; `submit.ts` 109329 bytes, `test-plan.ts` 40991 bytes. Whole files were run, never `-t` filters.

`npx eslint` on both changed files → **rc=0**.

**`packages/cli` typecheck was NOT executed on the dev host.** `tsc` for this package is OOM-killed there (exit 134 at a 2800 MB cap, exit 137 at 4096 MB, SwapFree 0). This PR does **not** claim zero type errors; the change is validated by vitest + eslint + the mutation arms above.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behaviour.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested (vitest + eslint; typecheck not executed — OOM on host)   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (`npx vitest run` from `packages/cli`). No runtime, sandbox or network involved. Note the new mocks make the suite *less* dependent on the host: `aoneReader.composeUrl` and `gh` can no longer reach a real `a1`/`gh` binary from these paths.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `test-plan.test.ts` gains a module-wide `vi.mock('./lib/gh.js')`. It spreads `...actual` and overrides only `gh`, so `getGhHost`/`setGhHost` stay real for the existing host save/restore harness. No other test in that file invokes `gh` — every `runTestPlan` call passes an explicit fetcher (`() => body`, or `platformBodyFetcher(...)`), and `fetchPrBody` otherwise appears only in an identity comparison (`toBe(fetchPrBody)`), which mocking `gh` does not affect. All 104 tests pass. `submit-aone.test.ts` extends an existing mock rather than adding one, keeping `...actual` and `...actual.aoneReader`.
- Not validated / out of scope: `packages/cli` typecheck (OOM on the dev host, reported not-executed). The sibling deferred trackers #9750 and #9751 are deliberately **not** bundled here — they need a maintainer design ruling. No production code changed, so there is no behavioural risk to review.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #9698

这是 #9698 里被延后的两条发现。两条都是「缺失见证」型缺口：代码今天是对的，但本该守住该不变量的测试其实没有观测它。一个标题承诺了否定结论、正文却从不断言它的钉桩会给出虚假信心——下一位贡献者可以在 Aone 路径上重新引入一次阻塞式平台调用，然后看到 100% 全绿。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

两条发现都是缺失见证型缺口，因此没有可复现的运行时行为——缺陷本身就是「一个变异保持全绿」。改用变异复现，每条发现两个臂，基线 `5a0be334`：

**Arm A——缺口（`origin/main` 的原始测试文件 + 变异后的生产代码）：**

- 发现 1：在 `submit.ts` 的 Aone 提交路径中、紧接 `const postedUrl = result.webUrl;` 之前插入 `aoneReader.composeUrl(Number(args.pr), args.repo)` 二次查询（并补上 `aoneReader` 导入）。`npx vitest run src/commands/review/submit-aone.test.ts` → **rc=0，98 passed (98)**。这个「绿」就是缺陷。

**Arm A 正向对照（证明插入的那一行确实执行了，所以上面的绿不是空转）：**在*同一*插入点把调用换成 `throw new Error('MUTATION-EXECUTED-F1')` / `-F2`，测试文件仍为原始版本。

**Arm B——修复（本 PR 的测试 + 未变异生产代码，然后重新施加变异）：**

prs.title: test(serve): give the read-profile status wait a 10s budget
prs.body:
Fixes #15341.

## What fails

`hosted-harness-session.test.ts` › *gives a read-profile Session no skill catalog from its agent definition* failed 3/3 attempts inside one run:

```
AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 ❯ src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts:38363:43
   expect(status.body.hasActivePrompt).toBe(false);
```

1 failure out of 44,637 tests, runner `ecs-qwen-hk2-6`, `load 73.92` with 52 concurrent test processes. The PR it ran on (#15329) only touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, so the test file in that merge tree is identical to main's.

## Root cause

The assertion already polls — it is not a point-in-time read. What it lacks is a **poll budget**:

```ts
await vi.waitFor(async () => { ... });
```

A bare `vi.waitFor` inherits vitest's defaults of `timeout: 1000` / `interval: 50`. `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` raises `testTimeout` to 60s on `ecs-qwen-*` runners, but `testTimeout` does not bound `vi.waitFor` — the repo already documents that trap in `packages/cli/test-setup.ts`. The existing mitigation there (`configure({ asyncUtilTimeout: 10_000 })`) only covers `@testing-library` queries; `vi.waitFor` has no equivalent global bump.

Each poll is a supertest round-trip against a settle path that commits an fsync-backed journal entry before the active flag clears — the same mechanism behind #14107 and #14394. At load 74, one second is not enough, and steady contention across all three `--retry=2` attempts explains the identical repeats without implying a product defect.

## Change

One call gets the budget its neighbours already have:

```ts
await vi.waitFor(
  async () => { ... },
  { timeout: 10_000 },
);
```

`63` other `vi.waitFor` calls in this file already carry an explicit `{ timeout: 10_000 | 15_000 | 30_000 }`; this one was in the bare minority. Nothing is asserted less — a condition that never holds still fails, it just gets ten seconds to hold.

Same class and same shape as #14091 (5s → 10s), #14107 (two bare hosted recovery waits), #14394 (idle wait 1s → 10s) and #13323 (explicit timeout for the unknown-Hook fence).

## Test plan

The failing case is the test change, so the relevant check is that it keeps failing when the condition genuinely never holds and passing on a quiet host:

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t "gives a read-profile Session no skill catalog"
npx prettier --check packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts
```

`prettier --check` passes on this head. I could not run vitest locally (esbuild fails to start on this machine), so the run is delegated to CI; the file is otherwise unchanged, which is why the diff is four added lines and three re-indented ones.

## Scope

Test-only, no production code touched. The other 50 bare `vi.waitFor` calls in this file are left alone — they did not flake, and widening them all would bury the one line that matters.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): make two ARM64 smoke assertions environment-independent
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes the two `@smoke` specs that have failed deterministically on every full-profile CI run since #15364 routed the web-shell E2E Smoke lane to the ARM64 `ecs-qwen-hz2` fleet. `web-shell.token-usage.spec.ts` no longer hardcodes x64 font metrics for its header-wrap expectation at minimum panel width — it now derives the expected wrap outcome from the measured single-line width, while keeping the right-alignment and no-overflow assertions unconditional. `web-shell.message-deletion.spec.ts` no longer relies on a full `hover()` call whose actionability checks can outlast the hover-menu's 120 ms close timer on a contended host — it moves the pointer with a stepped raw `mouse.move`, so `pointerenter` cancels the timer without the overhead.

## Why it's needed

Since #15364, every full-profile run is red on this lane: the same two specs fail with in-run retries exhausted (#15364's own [CI job 120531715606](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39978113644/job/120531715606), plus [39987561416](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39987561416) and [39988132813](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39988132813)). Root cause analysis concludes the failures are pre-existing test fragilities, not a product regression: #15364 changed only CI routing, 356 other smoke tests pass on the same fleet, and the two specs encode host-specific assumptions (font glyph widths for `zh-CN` header wrapping; hover timing margins on a slower, contended ARM64 runner). The `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:4170` proxy errors seen in the logs are benign pre-existing noise — they also appear 645 times in a previously passing x64 run ([job 120554688708](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39981302184/job/120554688708)).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Expected: the `web-shell E2E Smoke` lane on this PR's CI passes the two previously failing cases (`message-deletion.spec.ts:873`, `token-usage.spec.ts:19`, all language/theme variants), and the suite stays green elsewhere. Locally: `cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.token-usage.spec.ts client/e2e/web-shell.message-deletion.spec.ts --grep '@smoke' --workers=2`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: both specs fail 3/3 attempts on ARM64 (`expect(alignment.wrapped).toBe(true)` got false; `getByRole('menu')` never visible for 20 s). After: 32/32 `@smoke` tests in both files pass locally, and this PR's CI lands green end-to-end — [run 40050426620](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40050426620) passes the ARM64 `web-shell E2E Smoke` lane with **359/359** tests (including `message-deletion.spec.ts:873` and all six `token-usage` variants) in 25.8 m, the first green run of that lane since #15364.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux verdict is the decisive one: the affected ARM64 ECS lane passes in CI (run 40050426620, 359/359). macOS validated locally; Windows CI runs the same suite as part of the PR checks.

### Environment (optional)

macOS, pnpm 11.24.0, Playwright chromium project with `npm run dev` web server.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the wrap assertion now derives its expectation from measured widths; it still fails if the header overflows, misaligns, or wraps inconsistently with the computed single-line width, so the anti-overflow/right-align intent is preserved. The stepped `mouse.move` exercises the same browser input path `hover()` wraps.
- Not validated / out of scope: aligning the hz2 fleet's installed fonts with hk3/hk5 (infra alternative; hosted runners remain a third font environment, so the test-side derivation is the durable fix). The remaining occasional `message-deletion` flake under extreme host contention is possible but no longer structurally biased.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — test-only changes, no product code touched.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15364 (CI lane routing that exposed the fragility; no revert proposed), #15381 (currently blocked by this lane).
