prs.title: test(web-shell): cross the hover-menu corridor with raw pointer moves
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Replaces the post-gap `hover()` call in `web-shell.message-deletion.spec.ts` with raw pointer moves, so the "message actions" smoke test stops racing the menu's 120 ms hover-intent close delay. The gap dwell and the "menu is still open" assertion are unchanged; nothing in `MessageTimestamp.tsx` changes.

## Why it's needed

The test hovers the "More message actions" trigger, parks the pointer in the gap for 60 ms, then calls `menu.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Edit message' }).hover()`.

That `hover()` first runs Playwright's actionability check (visible, stable across two animation frames, receives pointer events) **while the pointer is still in the gap**. A menu opened by hover closes 120 ms after the pointer leaves the trigger (`MessageTimestamp.tsx` schedules exactly that), so the actionability budget can consume the whole delay before the pointer arrives — and the menu is gone by the time the next assertion runs.

It is load-dependent, not deterministic. Instrumented on the ARM64 ECS pool host (`ecs-qwen-hz2`), 10 runs of the single test:

| `hover()` round trip | time since leaving the trigger | result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 70–73 ms | 153–158 ms | 6 passed |
| 89–92 ms | 180–183 ms | 4 failed |

The failure always lands on `expect(menu).toBeVisible()` right after the hover, with `getByRole('menu')` already detached.

This is a test-side timing assumption, not a product bug: a human crossing that gap is nowhere near 120 ms of actionability overhead. Fixing it in the test keeps the product's hover-intent delay untouched.

No tracking issue — found while triaging `web-shell E2E Smoke` failures on the ARM64 pool. The other failure in that lane (`token usage 1200px zh-CN light` asserting `alignment.wrapped`) was host font drift, not code, and is not part of this PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a self-hosted Linux pool host with the repo workspace and Playwright browsers present:

```bash
sudo -u github-runner -H \
  env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/home/github-runner/.cache/ms-playwright PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=4921 \
  bash -lc 'cd <workspace>/packages/web-shell && \
    ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config playwright.config.ts \
      --project=chromium --grep "hoverable menu that also supports click and keyboard" \
      --repeat-each=20 --workers=2 --reporter=line'
```

Expected: `20 passed`. On `main` the same command gives `4 failed / 6 passed` on the same host.

### Evidence (Before & After)

```
# before, main @ 5a0be334, ecs-qwen-hz2, repeat-each=10 --workers=2
  4 failed
  6 passed (2.8m)

# after, this PR, same host, repeat-each=20 --workers=2
  20 passed (1.6m)

# after, this PR, exact committed revision, repeat-each=10 --workers=2
  10 passed (52.7s)
```

The failure signature before the change:

```
Error: expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed
Locator: getByRole('menu')
Error: element(s) not found
> 929 |   await expect(menu).toBeVisible();
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅   |

Linux = ARM64 self-hosted ECS pool (`ecs-qwen-hz2`), which is where the flake reproduced. Prettier check passes for the changed file.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-only change — the product's 120 ms hover-intent delay is untouched. The raw `mouse.move` deliberately skips Playwright's actionability check for the menu item, so a future regression that left `Edit message` non-actionable (covered, zero-size, or `pointer-events: none`) would no longer surface as a `hover()` failure; it is still caught by the assertions immediately after the move (`toBeVisible()`, `toBeFocused()`, `data-highlighted`), which is the behavior this test exists to pin.
- Not validated / out of scope: the sibling `token-usage` failure in the same lane (host font drift) landed on `main` separately via #15399 and #15400, so it is not part of this PR. The hosted x64 lane is not covered here; the change carries no font or metric assumptions, and this spec only runs in the Linux Chromium smoke lane, which is why macOS and Windows stay ⚠️.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — one spec file, no product code, no workflow change.

## Linked Issues

No tracking issue. Found while triaging the `web-shell E2E Smoke` failures on the ARM64 pool that followed #15364. Supersedes the hover half of #15401: once this lands, the hunk left in #15401 is an exact duplicate of this one, and its `token-usage` half is already on `main` via #15399 and #15400.

`Locator.hover()` spends its actionability budget (visible, stable across two

the "More message actions" trigger and the opened menu. A menu opened by hover

budget can consume the whole delay before the pointer reaches the menu.

  hover() round trip 70-73 ms -> passes
  hover() round trip 89-92 ms -> fails at the post-hover visibility check

and the "menu is still open" assertion are unchanged, so the hover-intent
corridor stays covered. No product behavior changes.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): retry the team-lead boot past the harness port race
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the team-lead Hosted MySQL integration test's boot resilient to the harness losing its reserved port. The test reserves its three ports up front, but the Node harness binds its port only after Spring has finished booting. When a busy runner reassigns that port in the gap, `qwen serve` advances to the next port instead of failing, so the test's `/capabilities` poll waits on the stale port until it times out. The boot now retries the whole attempt with fresh ports when the harness reports that move, matching the existing retry that already covered Spring and the embedded broker.

## Why it's needed

`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT.teamCallsAskWithTheirInputInDefaultMode` failed in the Managed Agent hosted MySQL lane and blocked the gate. Main's gate has passed repeatedly on the same code, so this is a timing-dependent boot race rather than a product regression. Leaving it unfixed means the class can fail again whenever the runner is contended.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` in the hosted MySQL lane. All three tests should pass, including the approval test's four action cards, their input previews, the agent launch answer and the member report. Running the class repeatedly under load exercises the new retry path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only stability change with no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: build, typecheck, lint and the focused serve port-retry Vitest passed. The Java/MySQL integration test could not run in this sandbox.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22 sandbox without a JDK, Maven or MySQL; CI's hosted MySQL lane is the final witness for the Java test.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a bind conflict now also restarts Spring and the harness with fresh ports. The retry is bounded to three attempts and only runs when a port is lost, so a genuine startup failure still surfaces.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java integration test and its mutation probe could not run here; they are covered by the hosted MySQL lane.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test-only.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15205

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让团队负责人（team lead）的 Hosted MySQL 集成测试在 harness 丢失预留端口时仍能可靠启动。测试会预先预留三个端口，但 Node harness 只有在 Spring 启动完成后才会绑定自己的端口。当繁忙的 runner 在这段空档里把该端口分配给别的进程时，`qwen serve` 不会失败，而是顺延到下一个端口，于是测试的 `/capabilities` 轮询会一直等待那个已经失效的端口，直到超时。现在，当 harness 报告这种端口迁移时，启动流程会用新的端口重试整个启动尝试，与已有的、只覆盖 Spring 和内嵌 broker 的重试保持一致。

### 如何验证

Node 22 沙箱，没有 JDK、Maven 或 MySQL；CI 的托管 MySQL 通道是 Java 测试的最终见证。

prs.title: ci: reduce redundant TUI parity runs and build scope
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Cancels superseded TUI parity runs for the same PR and skips both expensive TUI gates when a PR changes only the Java managed-agent service and documentation. The existing check names remain present as skipped checks. Manual dispatches always run and remain independent.

Both gates use the existing CLI dependency build instead of building every workspace. Component checks, the no-flicker gate, bundling, all three runtime/renderer acceptance legs, and strict error handling are retained. Shared build-input changes remain covered, including patches and workspace configuration.

## Why it's needed

[PR #15261](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15261) changes Java service code and documentation but triggered the full TUI workflow. Applying the new classifier to its current 16-file diff correctly skips the expensive gates. A completed baseline [run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39975710372) spent 22m33s in parity, including 6m21s building and 13m02s in serial acceptance. Repeated pushes could leave multiple copies running because there was no concurrency group.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A Java-service-only PR, optionally accompanied by documentation, should finish the impact check and skip both existing named TUI checks. A mixed PR that touches a CLI dependency, test, or build input should run both.
- Renaming a CLI file into the Java subtree must still run the checks. Incomplete API results require testing; if classification fails, both gates still run and the workflow retains the classification failure.
- A newer commit on the same PR should cancel its older workflow. Other PRs and manual dispatches should remain independent.
- The CLI-only build should still supply every component, offline no-flicker, bundle, and three-leg product acceptance consumer.

Local validation passed:

- Fresh `npm run build -- --cli-only && npm run bundle`, followed by all consumer checks below before the full build.
- Workflow meta-tests: 63/63; ESLint, Prettier, design-link checks, and `actionlint -ignore SC2016` passed. Unfiltered actionlint reports the same two pre-existing SC2016 warnings on literal `$version` JSON in the base workflow.
- Component parity: all 10 scripts passed; offline no-flicker: zero clears and balanced DEC2026 (24 begin / 24 end).
- Matrix/viewport: 20/20; Node+Ink, Bun+Ink, and Bun+OpenTUI: 36/36 each, for 128/128 Vitest tests. No retries or relaxed assertions.
- Subsequent full `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` passed. Independent correctness and security reviews found no issues.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for product UI changes. This changes CI scheduling and build selection. The live 16-file diff from #15261 requires TUI checks before this change and returns `false` from the new impact classifier.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | Node 22.22.0, Bun 1.3.14, arm64; validation details above |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | Pending PR CI |

### Environment (optional)

Fresh isolated worktree and frozen pnpm install. TUI consumers use empty temporary settings/home directories and offline fixtures, with no model credentials.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the impact check adds a small hosted-runner/API dependency. All packages outside the exact Java service subtree retain coverage. A failed or incomplete classification cannot silently skip testing.
- Not validated / out of scope: actual Linux shared-runner speedup and cancellation behavior require PR CI. The three acceptance legs remain serial: shared global setup state and tight timing assertions make naive parallelism unsafe under ECS contention. Cross-job build artifact sharing is deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no product source changes, test assertions removed, or check names changed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ci/tui-parity-efficiency/docs/design/2026-10-24-tui-parity-ci-efficiency.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ci/tui-parity-efficiency/docs/design/2026-10-24-tui-parity-ci-efficiency.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same decisions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

N/A. Motivating PR: #15261 (reference only).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

取消同一 PR 的过期 TUI parity 运行；当 PR 只修改 Java managed-agent 服务及文档时，跳过两项重型 TUI 检查。原有检查名称保留，并显示为 skipped。手动触发始终执行，且各次运行彼此独立。

两项检查使用已有的 CLI 依赖构建，不再构建全部工作区。组件检查、防闪烁检查、bundle、三组运行时/渲染器产品验收以及严格异常处理保持完整。共享构建输入（包括补丁和工作区配置）变化仍被覆盖。

## 原因

[PR #15261](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15261) 修改 Java 服务代码及文档，却触发了完整 TUI 工作流。新判定逻辑已对其当前 16 个变更文件验证，可正确跳过重型检查。已完成的基线[运行](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39975710372)中，parity 耗时 22 分 33 秒，其中构建 6 分 21 秒，串行验收 13 分 02 秒。原先没有并发组，连续推送可能让多份运行同时占用资源。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 纯 Java 服务修改（可附带文档）应完成影响判定并跳过原名的两项 TUI 检查。若混合修改涉及 CLI 依赖、测试或构建输入，应运行两项检查。
- 将 CLI 文件重命名至 Java 目录仍应运行检查。API 结果不完整时必须测试；判定失败时两项检查仍运行，工作流保留判定失败状态。
- 同一 PR 的新提交应取消旧工作流；其他 PR 及手动运行互不影响。
- CLI-only 构建应继续满足全部组件、离线防闪烁、bundle 和三组产品验收的产物需求。

本地验证已通过：

- 全新依赖下执行 `npm run build -- --cli-only && npm run bundle`，在完整构建之前完成下述全部消费者验证。
- 工作流元测试 63/63；ESLint、Prettier、设计链接校验和 `actionlint -ignore SC2016` 通过。未过滤的 actionlint 在基线工作流的字面量 `$version` JSON 上同样报告两条既有 SC2016 警告。
- 组件一致性全部 10 个脚本通过；离线防闪烁零次清屏，DEC2026 平衡（24 次开始 / 24 次结束）。
- Matrix/viewport 20/20；Node+Ink、Bun+Ink、Bun+OpenTUI 各 36/36，合计 Vitest 128/128。未重试、未放宽断言。
- 随后的完整 `npm run build` 和 `npm run typecheck` 均通过。独立正确性及安全评审未发现问题。

### 前后证据

产品 UI 变化不适用。本次仅改变 CI 调度与构建选择。#15261 的实际 16 文件 diff 在修改前要求 TUI 检查，新影响判定返回 `false`。

### 测试环境

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | Node 22.22.0、Bun 1.3.14、arm64；验证详情见上文 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 等待 PR CI |

### 环境补充

全新隔离 worktree，冻结 pnpm 依赖安装。TUI 测试使用空的临时设置/home 目录及离线 fixture，不使用模型凭据。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：影响判定增加一个轻量 hosted runner/API 依赖。精确的 Java 服务目录之外，全部 package 保留覆盖。判定失败或结果不完整不会静默跳过测试。
- 未验证或暂不处理：Linux 共享 runner 的实际提速及取消行为仍需 PR CI 验证。三组验收维持串行；共享全局初始化状态和严格时间断言使直接并行在 ECS 负载下存在风险。跨 job 共享构建产物暂缓。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无；不修改产品源码、不移除测试断言、不改变检查名称。

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): share the openable-PR filter with the details tooltip
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The session details tooltip now lists its pull requests through `openableSessionPrs`, the same filter the session PR badge uses, instead of keeping its own copy of it. There is no behaviour change: the tooltip still lists only openable PRs, newest first.

- The tooltip reverses a copy of the session's bindings and hands it to `openableSessionPrs`. Because it reverses a copy, the session's own array is never reordered in place, even if the helper someday returns its input unchanged.
- The helper's doc comment is corrected. It said non-http(s) bindings are filtered out, but the external opener also accepts `mailto:`. It now also notes that the tooltip shares the helper and that the helper keeps the order it was given.

## Why it's needed

A reviewer on #15238 flagged, two rounds running, that `SessionDetailsTooltip.tsx` kept its own `[...prs].reverse().filter((pr) => isExternalOpenUrl(pr.url))`. Today the two copies agree. But a change to the badge's notion of "openable" would have reached only the badge, and the tooltip would then list PRs the badge refuses to open, or the reverse. The tooltip tests could not catch that, because none of them depended on the helper: on main, each of the three `openableSessionPrs` mutants below leaves all 18 of them green.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the session details tooltip and session PR badge unit tests; all pass. Then apply a mutant to `openableSessionPrs`, for example make it return its input, sort it by number, or reverse its result. On main the tooltip tests stay green. On this branch each mutant fails at least one tooltip test.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no visible change). Tooltip test file only (`SessionDetailsTooltip.test.tsx`, 18 tests), each mutant applied alone and then restored:

```
mutant                                   on main          on this branch
pristine                                 18 passed (18)   18 passed (18)
helper sorts bindings by number          18 passed (18)   fails: shows the bound pull request as a link
helper returns its input                 18 passed (18)   fails: shows the bound pull request as a link,
                                                                 lists the issues the bound pull requests close
helper reverses its result               18 passed (18)   fails: same two tests
tooltip drops its reverse                -                fails: same two tests
tooltip drops the filter                 -                fails: same two tests
```

In every failing run, one more test, `copies the complete session ID from the pointer-only panel`, also fails. It is a knock-on failure: the earlier failed test never reaches its `root.unmount()`. It passes when run alone and is not counted above.

The 56 test files that render the badge or the tooltip (badge, sidebar, dialogs, session overview) all pass, 1160 tests. ESLint is clean. `tsc --noEmit` reports no errors in the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: vitest (jsdom), as above. macOS: the review on `373c25a889` ran both test files on macOS (Node 22.22.2), 24/24 pass. Windows was not tested. PR CI does not cover it either: the macOS and Windows test jobs run only for `merge_group`, `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`, not for pull requests. The change is a jsdom component refactor with no OS-dependent code.

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: low. The tooltip change is one import and one expression, and the PRs it lists, their order, and its issue list are all unchanged. The tooltip now imports from `SessionPrBadge.tsx`. That module imports nothing from `sidebar/`, so no import cycle is introduced.
- Not validated / out of scope: the tooltip's issue-URL filter still calls `isExternalOpenUrl` directly. Issues have no shared helper to reuse, and the badge doesn't render them.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15238 (a reviewer's non-blocking note), #15059 and #14994.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

会话详情浮层现在通过 `openableSessionPrs` 列出 PR。这就是会话 PR 徽标使用的同一个过滤函数，浮层不再自己保留一份副本。行为没有变化：浮层仍然只列出可打开的 PR，最新的在前。

- 浮层先复制一份会话的绑定并反转，再交给 `openableSessionPrs`。因为反转的是副本，即使 helper 以后改成原样返回输入，会话自己的数组也不会被原地重排。
- 修正了 helper 的注释。原注释说过滤掉的是非 http(s) 的绑定，但外部链接打开器同样接受 `mailto:`。新注释还写明浮层也共用这个 helper，且 helper 保持传入时的顺序。

## 为什么需要

#15238 的一位评审者连续两轮指出，`SessionDetailsTooltip.tsx` 自己写了一份 `[...prs].reverse().filter((pr) => isExternalOpenUrl(pr.url))`。现在两份逻辑是一致的。但如果以后改动徽标对「可打开」的判定，改动只会影响徽标，浮层就会列出徽标拒绝打开的 PR，或者反过来。浮层的测试抓不到这种情况，因为它们都不依赖这个 helper：在 main 上，下文对 `openableSessionPrs` 的三个变异都让浮层的 18 个测试全部保持通过。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行会话详情浮层和会话 PR 徽标的单元测试，全部通过。然后对 `openableSessionPrs` 应用一个变异，例如让它原样返回输入、按编号排序，或反转结果。在 main 上浮层测试保持通过；在本分支上，每个变异都会让至少一个浮层测试失败。

### 证据（修改前后）

不适用（无可见变化）。只统计浮层测试文件（`SessionDetailsTooltip.test.tsx`，18 个用例），每次只应用一个变异，然后还原：

```
变异                                     main 上           本分支
未变异                                   18 passed (18)    18 passed (18)
helper 按编号排序                        18 passed (18)    失败：shows the bound pull request as a link
helper 原样返回输入                      18 passed (18)    失败：shows the bound pull request as a link、
                                                                  lists the issues the bound pull requests close
helper 反转结果                          18 passed (18)    失败：同上两个
浮层去掉反转                             -                 失败：同上两个
浮层去掉过滤                             -                 失败：同上两个
```

每次失败的运行里，还会多失败一个用例 `copies the complete session ID from the pointer-only panel`。这是连带失败：前面失败的用例没有走到 `root.unmount()`。它单独运行时能通过，上表没有计入。

渲染徽标或浮层的 56 个测试文件（徽标、侧边栏、对话框、会话总览）全部通过，共 1160 个用例。ESLint 无告警。`tsc --noEmit` 在改动的文件里没有报错。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux：vitest（jsdom），见上文。macOS：`373c25a889` 上的评审在 macOS（Node 22.22.2）上运行了这两个测试文件，24/24 通过。Windows 没有测试，PR 的 CI 也不覆盖：macOS 和 Windows 的测试 job 只在 `merge_group`、`schedule` 和 `workflow_dispatch` 时运行，不在 pull request 上运行。这次改动是 jsdom 组件的重构，没有依赖操作系统的代码。

### 环境（可选）

不适用（仅单元测试）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：低。浮层只改了一个导入和一个表达式，它列出的 PR、顺序和 issue 列表都没有变化。浮层现在从 `SessionPrBadge.tsx` 导入。该模块不从 `sidebar/` 导入任何东西，所以不会引入循环依赖。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：浮层对 issue URL 的过滤仍然直接调用 `isExternalOpenUrl`。issue 没有可复用的共享 helper，徽标也不渲染 issue。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

#15238（一位评审者的非阻塞意见）、#15059 和 #14994 的后续。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): expose model output language in settings panel
prs.body:
## What this PR does The Web Shell settings panel now shows the model output language next to the UI language. The daemon serves `general.outputLanguage` to hosts as a read-only descriptor, and the panel renders it as a combobox on the User scope tab: the input still accepts any language name, while the popover offers the supported languages as suggestions, and an empty value means auto (follow the user's input language). Committing a value sends `/language output ` through the session command channel and reloads the settings afterwards, so the persisted value, `output-language.md`, and the live system instruction stay in step. ## Why it's needed The panel previously exposed only the UI language. The model output language had no row at all, so hosts could not see or change a setting that the TUI settings dialog and the `/language output` slash command both support. The key was deliberately excluded from the settings route because a plain settings write only persists `settings.json` and leaves the rule file and running sessions stale; this change keeps that write restriction while adding a read path and the correct write path. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Open the Web Shell settings panel in a session and switch to the User tab. The General category shows "Language: Model output" directly after "Language: UI". Open its list to pick a suggested language, or type a name that is not listed; leave it empty to follow the input language. Expected: the command `/language output English` runs, the next reply uses the new language without a restart, and the `output-language.md` the session reads (the project file when it exists, otherwise the global one) is rewritten. Switching to the Workspace tab hides the row, and `POST /workspace/settings` with `general.outputLanguage` still returns `400 disallowed_key`. ### Evidence (Before & After) Both screenshots render this branch's real settings panel, driven by the workspace settings list read from the daemon through the Playwright settings harness (mock transport, real component and real descriptors). **Before** — the General category ends at the UI language row; there is no model output row. **After (English)** — the model output row sits directly after the UI language row; opening it lists the supported languages while the input still accepts a typed name. **After (中文)** — the same combobox in the Chinese UI. Route and DOM tests: ``` cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/SettingsMessage.dom.test.tsx client/settings.test.ts client/i18n.test.ts cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts ``` ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### Environment `npm run typecheck` plus the package-level vitest runs on Linux. Screenshots were captured with Playwright against the settings harness; no live-model E2E or tmux TUI capture. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: Older daemons do not serve the descriptor, so the row simply does not appear there. The row intentionally stays out of the Workspace tab because `/language output` only persists at user scope. - Not validated / out of scope: no live-model click-through proving the next reply switches language, and macOS/Windows were not exercised locally. Panel behavior is verified through DOM tests, the daemon route test, and the screenshots above. - Breaking changes / migration notes: None. `GET /workspace/settings` gains one read-only descriptor; writes remain rejected with `disallowed_key`. Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-output-language-setting.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-output-language-setting.zh-CN.md) ## Linked Issues None.
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 Web Shell 设置面板现在会在界面语言旁边显示模型输出语言。daemon 以只读 descriptor 的形式把 `general.outputLanguage` 下发给宿主，面板在“用户”标签页把它渲染成 combobox：输入框仍接受任意语言名，弹出列表展示支持的语言作为建议，空值表示 auto（跟随用户输入语言）。提交后通过会话命令通道发送 `/language output `，随后重新加载设置，使持久化的值、`output-language.md` 和当前系统提示保持一致。 ## 为什么需要 面板此前只暴露界面语言。模型输出语言完全没有对应的行，宿主既看不到也无法修改一个 TUI 设置对话框和 `/language output` 斜杠命令都支持的设置。该 key 之前被有意排除在设置路由之外，因为普通的设置写入只会持久化 `settings.json`，会让规则文件和运行中的会话保持旧状态；本改动保留这条写入限制，同时补上读路径和正确的写路径。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 在会话中打开 Web Shell 设置面板并切到“用户”标签页。“通用”分类中“语言：模型输出”紧跟在“语言：界面”之后。展开列表可选择建议的语言，也可以输入列表里没有的语言名；留空表示跟随输入语言。预期：执行 `/language output English`，下一轮回复使用新语言且无需重启，会话读取的 `output-language.md`（存在项目文件时为项目文件，否则为全局文件）被重写。切到“工作区”标签页时该行隐藏；对 `general.outputLanguage` 调用 `POST /workspace/settings` 仍返回 `400 disallowed_key`。 ### 证据（改动前后） 两张截图渲染的是本分支真实的设置面板，数据来自 daemon 的工作区设置列表，通过 Playwright 设置面板 harness 驱动（mock 传输，真实组件与真实 descriptor）。 **改动前** —— “通用”分类止于界面语言行，没有模型输出行。 **改动后（英文）** —— 模型输出行紧跟在界面语言行之后；展开后列出支持的语言，输入框仍可手输。 **改动后（中文）** —— 中文界面中展开的同一 combobox。 路由与 DOM 测试： ``` cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/SettingsMessage.dom.test.tsx client/settings.test.ts client/i18n.test.ts cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts ``` ### 测试平台 Linux 已测试；macOS、Windows 未在本地验证。 ### 环境 在 Linux 上执行 `npm run typecheck` 以及各包的 vitest；本 PR 没有做浏览器 E2E 或 tmux TUI 录制。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：旧版 daemon 不下发该 descriptor，因此那里不会出现这一行。该行有意不放在“工作区”标签页，因为 `/language output` 只写用户作用域。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：没有做手工浏览器验证或 tmux 录制，macOS/Windows 未在本地验证。面板行为由 DOM 测试和 daemon 路由测试覆盖。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`GET /workspace/settings` 多一个只读 descriptor；写入仍以 `disallowed_key` 拒绝。 设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-output-language-setting.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-output-language-setting.zh-CN.md) ## 关联 Issue 无。

prs.title: fix(ci): scope the sdk-java test-job lock to the cache write-back (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted Java test lane no longer holds the pool-wide Maven host lock for its entire test suite. It seeds a job-local Maven repository, runs the SDK install and the managed-agent tests unlocked, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the bounded cache write-back. The write-back reuses the MariaDB lane's nlink-delta copy, its 300-second backstop, and its fixed-release excludes. The workflow meta-tests and the bilingual design note follow the new scope, and the workflow size baseline records the real growth.

## Why it's needed

Issue #15281's Managed Agent gate failure is a lock wait, not a test failure. The check-run annotation names the exact state: `::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast)`. The lock is shared across the ECS pool and serialized a ~925-second suite per hold, so a handful of sibling jobs consumed the whole 5400-second budget before this job ran Maven. #15128 already moved the MariaDB lane to the write-back-only scope for the same reason; the push-time test job was the remaining whole-suite hold and the lane that timed out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Push a PR that touches a managed-agent path and open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back. The focused meta-tests also pin Maven above the lock, the job-local repository on each self-hosted leg, and the write-back lock for both sites.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the job ended with `::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast); head of queue is 0-0000000264-3663917` before Maven ran. After: the suite runs immediately; the host lock is taken only for the write-back, whose hold is bounded by the 300-second backstop. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                    Status                     |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |                ⚠️ not tested                  |
| 🪟 Windows |                ⚠️ not tested                  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ meta-tests, lint, typecheck, build         |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — workflow and meta-test change. JDK 21 and Maven are not installed in this container, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the test lane now seeds and writes back a job-local Maven repository; a cold host pays the seed/download cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real JDK 21/Maven suite was not run locally (no JDK/Maven in the container); CI runs it. Pool capacity and the lock's 5400-second budget are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15281

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

self-hosted Java test 通道不再把池级 Maven 宿主锁持在整个测试套件上。它先播种一个 job 本地 Maven 仓库，在不持锁的情况下运行 SDK install 和 managed-agent 测试，只在有界缓存写回时获取票据化宿主锁。写回复用 MariaDB 通道的 nlink 增量复制、300 秒兜底和固定发布坐标排除。工作流元测试和中英文设计文档同步到新的持锁范围，工作流体积基线记录这次真实的增长。

## 为什么需要

Issue #15281 的 Managed Agent gate 失败是一次锁等待，不是测试失败。check-run 注解给出了确切状态：`::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast)`。这把锁在 ECS 池内共享，每次持锁串行化一个约 925 秒的套件，因此少数几个兄弟 job 就在本 job 启动 Maven 之前耗尽了整整 5400 秒预算。#15128 已经出于同样的原因把 MariaDB 通道改成只在写回时持锁；push 时的 test job 是最后一个整套持锁的站点，也是这次超时的通道。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

推送一个触及 managed-agent 路径的 PR，打开 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job。self-hosted step 应当先出现 `cp -aln` 播种和三次 Maven 调用，之后才可能出现 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock`；锁等待只应出现在缓存写回处。聚焦的元测试还固定了 Maven 在锁之前、每个 self-hosted leg 使用 job 本地仓库、以及两个站点都只在写回时取锁。

### 证据（Before & After）

之前：job 在 Maven 启动前就以 `::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast); head of queue is 0-0000000264-3663917` 结束。之后：套件立即运行；宿主锁只在写回时获取，且持锁时长受 300 秒兜底约束。UI 变化：N/A。

### 测试环境

|     OS     |                   状态                    |
| :--------: | :---------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |                ⚠️ 未测试                  |
| 🪟 Windows |                ⚠️ 未测试                  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 元测试、lint、typecheck、build         |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 工作流和元测试改动。本容器没有安装 JDK 21 和 Maven，因此真实 Java 套件交给 CI 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：test 通道现在播种并写回 job 本地 Maven 仓库；冷宿主会支付一次播种/下载成本，写回是尽力而为且上限 300 秒，与 MariaDB 通道一致。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未在本地运行真实 JDK 21/Maven 套件（容器内没有 JDK/Maven）；由 CI 运行。池容量和锁的 5400 秒预算保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15281

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve OpenTUI clipboard source across draft recovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps large clipboard pastes collapsed while sending the model Ink's exact escaped source blocks and one attribution suffix. Raw human text, compact display text and source maps remain distinct through pending clipboard I/O, queue restoration, cancellation and recall. Existing Linux offered-text fallback is connected; shell and attachment-free slash input stay raw, and prepared Retry remains unchanged.

One complete batch: 17 files, +1,527/-185 (1,712 gross changed lines), head `2c79c2a63503da8a4c88ad8966149df0594c502e`. Stacked on #15389; **Draft** while #15283 → #15384 → #15386 → #15389 remain unmerged.

## Why it's needed

The real differential test showed unlabelled raw pasted material on OpenTUI's model wire, while Ink escaped and attributed the same source. A placeholder alone does not preserve source meaning. This change uses the existing draft owner and queue, without a new store, schema, dependency or permission mechanism.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Paste a large block with literal clipboard markers and backslashes between typed instructions. Expect a compact placeholder and exact escaped model text with one attribution suffix. Two blocks should produce one suffix. Check pending clipboard reads, undo/redo, cancellation/rejection with a healthy successor, source-map collisions and known/unknown history. Shell, slash, image and prepared Retry boundaries must hold. In OpenTUI, recall the original raw text, edit it and explicitly submit again; the second request and serialized model-record ancestry must match.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: preserved strict OpenTUI RED sent raw material; Ink controls sent the framed form. After: the updated permanent whole case passes separately on Node26+Ink, Bun1.4.4+Ink and Bun1.4.4+strict OpenTUI. All retain the same exact 2,475-character first-request oracle. The native continuation also verifies raw recall/edit, two actual model-journal records and ancestry. Total: 3 case passes, 4 closed HTTP requests (1/1/2), 3 natural exits0, actual executable identities and strict same-PID native mapping, with unchanged full inventories and no residue.

Normal production build/bundle and full typecheck passed; after this test/document-only update, full typecheck, scoped lint/format and normal commit hooks passed. Seven complete CLI files retain 800 passes and one original skip, selected per-file from their latest complete runs. The complete native Vim script also passes with all original undo/history/source-isolation assertions retained; three obsolete model-text expectations were updated after the actual CI failure.

The updated permanent runs used the `c742a38989` application bundle plus the exact test/document changes later committed here. All 17 shipping file hashes/modes match the tested source maps. They are not relabelled as runs of a newly stamped `2c79c2a635` bundle. Fresh committed rebuild and current CI are tracked separately. Detailed receipts and original failures are in the E2E comments.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Updated permanent three legs and complete native Vim script PASS. Native additionally verifies raw recall and model-journal ancestry. |
| 🪟 Windows | This batch's product behavior NOT_RUN. |
| 🐧 Linux | Controlled helper/caller unit coverage; native OS clipboard NOT_RUN. New-head CI is tracked separately. |

### Environment (optional)

Owned settings and loopback fake model HTTP; pinned Node24 controller; observed Node26/Bun1.4.4 product executables. Native component script uses the pinned historical Bun resource separately. Development-bundle proof does not establish npm handoff or installed-package acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: mixing model/display/raw-source ownership across asynchronous restoration. Existing owners and structured queue metadata are preserved and exercised by complete consumer regressions.
- Remaining: native OS clipboard, real multi-paste/shell/queue/steering/Vim product flows, installed delivery, platform qualification and unmerged dependencies. Ink itself loses the pasted source during recall (#15397); its unchanged history chain is tracked separately, not accepted as a green placeholder oracle. Native recall coverage does not claim cross-renderer recall parity or ordinary raw-human persistence.
- Compatibility: no new schema, product flag or dependency; existing shell-image and prepared Retry semantics remain. Source attribution is not a new permission boundary.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/opentui-paste-source-lifecycle/docs/design/2026-10-24-opentui-clipboard-source-lifetime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/opentui-paste-source-lifecycle/docs/design/2026-10-24-opentui-clipboard-source-lifetime.zh-CN.md). Both versions state matching decisions, constraints and acceptance limits.

## Linked Issues

Related: #8662, #15397; stacked on #15389. No broader migration issue is closed.

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve arrival order of direct-mode stream-json startup messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In a stream-json session whose first frame is a user message (direct mode, i.e. no SDK `initialize` control request), `initializeDirectMode` awaited config initialization *before* enqueueing that first message. A second user message arriving inside that initialization window was enqueued straight from the read loop, so it overtook the first one: the two turns ran in reverse arrival order and their `result` frames came back reversed, with exit code 0 and no error anywhere.

This moves the enqueue ahead of the `await`, keeping `ensureInitializationPromise()` first so the drain always has a promise to wait on.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #15365 and reproduced 3/3 on npm 0.26.0. Two messages sent back-to-back at session startup execute and report in the wrong order, silently. Any client that pipelines an initial user message plus a follow-up before config initialization finishes is affected. SDK sessions are not: their first frame is an `initialize` control request, which takes `initializeSdkMode` and does not have this ordering hazard.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression test drives the headless session directly, with no model, no network, no credentials and no sleeps:

- no `control_request` is yielded, so the session takes the direct-mode path;
- the input generator yields `'First message'` then `'Second message'`, and only afterwards releases a pending `config.initialize` promise. Generator semantics guarantee both frames have already reached the read loop by the time initialization completes, so the ordering window is deterministic rather than raced;
- the assertion is on the inputs `processUserMessage` handed to `runNonInteractive`, in call order.

Before the fix, that assertion fails:

```
FAIL  src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts > runNonInteractiveStreamJson > processes direct-mode startup messages in arrival order
AssertionError: expected [ 'Second message', 'First message' ] to deeply equal [ 'First message', 'Second message' ]
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 45 passed (46)
```

After the fix, the whole file passes:

```
 ✓ src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts (46 tests) 1060ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  46 passed (46)
```

`npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts --root packages/cli` on Linux, base `6094ba82`.

The green was also checked against a false-green by injected mutation: reverting only the ordering change turns the new test red again with the same `['Second message', 'First message']` assertion error (`1 failed | 45 passed (46)`, exit 1), and restoring it returns to `46 passed` (exit 0). The two pre-existing tests that touch multi-message handling (`processes multiple user messages sequentially`, `enqueues user messages received during processing`) both yield an `initialize` control request first and only assert `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)`, so they pass with the bug present; that is why the new test asserts call order on the direct-mode path instead.

`npx eslint packages/cli/src/nonInteractive/session.ts packages/cli/src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts` exits 0 with no output.

`packages/cli` typecheck was **not executed** on the development machine: MemAvailable was ~2.5GB with SwapFree ~0, and this package's `tsc` has previously died at 2800MB (exit 134) and 4096MB (exit 137). Leaving that to CI rather than reporting a number I did not measure.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no screen surface. This is an internal async enqueue-ordering fix on the headless stream-json path, and it does not change outbound wire behaviour: it does not change whether a request is made, where it goes, whether it uses a proxy, or its payload. It only changes the order in which two already-decided model calls are issued, and that order is fully covered by the deterministic ordering assertion above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (`vitest`, node environment). No runtime, sandbox or seatbelt involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the first message is now enqueued while config initialization is still pending. That is safe because `processUserMessage` already awaits `waitForInitialization()` before touching `this.config`, and everything the enqueue itself does beforehand (`extractUserMessageText`, `readHumanInputFromSdkMessage`) is pure message parsing.
- Not validated / out of scope: `packages/cli` typecheck (see above). The SDK-mode path is unchanged, as is the failure path — `failInitialization` still rejects, `waitForInitialization` still throws, and the existing catch in `processPendingWork` still emits the error result.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Two files, +37/-3.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15365

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在首帧就是 user 消息的 stream-json 会话里（direct 模式，即没有 SDK 的 `initialize` 控制请求），`initializeDirectMode` 会先 `await` config 初始化、**之后**才把这条消息入队。而在这个初始化窗口内到达的第二条 user 消息是由读循环直接入队的，于是它插到了第一条前面：两条消息按倒序执行，`result` 帧也按倒序返回，退出码 0，全程没有任何错误提示。

本 PR 把入队提到 `await` 之前，同时保持 `ensureInitializationPromise()` 在最前，确保 drain 时 promise 一定已经存在。

## 为什么需要

#15365 报告，在 npm 0.26.0 上 3/3 复现。会话启动阶段连续发两条消息，执行与返回顺序都是错的，且静默无提示。任何在 config 初始化完成前就把首条 user 消息和后续消息一起发出来的客户端都会中招。SDK 会话不受影响：它的首帧是 `initialize` 控制请求，走 `initializeSdkMode`，没有这个顺序隐患。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

回归测试直接驱动 headless 会话，不需要模型、网络、凭据，也不用 sleep：

- 不 yield 任何 `control_request`，因此会话走 direct 模式路径；
- 输入生成器先 yield `'First message'`，再 yield `'Second message'`，**之后**才放行一个 pending 的 `config.initialize` promise。生成器语义保证两条消息都已进入读循环之后初始化才完成，所以这个顺序窗口是确定性的，不依赖竞态；
- 断言的是 `processUserMessage` 交给 `runNonInteractive` 的 input，按调用顺序。

修复前该断言失败：

```
FAIL  src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts > runNonInteractiveStreamJson > processes direct-mode startup messages in arrival order
AssertionError: expected [ 'Second message', 'First message' ] to deeply equal [ 'First message', 'Second message' ]
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 45 passed (46)
```

修复后整个文件通过：

```
 ✓ src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts (46 tests) 1060ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  46 passed (46)
```

命令为 `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts --root packages/cli`，Linux，base `6094ba82`。

也用注入型变异排除了「假绿」：只回退顺序改动，新测试重新变红并报同样的 `['Second message', 'First message']`（`1 failed | 45 passed (46)`，exit 1）；改回来则回到 `46 passed`（exit 0）。另外两个涉及多消息处理的既有测试（`processes multiple user messages sequentially`、`enqueues user messages received during processing`）都先 yield 了 `initialize` 控制请求，且只断言 `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)`，因此在缺陷存在时同样通过；这也是新测试改为在 direct 模式路径上断言调用顺序的原因。

`npx eslint packages/cli/src/nonInteractive/session.ts packages/cli/src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts` 退出码 0，无输出。

`packages/cli` 的 typecheck 在开发机上**未执行**：MemAvailable 约 2.5GB、SwapFree 约 0，而这个包的 `tsc` 此前在 2800MB 下 exit 134、4096MB 下 exit 137。这一步交给 CI，不报一个我没有实测出来的数字。

### 前后对照证据

N/A —— 没有可截图的界面。这是 headless stream-json 路径上的内部异步入队顺序修复，且不改变出站 wire 行为：不改变请求该不该发、发去哪、走不走代理、载荷内容。它只改变两次已决定的模型调用的**发出顺序**，而这个顺序已被上面那条确定性顺序断言完整覆盖。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试（`vitest`，node 环境），不涉及 runtime、sandbox 或 seatbelt。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：现在第一条消息会在 config 初始化仍 pending 时入队。这是安全的，因为 `processUserMessage` 在触碰 `this.config` 之前已经 `await this.waitForInitialization()`，而入队之前所做的全部工作（`extractUserMessageText`、`readHumanInputFromSdkMessage`）都是纯消息解析。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：`packages/cli` 的 typecheck（见上）。SDK 模式路径未改动，失败路径也未改动 —— `failInitialization` 仍然 reject，`waitForInitialization` 仍然 throw，`processPendingWork` 里既有的 catch 仍然发出 error result。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。两个文件，+37/-3。

prs.title: test(web-shell): stop requiring the token-usage meta to wrap at min width
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Relaxes one layout assertion in the web-shell token-usage smoke test. At the split-view minimum width it now fails when the header's meta row actually overlaps the headline value, instead of requiring the meta to be stacked underneath the value. Right-edge alignment and the no-overflow check are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The smoke lane has been red for every trusted PR since it moved onto the ARM64 ECS pool: the `token usage 1200px zh-CN light` case fails on all three attempts on every hz1/hz2 host, while the identical commit stays green on the Hong Kong x64 pool and on GitHub-hosted runners. Compare [the ARM64 job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40036868669/job/120709730853) (1 failed / 358 passed) with [the hosted run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40019579092) of the same revision (358 passed).

The rendering on the failing host is not broken: in the failure screenshot the meta row sits beside the value, right-aligned to the header edge, with nothing overflowing — it simply does not wrap. Whether the zh-CN header wraps at the minimum panel width is decided by a few pixels of font metrics; the English label is longer and always wraps, which is why only the zh-CN case fails. The same failure also shows up on PRs that touch no web-shell code at all, such as #15377.

Asserting one of two acceptable layouts pinned the suite to a host's font stack. Asserting the invariant keeps the regression the check exists for — the meta must never overlap the value at minimum width — and stops the lane from going red on any font update.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the token-usage spec on a host where it already passed (macOS, GitHub-hosted, or the x64 pool): all six width/language/theme cases must stay green.
- On the ARM64 pool this PR's own CI is the check: before the change the zh-CN case failed 3/3, after it the suite should be green.
- To see the guarded regression still fail, make the meta row overlap the value (for example by absolutely positioning it over the headline) and confirm the assertion fires.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the ARM64 pool: `expect(alignment.wrapped).toBe(true)` received `false`, on all three attempts — [job 120709730853](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40036868669/job/120709730853).

After, patched spec run locally on macOS:

```
npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts client/e2e/web-shell.token-usage.spec.ts
6 passed (56.3s)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux covers both the ARM64 and the x64 pool; this PR's CI is the first run there with the relaxed assertion.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a regression that makes the meta hug the value without overlapping it would no longer fail. The right-edge alignment and no-overflow checks still cover the visible failure modes, and the layout has not changed.
- Not validated / out of scope: the ARM64 pool's font stack. Standardizing fonts across the hz and hk pools would remove this class of drift for every pixel-sensitive test, but that work is ops-side and is not required to unblock PRs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15364, which routed this lane to the ARM64 pool.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

放宽 web-shell token 用量冒烟测试里的一条布局断言：在分栏最小宽度下，现在只在 header 的 meta 行与主数值真的重叠时失败，而不再要求 meta 必须换行到数值下方。右边缘对齐与不溢出两项检查保持不变。

## 为什么需要

自打这条 lane 落到 ARM64 ECS 池，所有可信 PR 的冒烟 lane 都是红的：`token usage 1200px zh-CN light` 在每台 hz1/hz2 主机上三次重试全挂，而同一份提交在香港 x64 池和 GitHub 托管 runner 上都是绿的。可以对比 [ARM64 的 job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40036868669/job/120709730853)（1 挂 / 358 过）与同一版本的[托管运行](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40019579092)（358 全过）。

失败主机上的渲染本身没坏：失败截图里 meta 行就在数值右边、右对齐到 header 边缘、也没有溢出，只是没有换行。zh-CN header 在最小面板宽度下是否换行，取决于几像素的字体度量差异；英文标签更长、必定换行，所以只有 zh-CN 这条挂。完全没有改动 web-shell 的 PR（例如 #15377）也会挂同一条。

原来的写法把"两种都合规的布局"钉死成其中一种，等于把测试绑在某台主机的字体栈上。改成断言不变量后，它要守的回归——最小宽度下 meta 不许压住数值——仍在，同时不会因为任何一次字体更新就让 lane 变红。

## 评审怎么验

- 在原本就通过的主机上（macOS、GitHub 托管、或 x64 池）跑 token 用量这个 spec：六个宽度/语言/主题组合必须全绿。

prs.title: fix(vscode): keep transcript selection alive during host-driven webview copy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Selecting text in the companion's message history and pressing Ctrl+C (or choosing Copy in the right-click context menu) stopped putting the selected text into the clipboard on VS Code 1.143.0. The selection highlight stayed, but the clipboard was left unchanged — or was even cleared when no text was selected.

This PR keeps a non-editable element focused while the user presses the pointer into a non-interactive part of the webview (the transcript, empty states, panels). The app root element is now focusable and receives focus on such pointer presses, unless the press lands on a control (button, link, input, textarea, select, contenteditable, role=button) — those keep their own focus behavior.

## Why it's needed

VS Code 1.143.0 changed its webview guest script: before running a clipboard `execCommand` (which is how Ctrl+C and the context-menu Copy are delivered to webviews), it now restores focus to the webview's last focused element whenever the active element is `<body>`. In the companion, the last focused element is the composer's contenteditable, and focusing an editable collapses the document text selection — so the copy ran against an empty selection and landed nothing.

Focusing a non-editable element (the app root) instead keeps the selection intact, and because the active element is then no longer `<body>`, the guest script skips the focus restore entirely and the copy proceeds against the live selection. The fix is scoped to the companion's own webview; the web app and other surfaces are unaffected because their clipboard paths don't go through the VS Code guest script.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On VS Code 1.143.0 (or newer) with this extension built and loaded:

1. Send a message so the transcript has an assistant reply; type in the composer once so it has been focused.
2. Select any text in the message history with the mouse.
3. Press Ctrl+C and paste somewhere — the selected text should appear (Before: the clipboard is unchanged or cleared).
4. Repeat with right-click → Copy — same result.
5. Confirm nothing regressed: clicking a message button (copy icon, edit, approval options) still focuses/activates it, typing in the composer still works, and the selection popover's Copy buttons still copy.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Verified in a real VS Code 1.143.0 window (Linux) with an instrumented webview build. Before: instrumenting the webview showed the `copy` event and `execCommand('copy')` firing with the selection already empty, immediately after a `focusin` on the composer's contenteditable delivered through the host messaging channel; the OS clipboard kept its previous content. After the fix: the same select-then-Ctrl+C flow lands the selected word in the OS clipboard (checked with `xclip`).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested  |

### Environment (optional)

Verified against a real VS Code 1.143.0 (snap) window with the extension built from this branch and driven over CDP; package unit tests (`npm run test`: 651 passed, 1 skipped), typecheck and lint clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a pointer press on non-interactive webview areas now moves DOM focus to the app root instead of leaving it on `<body>`. The element is not tabbable, has no visible focus ring, and pressing on any control is excluded, so interactive focus behavior is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows hosts (the guest script change is in VS Code itself, so behavior should match); an upstream microsoft/vscode report for the refocus-before-copy behavior is worth filing separately — the workaround here is defensive and also helps older extension versions.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15402

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

在 VS Code 1.143.0 上，在会话历史中选中文字后按 Ctrl+C（或右键菜单中的 Copy）不再能把文字复制到剪贴板：高亮仍在，但剪贴板内容不变（没有选中文字时甚至会被清空）。

本 PR 让指针按在 webview 的非交互区域（消息历史、空状态、面板）时，保持一个非可编辑元素处于聚焦状态：应用根元素现在可聚焦，并在这类按下时接收焦点；如果按在控件上（按钮、链接、输入框、textarea、select、contenteditable、role=button），则不改变其原有焦点行为。

## 为什么需要

VS Code 1.143.0 修改了 webview 宿主脚本：在执行剪贴板 `execCommand`（Ctrl+C 和右键 Copy 都通过它下发）之前，如果当前活动元素是 `<body>`，会先把焦点恢复到 webview 中“最后聚焦过的元素”。在 companion 中这个元素是输入框的 contenteditable，聚焦可编辑元素会折叠文档中的文字选区——于是复制发生在一个空选区上，什么都没复制到。

改为聚焦非可编辑元素（应用根元素）可以保住选区；且此时活动元素不再是 `<body>`，宿主脚本会完全跳过焦点恢复，复制针对实时选区执行。修复范围仅限 companion 自己的 webview；Web 版等其它界面不受影响，因为它们的剪贴板路径不经过 VS Code 宿主脚本。

## 验证方法

在 VS Code 1.143.0（或更新版本）加载本分支构建的扩展：

1. 发送一条消息让历史里出现回复；在输入框里输入一次使其被聚焦过。
2. 用鼠标选中历史消息中的任意文字。
3. 按 Ctrl+C 后粘贴——应出现所选文字（修复前：剪贴板不变或被清空）。
4. 右键 → Copy 重复一遍，结果相同。
5. 确认无回归：消息上的按钮（复制图标、编辑、审批选项）仍可聚焦/激活，输入框输入正常，选区气泡里的 Copy 按钮仍可复制。

## 证据（修复前后）

在真实 VS Code 1.143.0（Linux）窗口中用带插桩的 webview 构建验证。修复前：`copy` 事件和 `execCommand('copy')` 触发时选区已经为空，且紧随其前的是经宿主消息通道送达的、对输入框 contenteditable 的 `focusin`；系统剪贴板保持原内容。修复后：同样的选中后 Ctrl+C 流程能把所选单词写入系统剪贴板（用 `xclip` 验证）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：非交互区域的按下现在会把 DOM 焦点移到应用根元素而不是停留在 `<body>`。该元素不可 Tab 聚焦、无可见焦点框，且按在控件上时被排除，交互焦点行为不变。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：macOS 与 Windows 宿主（宿主脚本变化在 VS Code 本身，行为应一致）；建议另外向 microsoft/vscode 报告“复制前恢复焦点”的上游问题，本 PR 的防御性修复对旧版扩展同样有效。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #15402

</details>

> **Status: superseded — this change is being landed onto main in reviewable batches tracked in #8662.**
>
> This PR carries the complete ink→OpenTUI renderer migration (215 files, +53,193 lines). Per the
> rollout plan in #8662, the code lands on main behind the existing `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER` opt-in
> flag (default stays **ink**) in dependency-ordered batches — infra/deps, foundation modules,
> live-session & input, dialogs & commands, backend composition root, renderer activation,

> batches are cut from.

## What this change is (for historical reference)

Replaces the ink 7 rendering layer with **OpenTUI** (Zig native renderer: row memcmp fast-path,
cell-level diff, run coalescing, zero erase sequences, DEC 2026 synchronized output) for a
flicker-free TUI with first-class mouse (drag-select + copy-on-select, click-to-expand, wheel
scroll) and native virtual scrolling — see #8662 for the full background, design contracts, and
accepted trade-offs.

- Single `scrollbox` virtual viewport replaces `VirtualizedList`/`<Static>`; ink patch and VP mode retired on the opentui path.
- Framework-neutral `ui/model/` state machines shared by both renderers; dependency-direction arch test enforces the seam.
- Dual-renderer dispatch: ink remains the default; `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui` (Bun, or Node with `node:ffi`) opts into the new renderer.
- Parity tooling: ink→opentui JSX codemod, tui-parity PTY harness (flicker metrics, normalized screen compare), renderer-matrix integration tests, opentui e2e CI leg.

Five review rounds completed on this PR — all 56 unique round-1 Critical findings resolved with
regression tests (see the batched fix reports in the comment thread below), full opentui unit
suite (1,007 tests) green with ESLint/`tsc`/Prettier clean, PTY smoke runs passing, and CI green
on every batch. The fixes ride along in the split PR that carries each file.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): wrap long diff lines
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Wraps long lines in Web Shell diff previews while preserving indentation, line numbers, and access to every row. A short Changes panel now scrolls the diff rows instead of clipping their wrapped content. Document transcripts retain their natural height and normal document scrolling.

## Why it's needed

Long paths and URLs previously required horizontal scrolling. Enabling wrapping alone exposed a second problem when a review panel had little vertical space: the preview root clipped content before the row container became scrollable. This change makes the root and rows shrink together and covers the real Changes panel with a browser regression test.

## Reviewer Test Plan

- Open a session with several changed files, expand a diff containing a few long paths in a short browser window, and scroll to its final row. Long lines should wrap and all rows should remain reachable.
- Repeat with a longer diff. The row container should scroll vertically without horizontal overflow or clipping by its parent.
- Render an expanded document transcript. It should grow naturally and expose the final diff row through document scrolling.

## How to verify

Environment: Windows AMD64, Node 24.15.0, pnpm 11.24.0, Chromium 1234. The installed browser revision was selected through a local Playwright configuration; committed tests use the repository configuration.

- `npm --workspace packages/web-shell run test -- client/components/messages/tools/DiffView.styles.test.ts`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `npm --workspace packages/web-shell run lint`, `npm --workspace packages/web-shell run typecheck`, and `npm --workspace packages/web-shell run build`: passed.
- `node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/tools/DiffView.module.css packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/tools/DiffView.styles.test.ts packages/web-shell/client/e2e/web-shell.diff-wrap.spec.ts`: passed.
- `npm --workspace packages/web-shell run test:e2e -- web-shell.diff-wrap.spec.ts --project=chromium`: the equivalent local-browser configuration passed 2/2 tests at 1280x600, with 3 and 20 long diff lines.
- Independent browser checks: 4/4 actual Changes-panel cases at 1280x600 and 1280x950, plus 2/2 public document-transcript cases at 800x600. Every final row was reachable; document mode retained `max-height: none` and `overflow-y: visible`.
- Strengthened-style mutation checks: both an appended `white-space: pre` declaration and a document-mode override were rejected by the tests. Original CSS was restored after each check.
- Full Web Shell suite collected before these commits: baseline 10,633 passed / 2 failed; final 10,637 passed / 0 failed. Commands: `npm --workspace packages/web-shell run test -- --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=json --outputFile=<absolute-report-path>`. The original two failures were in existing daemon-session tests; no new failures occurred.

Browser runs had no JavaScript page errors. The mocked daemon does not serve every unrelated resource: `/workspace/models` returned 500 in panel cases, and one document case had a missing resource. These were recorded separately from layout results; no external model request was used.

## Risk & Scope

The change affects diff layout and regression coverage only. The repository-wide preflight was not run; the affected Web Shell package checks were run. No public API or migration changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13248

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve wrapped drafts during arrow navigation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves unsent Web Shell drafts while ArrowUp/ArrowDown move between visual rows, including soft wraps and RTL or mixed-direction text. On an edge row, arrows first reach the document edge before browsing history; short single-row prompts retain immediate history recall.

Continuous paging applies only to active arrow-history browsing of a single logical line. Selections, entries with real newlines, edited recalls, and search/panel recalls retain editor control. Paging past the newest entry restores the draft. An explicit search or panel recall starts a fresh navigation sequence, so subsequent paging returns to the selected text without tags from an earlier draft.

## Why it's needed

A long paragraph can occupy several visual rows without containing a newline. Treating that paragraph as a history boundary replaces an unsent draft during ordinary caret movement. Horizontal visual endpoints also need not match logical document endpoints in bidi text, so the boundary decision now compares vertical caret and edge positions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Establish two history entries, then enter a paragraph long enough to wrap. ArrowUp from a later row and ArrowDown from an earlier row should move the caret inside the document without changing its text. Repeat with explicit newlines and wrapped RTL text.
2. Move within the first/last row near the document edge. One arrow should reach the true edge; the next may browse history. Active browsing should page through wrapped single-line entries and eventually restore the draft.
3. Try short LTR, RTL, and mixed-direction prompts. ArrowUp should recall history immediately, and ArrowDown should restore the exact draft.
4. Select recalled text, edit a wrapped recall, or recall through search/the history panel. Arrows should preserve the text and keep normal editing behavior; entries containing real newlines should also keep caret movement inside their lines.

5. Browse history first, then pick a different wrapped entry through search or the panel. Interior arrows should preserve the pick. Browse again from the document edge and return; the selected text should return without tags from the earlier draft.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The latest follow-up is based on incoming PR head `a4c2079a`, synchronized with main at `9e2d6ebf`. Before the fix, **4 new DOM cases fail with 184 controls passing**, and **2 new browser cases fail with 15 controls passing**. After the fix, **all 280 related composer/history unit tests and all 17 browser regressions pass**. The browser regressions use real Chromium and the repository mock daemon. All 17 are selected by the existing PR smoke filter.

| Interaction | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browse history, pick a different wrapped entry through search/panel, then use interior arrows | The pick is replaced by another history entry or the old draft | The pick is preserved while the caret moves inside it; later browsing returns to the selected text |

A dedicated tagged-draft regression also fails if navigation is reset without clearing the old tag snapshot. Replacing visual-row overlap with logical-line equality makes all eight focused geometry cases fail, so the fast unit lane now detects that regression too. Independent verification against the final built CLI and actual daemon passes all 4 checks, covering search/Tab and panel/click with and without prior paging. It uses no Vite, mock daemon or model call.

Full repository build, a final rebuild of the changed Web Shell package, bundle, repository-wide typecheck, lint, changed-file formatting and whitespace checks pass. No fresh full preflight is claimed. Upstream CI needs maintainer approval (`action_required`), separately from these local results.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium, unit tests, build checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 22.22.3, Chromium build 1234, viewport 1100 × 900. Production verification uses isolated configuration, runtime, and workspace directories.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: visual-row ownership depends on rendered editor geometry. Browser regressions cover bidi, wraps, state transitions, selections, and draft restoration; no performance improvement is claimed.
- Not validated / out of scope: other browser engines, Windows/Linux, touch textarea behavior, model execution, and a direct RTL document-end-to-footer focus handoff.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14879

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 中，上下方向键跨视觉行移动光标时保留未发送草稿，涵盖自动换行、RTL 和双向混排文本。在边缘视觉行，方向键先到达文档真正的起点或终点，再进入历史；短单视觉行提示仍可立即回溯历史。

连续历史分页仅适用于已启动方向键历史浏览且只有一个逻辑行的条目。选区、含真实换行的条目、编辑后的召回内容及搜索／面板召回仍由编辑器处理。越过最新历史条目时恢复草稿。显式搜索／面板召回会重新开始导航，之后翻页返回时恢复所选文本，不会附上更早草稿的标签。

## 为什么需要

长段落即使没有换行符，也可能占据多个视觉行。将它直接视为历史边界，会在普通光标移动时替换未发送草稿。双向文本的水平视觉端点也未必对应逻辑文档端点，因此边界判断改为比较光标与文档边缘的纵向位置。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

1. 建立两条历史后，输入足够自动换行的长段落。从靠后的视觉行按上方向键、从靠前的视觉行按下方向键，应在文档内部移动光标并保留全文。对含显式换行及自动换行 RTL 的文本重复验证。
2. 在首行／末行靠近文档边缘处移动光标。第一次方向键应到达真正边界，下一次才可进入历史。已启动的历史浏览应能连续翻阅自动换行的单逻辑行条目，并最终恢复草稿。
3. 分别输入短 LTR、RTL 和双向混排提示。上方向键应立即召回历史，下方向键应恢复完全相同的草稿。
4. 选中召回文本、编辑自动换行的历史条目，或通过搜索／历史面板召回。方向键应保留内容并维持普通编辑行为；含真实换行的条目也应能在内部各行间移动光标。

5. 先用方向键浏览历史，再通过搜索／面板选择另一条自动换行条目。内部方向键应保留所选文本。从文档边缘再次浏览并返回时，应恢复所选文本，且不附上更早草稿的标签。

### 证据（前后对照）

最新跟进基于远端 PR 提交 `a4c2079a`，已同步主干 `9e2d6ebf`。修复前，**新增 4 项 DOM 用例失败、184 项对照通过**，**新增 2 项浏览器用例失败、15 项对照通过**；修复后，**280 项相关输入框／历史单测和 17 项浏览器回归全部通过**。浏览器回归使用真实 Chromium 与仓库模拟 daemon，17 项均可被现有 PR smoke 筛选选中。

| 交互 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 先浏览历史，再通过搜索／面板选择另一条自动换行条目，随后使用内部方向键 | 所选内容被其他历史或旧草稿替换 | 保留所选内容并在内部移动光标；之后浏览并返回时恢复所选文本 |

另有一项标签草稿回归：若只重置导航而不清理旧标签快照，该用例会失败。将视觉行重叠退回逻辑行相等判断，会让 8 项几何专项单测全部失败，因此快速单测也能检测这一退化。独立的最终构建 CLI／真实 daemon 验证 4 项全部通过，覆盖 search/Tab 与 panel/click、以及先翻页与未翻页状态；没有使用 Vite、模拟 daemon 或模型调用。

整仓构建、最终 Web Shell 重建、bundle、全仓类型检查、lint、改动文件格式和空白检查均通过。未宣称重新通过完整 preflight。上游 CI 仍需维护者批准（`action_required`），与这些本地结果分别记录。

### 本地测试系统

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium、单元测试及构建检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js 22.22.3、Chromium build 1234，视口 1100 × 900。生产验证使用隔离的配置、runtime 和 workspace 目录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：视觉行归属依赖编辑器实际渲染几何。浏览器回归覆盖双向文本、自动换行、状态转换、选区与草稿恢复；未宣称性能提升。
- 未验证或超出范围：其他浏览器引擎、Windows/Linux、触摸设备 textarea、模型执行及 RTL 文档末尾到 footer 的直接焦点交接。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无。

修复 #14879。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

`pruneSnapshots` in `packages/core/src/agents/workflow-snapshot.ts` now counts only well-formed snapshots toward `MAX_RETAINED_SNAPSHOTS`. Previously it counted every `.json` file in the workflow runs directory, so a single malformed `.json` sitting next to 30 legitimate snapshots made the project look over cap. Because eviction picks the oldest mtime first, the victim was a real run — the malformed file that caused the overflow survived while a genuine `/workflows` history entry was silently unlinked.

The count is gated on content using the same `isWorkflowSnapshot` predicate `listWorkflowSnapshots` already applies, so "well-formed" means exactly what the loading side means. An unparseable file is skipped with a debug warning rather than thrown on, keeping prune best-effort. The cheap early return on the raw `.json` count is kept first, so a project under the cap still parses nothing.

Nothing else changes: the `/^wf_[0-9a-f]+$/` gate that guards the recursive journal `fs.rm` is untouched, so a `...json` or `notarun.json` name still cannot drive a directory delete.

## Why it's needed

A user can lose a real workflow run record with no signal at all. The trigger is not exotic — any `.json` in the runs directory that is not a snapshot (a leftover, a hand-edited file, a partial write from another tool) is enough, and the loss is silent and permanent. The loading side already treats such a file as invisible, so counting it toward the cap makes retention evict a run that is still listed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Two tests were added to `packages/core/src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts`, inside the existing `writeWorkflowSnapshot + listWorkflowSnapshots` suite:

1. `does not count a malformed .json toward the retention cap` — writes 30 legitimate snapshots with distinct ascending mtimes, plants `notarun.json` (content `{ not json`) with the *newest* mtime, then rewrites an already-existing runId so prune runs without adding a file. That is 31 `.json` on disk but only 30 snapshots. Asserts all 30 legitimate snapshots survive, that the oldest (`wf_0`) is still present, and that `notarun.json` is left untouched on disk. Before the fix this fails; after the fix it passes.
2. `still evicts the oldest of 31 well-formed snapshots` — regression arm proving the cap fix does not disable pruning: 31 legitimate snapshots with no malformed file still evict exactly one, and it is the oldest.

The malformed file is deliberately named `notarun.json`, which does **not** match `SNAPSHOT_TEMP_FILE`, so `sweepSnapshotTempFiles` cannot remove it before prune runs and hide the behaviour under test.

Run the whole file (not `-t`), so the two pre-existing retention tests are exercised unchanged:

```
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts
 ✓ src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts (54 tests) 498ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  54 passed (54)
```

Baseline before this change was 52 passed; with the two new tests it is 54 passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible / TUI surface. The test output below is the evidence.

Before (new test present, source unfixed):

```
× writeWorkflowSnapshot + listWorkflowSnapshots > does not count a malformed .json toward the retention cap 60ms
  → expected [ 'wf_1.json', 'wf_10.json', …(27) ] to have a length of 30 but got 29
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 53 passed (54)
```

After (fix applied):

```
 ✓ src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts (54 tests) 498ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  54 passed (54)
```

`eslint` and `prettier --check` are clean on both changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (`npx vitest run`). No runtime, sandbox, or network needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: **the malformed file is left on disk** — it is only excluded from the count. This is a deliberate choice. The reported harm is "a legitimate snapshot gets silently evicted", and excluding the file from the count fixes exactly that with a minimal diff. Additionally unlinking it would be a *new* destructive behaviour (deleting a `.json` this module never wrote) that the report never asked for; the existing temp-file sweep is authorised only for names matching the module's own strict `SNAPSHOT_TEMP_FILE` pattern, and that precedent does not extend to "anything that fails to parse". If maintainers would rather delete it, narrowing the unlink to `/^wf_[0-9a-f]+\.json$/` is the safe shape — happy to switch on request.
- Second consideration: the count gate now reads and parses the `.json` files in the runs directory, but only *after* the cheap raw-count early return has already established the directory is over cap. Under-cap projects — the common case — parse nothing.
- Not validated / out of scope: `packages/core` typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) did **not** run to completion here — it OOMs on this machine (exit 134 at `--max-old-space-size=2400`, MemAvailable ~2.7 GB, SwapFree 0). The change adds no new imports and only narrows a `string[]`, so type risk is low, but please treat CI as the authority.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #9418

**Scope note:** #9418 is a batch umbrella carrying 6 deferred review findings from PR #9034. This PR addresses **only** `rv:4949609635/workflow-snapshot.ts/prune-counts-shape-invalid`. The other five findings — including `ic:5305464985/workflow-snapshot.ts/hasonlykeys-strict-event-shape` and `ic:5305464985/workflow-snapshot.ts/no-byte-budget`, which live in this very same file — are untouched and still need a maintainer ruling between alternative designs. That is why this uses `Refs` rather than a closing keyword: merging this PR must not silently close the umbrella.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`packages/core/src/agents/workflow-snapshot.ts` 里的 `pruneSnapshots`，现在只把**格式合法的快照**计入 `MAX_RETAINED_SNAPSHOTS` 上限。之前它把 runs 目录下**所有** `.json` 都计入，于是 30 个合法快照旁边只要有 1 个畸形 `.json`，就会让项目看起来超出上限。由于驱逐是按 mtime 最旧优先挑的，受害者是一个真实的 run——制造溢出的畸形文件活了下来，而一条真实的 `/workflows` 历史被静默 unlink 掉。

计数门禁现在基于内容，复用加载侧 `listWorkflowSnapshots` 已经在用的同一个 `isWorkflowSnapshot` 谓词，所以「格式合法」的含义与加载侧完全一致。无法解析的文件只打一条 debug warning 并跳过，不抛异常，保持 prune 的 best-effort 语义。基于裸 `.json` 数量的那个廉价提前返回仍然放在最前面，所以未超上限的项目一个文件都不会去解析。

其余一概未动：守护递归 journal `fs.rm` 的 `/^wf_[0-9a-f]+$/` 门禁原样保留，所以名为 `...json` 或 `notarun.json` 的文件仍然无法驱动目录删除。

## 为什么需要

用户可能在毫无提示的情况下丢掉一条真实的 workflow run 记录。触发条件并不罕见——runs 目录里任何一个不是快照的 `.json`（遗留文件、被手工改过的文件、别的工具写了一半的文件）就够了，而且丢失是静默且不可恢复的。加载侧本来就把这种文件当作不存在，所以把它计入上限，会让保留策略去驱逐一个仍然会被列出来的 run。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/core/src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts` 既有的 `writeWorkflowSnapshot + listWorkflowSnapshots` suite 里加了两个测试：

1. `does not count a malformed .json toward the retention cap`——写入 30 个合法快照并赋予互不相同、递增的 mtime，再放一个 `notarun.json`（内容 `{ not json`）并给它**最新**的 mtime，然后重写一个已存在的 runId，让 prune 在不新增文件的前提下跑起来。此时盘上有 31 个 `.json`，但只有 30 个是快照。断言 30 个合法快照全部存活、最旧的 `wf_0` 仍在、且 `notarun.json` 原封不动留在盘上。修复前该测试失败，修复后通过。
2. `still evicts the oldest of 31 well-formed snapshots`——回归保护臂，证明这个修复没有把 prune 本身也一起关掉：31 个合法快照且没有畸形文件时，仍然必须恰好驱逐 1 个，而且是最旧的那个。

畸形文件特意命名为 `notarun.json`，它**不**匹配 `SNAPSHOT_TEMP_FILE`，所以 `sweepSnapshotTempFiles` 不会在 prune 之前把它删掉、把被测行为藏起来。

跑整个文件（不是 `-t`），因此两个既有的保留测试也原样被执行：

```
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts
 ✓ src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts (54 tests) 498ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  54 passed (54)
```

改动前基线是 52 passed；加上两个新测试后是 54 passed。

### 前后对照证据

N/A——没有用户可见 / TUI 界面。上面的测试输出即证据。

修复前（新测试已就位、源码未修）：

```
× writeWorkflowSnapshot + listWorkflowSnapshots > does not count a malformed .json toward the retention cap 60ms
  → expected [ 'wf_1.json', 'wf_10.json', …(27) ] to have a length of 30 but got 29
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 53 passed (54)
```

修复后：

```
 ✓ src/agents/workflow-snapshot.test.ts (54 tests) 498ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  54 passed (54)
```

两个改动文件的 `eslint` 与 `prettier --check` 均干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ 已测试   |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试（`npx vitest run`）。不需要运行时、沙箱或网络。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：**畸形文件留在盘上**，只是被排除出计数。这是有意为之。报告的伤害是「合法快照被静默驱逐」，把它排除出计数正好以最小 diff 精确修掉这一点。额外去 unlink 它会是一个**新增的破坏性行为**（删除一个本模块从未写过的 `.json`），报告从未要求过；既有的临时文件清扫只被授权用于严格匹配本模块自己的 `SNAPSHOT_TEMP_FILE` 命名的文件，这个先例不能外推到「任何解析不了的东西」。如果维护者更倾向删除，把 unlink 窄化到 `/^wf_[0-9a-f]+\.json$/` 是安全的形态——需要的话我可以改。
- 第二点考量：计数门禁现在会读取并解析 runs 目录下的 `.json`，但只在基于裸数量的廉价提前返回**已经**判定目录超出上限之后才做。未超上限的项目（常见情况）一个都不解析。
- 未验证 / 范围外：`packages/core` 的 typecheck（`tsc --noEmit`）在本机**没有**跑完——它在这台机器上 OOM（`--max-old-space-size=2400` 下 exit 134，MemAvailable ~2.7 GB，SwapFree 0）。本次改动没有引入任何新的 import，只是把一个 `string[]` 收窄，类型风险很低，但请以 CI 为准。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #9418

**范围声明：** #9418 是一个批量伞 issue，承载来自 PR #9034 的 6 条 deferred review findings。本 PR **只**处理 `rv:4949609635/workflow-snapshot.ts/prune-counts-shape-invalid`。其余 5 条——包括就在同一个文件里的 `ic:5305464985/workflow-snapshot.ts/hasonlykeys-strict-event-shape` 与 `ic:5305464985/workflow-snapshot.ts/no-byte-budget`——一律未动，仍需在备选设计之间由维护者裁决。这也是本 PR 使用 `Refs` 而非关闭关键词的原因：合并本 PR 不应静默关掉整张伞。

</details>
